jobs.title: AI Infrastructure Engineer
jobs.description: AI Infrastructure Engineer **Company:** Amaara Networks **Location:** Livermore, CA — Hybrid, with regular onsite work at our data center facility **Job Type:** Full\-Time **Experience Level:** 4–7 years **Travel:** Occasional travel, up to 10–15% **Reports To:** Manager, Data Center Operations About Amaara Networks Amaara Networks builds and operates the physical and systems infrastructure that supports modern AI workloads. Our teams deploy, configure, maintain, and troubleshoot high\-performance GPU clusters and the networking infrastructure that enables customers to train and run AI models. We are looking for an **AI Infrastructure Engineer** who enjoys working across hardware, Linux systems, high\-performance networking, and GPU infrastructure. This is a hands\-on engineering position with responsibility for complex Tier 2/Tier 3 escalations, deployments, troubleshooting, automation, and continuous improvement. Position Summary As an AI Infrastructure Engineer, you will support the full lifecycle of high\-performance GPU infrastructure—from physical installation and commissioning through Linux configuration, GPU validation, networking, troubleshooting, and production operations. You will be responsible for resolving complex infrastructure issues, identifying root causes, working directly with vendors and customers, and developing the documentation and automation that makes our infrastructure more reliable and scalable. This role is ideal for someone who enjoys both **working in the data center and solving problems from the terminal**. Key ResponsibilitiesInfrastructure Troubleshooting \& Escalation * Own Tier 2 and Tier 3 infrastructure escalations from investigation through resolution. * Perform root\-cause analysis on server and infrastructure failures using BMC/IPMI logs, kernel messages, MCE/EDAC records, thermal and power telemetry, and vendor diagnostics. * Identify recurring hardware and infrastructure issues and develop permanent corrective actions. * Participate in post\-incident reviews and translate findings into monitoring improvements, runbooks, and operational standards. * Work directly with hardware vendors on diagnostics, RMAs, firmware issues, and field\-service activities. * Communicate clearly with customers during incidents and scheduled maintenance windows. * Coordinate remote hands and field technicians during work performed at remote sites. * Participate in an infrastructure on\-call rotation. GPU Infrastructure * Deploy, administer, and troubleshoot high\-performance GPU compute systems. * Support NVIDIA H100/H200/B200/B300 SXM and PCIe platforms, AMD Instinct, or comparable accelerator platforms. * Use tools such as **nvidia\-smi, DCGM, and DCGM diagnostics** to troubleshoot GPU health and performance issues. * Analyze XID errors, ECC events, NVLink/NVSwitch health, thermal conditions, and power\-related throttling. * Install and maintain GPU drivers, CUDA toolkits, Fabric Manager, and container runtimes. * Manage software and driver compatibility across the GPU fleet. * Perform GPU stress testing, burn\-in, NCCL testing, bandwidth testing, and all\-reduce benchmarking. * Investigate performance issues including straggler nodes, reduced collective bandwidth, PCIe degradation, NUMA configuration, and topology problems. High\-Performance Networking * Configure and support **InfiniBand and RoCEv2** high\-performance AI networking environments. * Configure switches, manage firmware, and validate network topology. * Support InfiniBand subnet management, partitioning, routing, and topology validation. * Use tools such as **UFM, OFED, ibdiagnet, ibnetdiscover, and perfquery** to troubleshoot network issues. * Diagnose link flaps, symbol errors, degraded optics, cabling issues, and port\-level failures. * Configure and troubleshoot RoCE environments, including PFC, ECN, lossless queues, and congestion control. * Administer RDMA/OFED stacks, NIC/HCA firmware, bonding, VLANs, and management networks. * Support enterprise networking, including L2/L3 networking, VLANs, LACP, MLAG/VLT, firewalls, NAT, VPN, DHCP, and DNS. * Validate network performance following deployments and infrastructure changes. * Maintain accurate network topology, port maps, and infrastructure documentation. Linux Systems Administration * Administer Linux systems including **RHEL, Rocky Linux, and Ubuntu**. * Manage provisioning, patching, kernels, drivers, storage, filesystems, networking, users, and access. * Operate bare\-metal provisioning platforms such as **MAAS, Foreman, Ironic, or similar technologies**. * Troubleshoot PXE, commissioning, enrollment, deployment, and image\-related issues. * Configure cloud\-init, netplan, bonded networking, and storage layouts. * Tune Linux hosts for GPU and HPC workloads, including NUMA, CPU pinning, IRQ affinity, and I/O configuration. * Monitor hosts, GPUs, networking, and environmental conditions. * Develop monitoring, dashboards, and alerts to identify issues before they  erational runbooks. Qualifications * **4–7 years of experience** combining data center operations, infrastructure engineering, and Linux systems administration. * Strong production Linux administration experience with RHEL, Rocky Linux, or Ubuntu. * Experience managing Linux kernels, drivers, storage, networking, and shell\-level diagnostics. * Hands\-on experience operating a bare\-metal provisioning platform. * Experience with PXE, node commissioning, deployment, and provisioning troubleshooting. * Experience using **Redfish and IPMI** for hardware management, power control, boot configuration, and firmware operations. * Demonstrated Tier 2/Tier 3 escalation and incident\-resolution experience. * Strong server hardware troubleshooting and root\-cause analysis skills. * Experience with BMC/IPMI logs, system event logs, and Linux kernel diagnostics. * Experience with high\-performance networking, including **InfiniBand, RoCE, or high\-speed Ethernet**. * Working knowledge of production L2/L3 networking. * Experience supporting GPU or accelerated\-computing systems. * Understanding of data center fundamentals including power, cooling, airflow, cabling, and rack layouts. * Scripting experience with **Python or Bash**. * Familiarity with configuration management tools such as **Ansible**. * Strong technical writing and documentation skills. * Ability to communicate directly with customers during infrastructure incidents. * Ability to coordinate remote technicians and field\-service personnel. * Willingness to participate in an on\-call rotation and occasional after\-hours maintenance windows. Preferred Qualifications * Experience supporting large\-scale, multi\-rack GPU clusters. * Experience with NVIDIA SXM systems, NVLink/NVSwitch, or rail\-optimized network architectures. * Deep InfiniBand experience, including UFM, subnet management, ibdiagnet, adaptive routing, or SHARP. * Experience with Slurm, Kubernetes GPU Operators, Run:ai, or similar workload schedulers. * Experience with high\-performance storage such as Lustre, GPFS, WEKA, VAST, or NFS over RDMA. * Experience with liquid\-cooled or high\-density data center infrastructure. * Experience with Prometheus, Grafana, DCGM Exporter, Elasticsearch, or similar observability platforms. * RHCSA, RHCE, NVIDIA networking/InfiniBand certifications, CompTIA Server\+/Network\+, or Uptime Institute certifications. * Experience working in a growth\-stage environment where processes and standards are being developed. Working Conditions \& Physical Requirements This position includes regular work inside an operating data center. Candidates must be able to, with or without reasonable accommodation: * Lift and maneuver equipment weighing up to 50 lbs. unassisted and heavier equipment with team or lift assistance. * Work on ladders and in confined areas, including under raised floors and in overhead cable trays. * Stand, walk, kneel, and reach for extended periods. * Work in environments with sustained equipment noise, cold aisles, and limited natural light. * Wear required personal protective equipment (PPE). * Follow all electrical, data center, and site safety procedures. Compensation \& Benefits * **Compensation:** Negotiable, depending on experience * 401(k) * Healthcare reimbursement * Paid holidays * Flexible time off / flex\-time Why Join Amaara Networks? This is an opportunity to work directly with the infrastructure powering modern AI workloads. You'll have the opportunity to work across **GPU systems, Linux, high\-performance networking, automation, hardware, and data center operations** while helping build reliable infrastructure at scale. If you enjoy solving difficult infrastructure problems, working hands\-on with cutting\-edge technology, and turning recurring problems into permanent solutions, we'd like to hear from you. **Apply today to join Amaara Networks as an AI Infrastructure Engineer.** Pay: $1\.00 per year Benefits: * 401(k) * Paid time off Work Location: In person

jobs.title: DC Commercial Program Manager
jobs.description: Description: Fermi America is seeking a DC Commercial Program Manager. This position sits on Fermi’s Commercial Team, not in the DC construction organization, and serves as the delivery voice inside tenant pursuits. Fermi sells powered land, powered shell, and turnkey data centers, in tenancies measured in hundreds of megawatts and billions of dollars. This role makes sure that what Fermi offers a prospect is something Fermi can actually deliver, at the capacity offered, on the dates offered, under the terms offered, whichever product the deal lands on. Capacity dates, service levels, demarcation of responsibility, and delivery obligations are set during pursuit and negotiation, and they bind for the life of the agreement. This role validates each of those commitments against the delivery plan before Fermi agrees to them. The role works across every active pursuit and the pipeline behind it. It owns the campus capacity and availability position used in commercial conversations, the delivery basis behind each offer, the coordination of technical and lender diligence, and the handoff into the delivery organization once an agreement executes. This role reports to the Head of DC Service \& Delivery and sits within Fermi’s Commercial organization under the Chief Commercial Officer. It works closely with the DC delivery organization, Program Controls, and counsel to assemble and defend the delivery position behind each pursuit. **Key Responsibilities** ------------------------ * Serve as the delivery voice inside tenant pursuits across all three Fermi products, powered land, powered shell, and turnkey, translating prospect requirements into a deliverable posture with the cost, schedule, and risk implications of each * Own the campus capacity and availability position used in commercial conversations, including megawatts by building, energization dates, and uncommitted capacity * Develop and maintain the delivery basis behind every commercial offer, including the schedule basis for a proposed ready\-for\-service date, the assumptions it depends on, and the conditions that would break it * Test proposed commercial terms against delivery reality before they are committed, including capacity dates, service levels, late delivery exposure, access rights, and demarcation, and identify what Fermi cannot credibly meet * Coordinate technical and commercial diligence for prospective tenants and for lender independent engineers, assembling input from technical, controls, construction, and operations * Build and maintain the standard pursuit package, including delivery approach, execution model, organization and staffing plan, schedule basis, and track record * Maintain the pipeline view and its delivery implications, identifying which pursuits would trigger staffing adds, long\-lead procurement, or capacity conflicts if they close * Support lease and agreement negotiation from the delivery side, providing the basis for dates, obligations, and demarcation positions to counsel and the commercial organization, and identifying terms Fermi cannot deliver against before they are agreed * Own the pursuit\-to\-delivery handoff at execution, transferring the commercial commitments, delivery basis, assumptions, and open items to the accountable Director with named owners and dates * Track each active pursuit against the milestones that matter to delivery, including agreement execution, financial close, and notice to proceed, and the lead time each one triggers * Maintain the record of what Fermi has committed across executed agreements, so that new offers are made against remaining capacity and existing obligations * Route tenant technical requirement changes to the DC Sr Technical Manager for the technical position, and assess the commercial and schedule consequence of each * Provide delivery cost and schedule assumptions into commercial pricing models in coordination with Program Controls, so that pricing reflects the current delivery basis * Prepare pursuit and pipeline reporting for the Head of DC Service \& Delivery and the Commercial Team, including status, delivery exposure, and required decisions * Capture lessons from each pursuit, won or lost, and update the standard pursuit package and delivery basis accordingly **AI\-Enabled Execution Philosophy** ------------------------------------ Fermi America integrates artificial intelligence and advanced analytics into its core project delivery workflows. The DC Commercial Program Manager will be expected to embrace and champion this philosophy, including: * Using AI to assemble diligence responses from prior submissions, technical documentation, and the program record * Applying AI\-assisted analysis of tenant requirement documents, requests for proposal, and agreement drafts to identify obligations that carry delivery risk before they are agreed * Leveraging AI\-driven comparison of proposed commercial terms against Fermi’s executed agreements to surface where a new deal diverges from precedent * Supporting a capacity and availability view drawn automatically from schedule and delivery source systems * Using AI to test consistency between commercial offers and the delivery plan of record * Contributing pursuit outcomes and lessons learned into Fermi’s standard pursuit package and delivery basis Requirements: * 12\+ years in commercial operations, solutions engineering, business development support, or program management within data center, energy, or large capital infrastructure, including at least 6 years in the data center industry * Demonstrated experience supporting large customer pursuits from qualification through agreement execution in a role accountable for the delivery position rather than for selling * Fluency across data center product types, including powered land, powered shell, turnkey, and build\-to\-suit, and a working command of how each shifts cost, schedule, and risk between owner and tenant * Ability to interrogate a construction schedule and a capacity plan, and to determine what commitments are credible * Experience coordinating technical and commercial diligence, including customer technical diligence and lender or independent engineer review * Familiarity with lease and services agreement structures, including capacity commitments, service levels, remedies, and demarcation of responsibility * Experience assembling a position across engineering, construction, controls, and operations without holding authority over any of them * Strong executive and customer\-facing communication, credible in front of a prospective tenant and in front of Fermi leadership * Willingness to raise and defend a position that conflicts with commercial objectives, supported by schedule and capacity evidence * Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Construction Management, Business, or related field **Preferred Qualifications** ---------------------------- * Experience on the owner or developer side of hyperscale data center leasing, build\-to\-suit, or colocation * Familiarity with tenant technical requirement sets from hyperscale operators * Experience supporting project finance diligence and what lenders test in an owner’s ability to deliver * Experience with capacity planning and availability management across a multi\-building campus * Working knowledge of Oracle Primavera P6 and enterprise delivery systems * Familiarity with AI\-powered analytics and document review platforms * Comfort operating in a high\-growth organization where the role will help define how pursuits are supported **Work Requirements** --------------------- * This role is based in Dallas or potentially a remote role with up to 60 percent travel, including tenant and partner offices, diligence sessions, industry events, and regular presence at Fermi’s campus in Amarillo, TX * Ability to host and participate in campus tours and site visits with prospective tenants, lenders, and partners, including walking active construction sites * Willingness to wear required personal protective equipment (PPE) including hard hat, safety glasses, high\-visibility vest, steel\-toe boots, and hearing protection when on\-site * Flexibility to work extended hours during pursuit deadlines, diligence windows, and negotiation periods

jobs.title: DevOps Engineer
jobs.description: **Company Overview** Fortastra designs and delivers resilient, high\-performance spacecraft that safeguard critical orbital assets and ensure freedom of action in space. We integrate advanced autonomy, sensing, and control into systems engineered for reliability, speed, and scale. Our culture values simplicity, accountability, and disciplined execution empowering every engineer to think systemically, act decisively, and build with purpose. Aggressive innovation. Disciplined execution. Strength among the stars. **Our Engineering Team** You'll join Fortastra's Engineering Division, working at the intersection of software, cloud infrastructure, and mission security. Our cloud and DevSecOps stack underpins everything from simulation and CI/CD to mission tools, and must be secure, observable, and easy for engineers to use. **The Role** Fortastra is seeking a **DevOps Engineer** with strong cloud and DevSecOps experience to build and operate our CI/CD, container, and cloud platforms. You will focus on reliability, automation, and security, enabling engineers to ship quickly while staying within well defined guardrails. This role is primarily cloud and platform engineering, with security integrated from the start. You will own CI/CD pipelines, container infrastructure, IAM patterns, and environment provisioning in AWS and Azure, working closely with the Cyber Security Engineer to integrate security into workflows. **Key Responsibilities** * Design, build, and maintain CI/CD pipelines within a Git environment such as GitHub, Gitlab, Bitbucket for applications, services, and infrastructure. * Architect and operate container infrastructure, including registries, orchestration, and deployment patterns using docker and kubernetes * Implement and maintain Terraform based infrastructure as code across multi\-cloud tenants. * Lead IAM reorganizations and implement scalable account, role, and permission structures across environments. * Create and onboard new cloud tenants into the existing infrastructure in a secure, standardized way. * Integrate DevSecOps tooling into pipelines, including SAST, DAST, SCA, and container scanning, while optimizing for low friction. * Partner with the Cyber Security Engineer to embed security guardrails into the platform without slowing down engineers. * Act as an enablement engineer for development teams, helping them adopt best practices and use shared platforms effectively. **Qualifications \& Skills** * 5\+ years of hands on DevOps, SRE, or cloud engineering experience, ideally with exposure to security and compliance. * Strong experience with AWS and/or Azure, including environment setup, IAM, networking, and services commonly used in CI/CD and deployment. * Hands on experience with GitLab CI and Terraform. * Experience building and operating container\-based infrastructure. * Exposure to DevSecOps tooling and practices, and interest in working closely with security engineering. * Background in defense, aerospace, or other high assurance environments is a plus. * Steady employment history with evidence of owning and maturing DevOps platforms, rather than short stints. **Why Fortastra** We are a small, high\-impact team building the next generation of autonomous orbital control systems for national security space. At Fortastra, leaders own outcomes from first principles through flight and directly shape the future of resilient, mission\-critical spacecraft autonomy. **FORTASTRA TALENT \& CULTURE PRINCIPLES** **Values Driven by First Principles** We value engineers and operators who prioritize sound judgment, candor, technical rigor, bias for action, and intellectual honesty over corporate consensus. We care about the caliber of the system you build and the speed at which you solve problems. **Talent Density Over Headcount** A high\-performing startup is built on dense talent, not organizational bloat. A single exceptional engineer designs, tests, and delivers faster than a bloated committee. We intentionally maintain a lean, elite engineering crew where every contributor directly moves the needle on the mission. **High Autonomy, High Ownership** We hire domain experts to execute, not to micromanage them. You own your systems end\-to\-end, from initial architecture and hardware design to testing and deployment. With absolute ownership comes the responsibility to deliver mission critical reliability. **Mission Context Over Bureaucracy** The best execution happens when teams are provided clear technical objectives, constraints, and operational context, rather than rigid top\-down policies. We strip away red tape so builders can iterate, make decisions, and push hardware and flight software forward rapidly. **Disciplined Speed \& Flight Rigor** We move fast because we test often and kill artificial bottlenecks, not because we cut corners. Rapid iteration on the test stand and in simulation is how we learn; an uncompromising flight\-readiness bar is how we earn trust. Precision without friction, speed without recklessness. **Direct Impact, Not Career Bureaucracy** You don't come to Fortastra to climb a corporate ladder or manage slide decks; you come to build complex, flight\-ready systems from day one. Growth here is organic, driven by the magnitude of technical challenges you solve and the trust you build across the team. **Benefits** We take care of our employees so they can focus on what matters most: family, well\-being, and life outside of work. **Unlimited Paid Time Off** so that you have the time you need to rest and recharge. **Comprehensive Healthcare:** Medical, dental, and vision coverage for you and your dependents, because peace of mind starts with feeling cared for. **Equity:** Share in Fortastra's success with equity in the company you're helping build. **401(k):** A 401(k) plan to help you invest in your future and plan for what's ahead. **Social Events:** Regular social events, team outings, and company\-sponsored activities that make this a place people are glad to be part of. The pay range for this role is $130,000\.00 \- $170,000\.00\. Where an offer falls within that range depends on factors like your qualifications, experience, location, and interview performance, which we weigh against the market rate for the position. Recruiters \& Agencies: Fortastra does not accept unsolicited resumes or candidate submissions from recruiters, agencies, or third parties. Any candidate submitted without a signed agreement and prior written authorization from Fortastra will not be subject to any fee, and no relationship is implied. Please do not contact Fortastra employees, hiring managers, or recruiting team directly.

jobs.title: Full Stack Engineer
jobs.description: Turbo AI turns anything you upload into bite\-sized lessons that make learning fast and actually fun. 12 million users in less than 2 years. **Turbo Engineering?** You ship a feature in the morning and watch tens of thousands of people use it that afternoon. No PMs, no spec handoffs, no quarterly planning cycle. Engineers own features end\-to\-end: from identifying the problem \-\> brainstorming solutions \-\> implementing it \-\> monitoring user analytics \-\> decide what iterations to make \- you're not just a code monkey. That combination is rare. Most places give you scale with no ownership, or ownership with nobody using the thing. Here you get a small team, real surface area each, and a million people a month on the other end of it. We're highly profitable and growing. Most of this job is judgment and communication. In a world where coding is faster than ever with smarter LLMs everyday, deciding what to build and what to skip, then telling everyone clearly what you're doing and why is the priority. If you can look at a business problem, work out which part actually matters this week, and explain that in a few sentences, you'll do very well here. We continuously optimize for solutions that take 20% of the time for 80% of the value before sinking precious engineering resources into areas. If it can be done in 200 lines with tools we already have, that's the right answer, even if it isn't elegant and even if it needs redoing in three months. Shipping something 80% right today beats something perfect next month. This is the thing we care about most. If your instinct is to build the framework instead of the script, or to handle every edge case before shipping, you'll find this frustrating. * Modern React on web * React Native on mobile * Python and TypeScript servers on the backend * PostgresSQL ' * You've shipped real things that real people used * You default to the simplest solution and can explain why the complicated one isn't worth it * You think about the business, not just the ticket. You can tell which work actually moves the number. * Clear, direct communicator. You write things down and people understand them the first time. * Genuinely fluent with AI coding tools. This isn't a bonus, it's how the whole team works. * Comfortable owning something without being managed * $170k to $260k cash \+ competitive equity * Lunch and dinner in the office every day * Unlimited PTO New York, in person. Everyone here is young, ambitious and moves fast.

jobs.title: Full Stack Software Engineer I
jobs.description: Parallel Systems is pioneering autonomous battery\-electric rail vehicles designed to transform freight transportation by shifting portions of the $900 billion U.S. trucking industry onto rail. Our innovative technology offers cleaner, safer, and more efficient logistics solutions. Join our dynamic team and help shape a smarter, greener future for global freight. **Full Stack Software Engineer I** Parallel Systems is seeking a Software Engineer I to join our Interfaces team. The Interfaces team builds the software people use to operate, monitor, and manage our vehicles and fleet, including our main operator application and the product surfaces that will grow into enterprise customer software. This is a junior role with real ownership. You do not need years of production experience, but you do need high agency, clear communication, and the hunger to learn fast. We care more about how you work than how many years you have been paid to work. **Responsibilities:** * Build and improve the operator and customer product platform in TypeScript, React, and Rust. * Ship features in our Electron operator application. * Work with product and vehicle/systems engineers to turn operational needs into clear, reliable interfaces. * Own features end\-to\-end: understand the user, implement, test, document, and follow through after merge. * Grow into full\-stack product work as we expand enterprise software, including data models, APIs, and the performance and reliability of software that talks to the real world. **What Success Looks Like:** * **After 30 Days:** You've set up your environment, learned how operators use our application, and shipped your first changes to the software platform. You're asking good questions early and building relationships with product and vehicle/systems engineers. * **After 60 Days:** You've owned a feature end\-to\-end, from understanding the operator's need through implementation, testing, documentation, and follow\-through after merge. You're reading and improving code across the Interfaces codebase. * **After 90 Days:** You're a reliable contributor to the operator application, independently identifying and fixing problems without waiting to be assigned. You've started contributing beyond the UI, such as data models, APIs, or performance and reliability improvements for our enterprise software. **Basic Requirements:** * Bachelor's degree in computer science, computer engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience (bootcamp plus portfolio, research, or shipped projects are fine). * Comfortable writing software in TypeScript or Rust and component\-based UI (React or similar). You can read other people's code and leave it better than you found it. * A track record of picking up a new tool, language, or domain and becoming useful with it, whether through a class project, internship, research, open source, or something you built because you wanted it to exist. **Preferred Qualifications:** * Project or professional experience with Rust, React, TypeScript, or Python. * Exposure to desktop wrappers (Electron, Tauri), backend development, or databases. * Coursework or projects touching networks, operating systems, or distributed systems. * Experience pairing with AI coding tools and being honest about what they got wrong. *Parallel Systems is an equal opportunity employer committed to diversity in the workplace. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to any discriminatory factor protected by applicable federal, state or local laws. We work to build an inclusive environment in which all people can come to do their best work.* *Parallel Systems is committed to the full inclusion of all qualified individuals. As part of this commitment, Parallel Systems will ensure that persons with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodations. If reasonable accommodation is needed to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform essential job functions, and/or to receive other benefits and privileges of employment, please contact your recruiter.*

jobs.title: IT STATEWIDE ASSOCIATE ENGINEER 1-4 (DCO/OTS)
jobs.description: Salary Depends on Qualifications Location Baton Rouge, LA Job Type Classified Job Number OTS 092226B ERG Department Division of Administration\-Office of Technology Services Opening Date 09/22/2026 Closing Date 10/2/2026 11:59 PM Central **About this Job** ------------------ The Division of Administration/Office of Technology Services has a vacancy. This position is located in the Data Center Operations Section. Req. 226149 The Office of Technology Services aims to be a responsible partner in delivering innovative, effective, and reliable solutions that support and enhance the IT functions within Executive Branch Departments. The Office of Technology Services will work to increase the return on the State's investment in technology by promoting smart decision\-making, solving problems intelligently, increasing the rate of project success, and fostering a skilled and professional staff. This is a high\-level technical support position requiring the ability to provide technical leadership in the implementation and management of complex messaging and directory services systems. The incumbent will possess advanced, specialized skills in messaging and/or directory services related products. The nature of the work is highly complex and requires a deep understanding of people, processes and technology within the context of a large enterprise and government environment. The incumbent is required to have in\-depth planning, design and analysis skills. The incumbent may be required to coordinate and serve as liaison with multiple vendors for in\-house and outsourced messaging or directory services related initiatives. The Division of Administration is the state government’s management arm and the hub of its financial operations. Division offices perform a wide variety of activities including the following: * Overseeing the state’s capital construction program * Working to provide state and federal grants for community development * Development of the state budget * Providing technology services * Giving agencies guidance in the state purchasing and contracting process as they seek goods and services * Administering a program that provides federal funds to help Louisiana residents recover from a series of devastating hurricanes **Minimum Qualifications** -------------------------- Two years of experience in information technology; OR Six years of full\-time work experience in any field; OR An associate's degree in information technology; OR A bachelor’s degree. EXPERIENCE SUBSTITUTION: Every 30 semester hours earned from an accredited college or university will be credited as one year of experience towards the six years of full\-time work experience in any area. The maximum substitution allowed is 120 semester hours which substitutes for a maximum of four years of experience in any area. NOTE: A certification in an approved area may be substituted for the education and/or experience requirements at the time of hire or promotion, provided the appointment is made from a Certificate of Eligibles. NOTE: Any college hours or degree must be from an accredited college or university. **Job Specification** --------------------- The official job specifications for this role, as defined by the State Civil Service, can be found here. **Job Duties and Other Information** ------------------------------------ Job Duties: * Assumes lead responsibility for the day\-to\-day administration and maintenance of Windows servers for multiple state agencies that are supported by the Division of Administration's Technical Support staff. * Coordinates the installation, maintenance, and modification of vendor\-supplied software for Windows server and related products which is critical to business functions and may require after\-hours scheduling due to extensive availability requirements. * Recommends and implements standards, policies and procedures related to Windows servers for an enterprise server environment. Consults regularly with vendors concerning software and /or hardware problems, resolutions and system performance. * Advises and consults with end\-users, administrators, technical support personnel and consultants, designing and providing documentation, instruction, problem analysis and education pertaining to specific and highly complex areas of software performance. * Assists in the consolidation of all Windows server environments within the scope of the State IT consolidation effort. Provides problem analysis and specialized technical expertise to end\-users, administrators, technical support personnel and management consultants. Mentors lower level team members. Facilitates knowledge transfer and training. * Identifies and analyzes current and future needs and requirements in the area of Windows servers for the Division of Administration and other departments that are supported by OTS Windows Servers staff. Reviews software products and interfaces with vendors as needed. Monitors and updates procedures, documentation, and change ma ns in the field of Information Technology and management. * Performs all other tasks, special projects, analysis, studies, and plans as directed. Position\-Specific Details: **Appointment Type:** This vacancy will be filled by a new hire or by promotion of a current permanent status classified employee. **Career Progression:** This position may be filled as an IT Statewide Associate Engineer 1, 2,3 or 4, depending on the level of experience of the selected applicant. Louisiana is a "State as a Model Employer" for People with Disabilities. How To Apply: **No Civil Service test score** is required in order to be considered for this vacancy. Applicants are responsible for checking the status of their application to determine where they are in the recruitment process. Further status message information is located under the Information section of the Current Job Opportunities page. \*Information to support your eligibility for the position must be included in the application (i.e., relevant, detailed experience/education). Resumes will not be accepted in lieu of completed education and experience sections. Applications may be rejected if incomplete. The transcripts can be added as an attachment to your online application. The selected candidate will be required to submit original documentation upon hire. Prior to a new hire, a background check, including criminal record history, will be conducted. Information from the background check will not necessarily preclude employment, but will be considered in determining the applicant’s suitability and competence to perform in the position. A criminal history check may be conducted on employees changing positions, including promotions, demotions, details, reassignments, and transfers. jobs.title: ML Engineer
jobs.description: Astrocade is an AI technology company building super\-intelligence for the interactive world, delivered through a breakout consumer platform. Today's frontier models can write, reason, and generate video. None can build a world you can step into and act on. Interactive world models are one of the defining problems on the path to ASI, and the foundation of the next great consumer platform. Interactivity is the holy grail of content: not something you watch, but something that responds to you. We're further ahead than anyone: the only team building the intelligence and the platform together, and both are already live. Our social UGC platform lets anyone create and play interactive experiences through natural language. And it's one of the fastest\-growing consumer products in the world, with over 30 million users in just months since launch. Creators bring to life games, companions that remember and grow with them, learning experiences that adapt like a great tutor, and social worlds built with friends. The platform also powers our research with data no video dataset contains: millions of creators prompting and refining gives us paired data of human intent and the worlds that fulfill it, and every play session produces ground\-truth, action\-labeled interaction data at scale. All of it flows back into our models, and research ships to real players in days, spinning a flywheel no one else can build. We are a small team from Google Research, Meta, FAIR, Character.ai, and Stanford, led alongside Fei\-Fei Li, with frontier\-scale compute and direct ownership of core model problems. We are backed by Sequoia Capital, Google, NVIDIA, and luminaries including Eric Schmidt and Jerry Yang. The next foundational AI company will be built where world models meet a billion players. We're the rare place where frontier research and a breakout consumer platform are one company, and where your work ships to millions, not to a paper. Come build it with us. **About the Role** Every experience on Astrocade starts as an idea from a creator. An agentic AI system turns that idea into something playable. How good that experience turns out to be is our north\-star metric. Your job is to move that metric. As an ML Engineer on our AI team, you'll own how our creation system behaves, where it fails, and how it gets better. You'll dig into real creator sessions to find where generation breaks down, build the evals that tell us whether a change actually helped, and design the agentic systems behind the next version of creation on the platform. This is applied ML with a direct line to product. What you ship shows up in the games millions of players see. We're a small team of about 20 engineers, and nobody here stays in a lane. You'll work across models, agents, data pipelines, and infrastructure as the problem requires, and you'll collaborate directly with our CTO and co\-founders. **What You'll Do** * Own the quality of AI\-generated content end to end, including model behavior, agent orchestration, prompting, tool use, and the failure modes in between * Build evaluation and insight systems on production creator data that measure failure rates, quality, and where the system is strong or weak, and turn those findings into concrete improvements * Design and build agentic ML systems that take a creator's idea and reliably produce a great, playable game * Debug hard problems across the stack, from a bad generation down to the data, the model, or the pipeline that caused it * Run experiments quickly, measure rigorously, and ship what works * Help define how the AI team works as it grows, including tooling, eval standards, and technical direction **You'd Be a Great Fit If You:** * Have 3–7\+ years of experience in ML engineering or applied ML, with a track record of shipping models or AI systems to real users * Have built LLM\-powered or agentic systems in productionTreat evals as a core part of the job: you've designed metrics and eval sets and know when a number is lying to you * Have strong CS fundamentals and write clean, efficient code (Python\-heavy) * Reason well about probability and statistics, and are comfortable being tested on it * Are a builder with high agency and a bias for action, and want to own outcomes rather than tickets * Have played with Astrocade and have opinions about what the content should be **Bonus Points** * Background in code generation, program synthesis, or LLM\-for\-code * Experience at a fast\-moving AI startup, or on applied ML teams at large consumer companies * Interest in games, UGC, or creator platforms * Exposure to post\-training or fine\-tuning, and a sense of when it beats better prompting and orchestration **What we Offer** ================= * Competitive salary, meaningful equity, and performance bonus. * 100% employer\-paid medical, dental, and vision insurance for employees and eligible dependents. * Flexible PTO and unlimited sick time. * **$650/month AI Tools budget** to use on the tools that help you do your best work. * **$500/month Lifestyle Benefit** for wellness, fitness, meals, house cleaning, and more. * **$200/month Fun Benefit** to spend on hobbies, travel, games, concerts, or whatever brings you joy. * Up to **16 weeks paid parental leave** for birth parents and **12 weeks** for non\-birth parents, plus a **$1,500/month childcare benefit**. * **$2,000 workspace setup allowance** and **$200/month commuter benefit**. * Daily breakfast, lunch, and dinner on in\-office days, plus regular team events and offsites. * 401(k) retirement plan through Human Interest. Join us to help build the future of interactive entertainment! Compensation Range: $200K \- $250K

jobs.title: Senior Machine Learning Engineer, Computer Vision
jobs.description: **About Sonari** Sonari is a well\-funded startup and the world's first company to deploy AI\-powered ultrasound imaging in professional sports, turning a fast, portable scan into objective data on an athlete's tissue health, performance, and endurance over time. Our ultimate goal is to predict and prevent soft\-tissue and non\-contact injuries. Our technology is grounded in peer\-reviewed research. We're backed by a global investment firm ($70B\+ AUM), and we're already in partnership with a Major League Baseball team and a Premier League club. Our aim is to put this capability in the hands of every sports organization in the world, from championship rosters to the academies where the next generation is coming up. We're mission\-driven and looking for like\-minded top engineers who want to build at the intersection of AI, medical imaging and sports. **Your role:** You own the **models and the measurements**: you train the AI models that run on the device and in the cloud, and you build the analysis services that convert ultrasound images and clips into validated quantitative metrics that track athlete performance and injury risk. You'll work in a fast\-paced, hands\-on environment, reporting directly to the CTO. This role spans two parts of the system: * **The Model Factory (offline):** the training pipeline. Move data to and from the labeling platform, preprocess, train, evaluate, and package new metrics models, then ship them back to the edge and the analysis services with full provenance. * **The Analysis Services (online):** the inference/measurement services that take an exam's images or clips and produce segmentation masks, geometry, and the derived athlete metrics — both on the edge and in the cloud backend. *Scope note:* this is a wide surface for one person \- model training and productionized inference. We're hiring for someone comfortable owning both early, with the expectation that a second ML/MLOps hire follows. If your strength is decisively one side, tell us \- we'd rather place you well. **What you'll work on:** * **Image \& video processing.** Build robust image\- and video\-processing pipelines over **DICOM and raw imagery** — still frames and clips — including physical calibration so measurements come out in real\-world units. * **Segmentation \& measurement models.** Train and refine segmentation models of musculoskeletal anatomy in ultrasound, and derive the athlete metrics from their geometry — the numbers that end up on a team's dashboard. * **Navigation models for the edge.** Train the on\-device models that recognize views, score image quality, and produce initial segmentation to guide capture — then package them to run on\-device (e.g. CoreML) in the navigation app. * **The labeling loop, with the clinical team.** Own the round\-trip with the labeling/annotation platform: push de\-identified images to be labeled, pull labels back, and land them in the platform's single canonical **annotation schema** (in\-app clinician annotations and platform labels share that schema — you consume both). Work closely with the clinical team to define and continually refine what gets labeled, how, and to what quality bar, so the training data stays consistent and clinically meaningful. * **Reproducibility \& provenance.** Stamp every model with a version \+ provenance record so any metric traces back to the model that produced it, and maintain the evaluation / regression harness that qualifies a model before it ships. * **Data governance in practice.** Work only with de\-identified data; honor consent gating on the training stream; keep athlete\-identifying information out of everything you touch. Required skills * Strong **Python** and the scientific stack: **NumPy, SciPy, OpenCV, scikit\-image, scikit\-learn**. * **Deep learning for computer vision**, hands\-on: **TensorFlow / Keras** and/or **PyTorch**; semantic segmentation (U\-Net\-style) and/or object detection (YOLO\-style) on images. * Solid ML engineering fundamentals: reproducible training, evaluation metrics (e.g. Dice/IoU for segmentation), regression testing, and reasoning about model quality and failure modes. * Data discipline: you treat de\-identification, consent, and provenance as first\-class requirements, not afterthoughts. Nice to have * Experience with **medical / scientific imaging** — e.g. DICOM, physical calibration, and turning pixels into real\-world units. * **Sports science, musculoskeletal, or physiology** domain experience. * Model **deployment to constrained runtimes** — CoreML for iOS, or ONNX. * Experience with **labeling / annotation platforms** and building label round\-trip pipelines. * Image\-stitching / geometric processing. * MLOps: training reproducibility, model registries, GPU scheduling, containerized inference. * Experience with **transformer\-based or foundation\-model approaches** to segmentation (e.g. SAM and its medical variants). * Awareness of clinical\-software constraints (data handling, regulatory pathways) — depth here is a plus, not a requirement; we retain regulatory specialists separately. Tech stack you'll touch Python · TensorFlow / Keras · PyTorch · OpenCV · scikit\-image · scikit\-learn · pydicom · SimpleITK · a labeling / annotation platform · cloud object storage · on\-device packaging (CoreML) · Docker · a Python web framework for the analysis services · a shared JSON\-Schema\-based annotation contract. How this role fits the team You'll be key member of our engineering team. The **Mobile iOS Engineer** ships the models you package into the capture app; the **Full\-stack Engineer** runs the platform that stores your training data, dispatches your analysis jobs, and displays your metrics. You'll define the model↔platform seam together, working against shared, versioned contracts rather than ad\-hoc handoffs. Pay: $160,000\.00 \- $220,000\.00 per year Benefits: * Dental insurance * Health insurance * Vision insurance Work Location: Hybrid remote in Cambridge, MA 02142

This is a rare opportunity to shape a practice and a culture from day one, on a platform where every order, quote, and position has to be right, because real client capital is on the line. **What jobs.title: Software Engineer I
jobs.description: Software Engineer I : **APPLY at**: **https://virnous.com/careers/** Department: Engineering Reports to: Director of Engineering / Chief Technology Officer Employment type: Full\-time Level: Entry level (1 to 3 years of experience) Position Summary Virnous builds software for the people who work criminal cases: detectives, crime analysts, and prosecutors. Our main product, CANDOR, takes the raw data that shows up in a modern investigation, such as phone carrier records, cell site location information (CSLI), device extractions, and social media returns, and turns it into maps, timelines, and reports that an investigator can use and defend in court. We also build a public tip line, a training platform, and CANDOR Edge, a self\-contained version of CANDOR for agencies whose data can’t leave their building. As a Software Engineer I, you’ll be working on real features and bug fixes from your first few weeks. Most of our code is Ruby on Rails and PostgreSQL, with a good amount of JavaScript on the front end. You’ll get code review, pairing, and plenty of room to ask questions. In return, we need you to be careful. The files our customers upload are evidence, and what our software shows them can end up in front of a jury. Getting it right matters more to us than getting it done fast. Key Duties \& Responsibilities Build and maintain features across CANDOR and our other Rails applications, from the database migration through the view, along with the tests that cover them. Write and improve the importers that read what investigators bring us: carrier call detail records, tower lists, spreadsheets, PDFs, and phone extraction reports. These files are often messy, and carriers change their formats without telling anyone**.\* Track down bugs reported by customers and our support team. Reproduce the problem, find the real cause, fix it, and add a test that would have caught it. Work on the front end with Hotwire (Turbo and Stimulus) and plain JavaScript, including maps, timelines, and charts that sometimes have to draw hundreds of thousands of records. Write and maintain automated tests, and help keep the CI pipeline passing. Help move code from development to test to production, and keep an eye on it after it goes live. Work with our support staff and investigators, many of whom come from law enforcement, to learn how the software is used on real cases. Use AI coding tools as part of your daily work, and review what they produce as closely as you would review a teammate’s pull request**.\* Update documentation and runbooks when you change how something works. What You’ll Work With * Ruby 3\.x and Rails 8, with Hotwire (Turbo and Stimulus), import maps, and Solid Queue for background jobs. PostgreSQL, S3\-compatible object storage, and Apache Arrow for large datasets. JavaScript with D3, deck.gl, Google Maps, and Sigma.js for maps, charts, and link\-analysis graphs. Minitest and Capybara for application tests, and Playwright with TypeScript for end\-to\-end tests. Docker, Kubernetes, Jenkins, and Ansible for builds and deployments. Self\-hosted language models (vLLM, Ollama, and LiteLLM) that run features like our Ask Sarge assistant. Required Qualifications * 1 to 3 years of professional experience building web applications. A strong internship or co\-op can count toward this. Working knowledge of a server\-side web framework. Rails is ideal, but if you know Django, Laravel, Express, or something similar, you can pick up Rails here. Comfortable writing SQL and working with a relational database, preferably PostgreSQL. Solid fundamentals in JavaScript, HTML, and CSS. Everyday comfort with Git: commits, pull requests, and resolving merge conflicts. The habit of writing tests as part of the work, not after it. A methodical approach to debugging: read the logs, form a theory, check it, and say so plainly when you don’t know yet. Clear writing. You’ll write tickets, commit messages, and explanations for people who aren’t engineers. Good judgment and discretion with sensitive information. Our customers trust us with active criminal case data. Ability to pass a criminal background check. Preferred Qualifications * Experience with Ruby on Rails, especially Rails 7 or 8 and Hotwire. Experience with Docker. Exposure to Kubernetes, Jenkins, or another CI/CD system is a plus. Experience parsing and cleaning messy real\-world data in CSV, Excel, XML, JSON, or PDF form. Familiarity with geospatial data (coordinates, bearings, distance math) or with charting and mapping libraries like D3 or deck.gl. Curiosity about how large language models and retrieval\-augmented generation (RAG) work in practice. We run our own models in\-house. Any exposure to digital forensics, cellular networks, or the criminal justice system. It isn’t required. We’ll teach you the domain. Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience. *This job description outlines the general nature and level of work performed and is not intended to be an exhaustive list of all responsibilities, duties, and skills required. Duties may be modified at any time based on business needs.* Pay: $60,742\.41 \- $106,872\.57 per year Benefits: * Dental insurance * Health insurance Work Location: Hybrid remote in Phoenix, AZ 85016

jobs.description: Join ABC Fitness and become part of a culture that’s as ambitious as it is authentic. Let’s transform the future of fitness—together! maintain visual comparison tooling (e.g., Applitools, Percy, Playwright visual comparisons, or similar) integrated into CI/CD pipelines. * Define baseline management standards, screenshot comparison strategies, and tolerance thresholds for visual diffs across browsers and device viewports. * Partner with frontend engineers and designers to ensure visual test coverage aligns with design system standards and accessibility requirements. * Drive adoption of visual testing as a first\-class quality gate within the software delivery lifecycle. **DORA Metrics \& Engineering Excellence** * Lead jobs.description: **Powering the world’s payments ecosystem** ACI powers the payments ecosystem – globally, and you power ACI. You’ll innovate, collaborate, and grow – in an energetic technology culture with decades of proven success. ACIers – in all roles and levels – are truly your colleagues and many are your friends. Our size and reach allow you to see the global impact of your work. You are visible, your talents are valued, and you are empowered to shape the future of payments. As a **Sr Systems Engineer** in **Norcross, GA or Omaha,, NE** , you will join a diverse, passionate team, dedicated to powering the world’s payments ecosystem! ### **Position Summary:** We are seeking a highly skilled and motivated **Senior Systems Engineer** to support and enhance our enterprise payment systems. The ideal candidate will have hands\-on experience with **IBM WebSphere** , **COBOL** , **AIX** , **Linux** , and the **MTS payments platform** , and will be responsible for maintaining application stability, implementing enhancements, and collaborating with cross\-functional teams to deliver high\-quality solutions. ### **Key Responsibilities:** * Support, maintain, and enhance applications running on the **MTS payments platform** . * Develop and troubleshoot **COBOL** programs and batch jobs in a high\-volume transaction environment. * Manage and deploy applications using **IBM WebSphere Application Server** . * Perform system administration tasks on **AIX** and **Linux** servers related to application support. * Collaborate with infrastructure, security, and development teams to ensure system reliability and compliance. * Participate in incident management and root cause analysis for production issues. * Document technical processes, configurations, and procedures. * Assist in planning and executing application upgrades and migrations. * Monitor application performance and implement tuning strategies. ### **Required Qualifications:** * Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, or related field (or equivalent experience). * 5\+ years of experience in application engineering or software development. * Strong proficiency in **COBOL** and experience with legacy systems. * Hands\-on experience with **IBM WebSphere Application Server** . * Solid understanding of **AIX** and **Linux** operating systems. * Experience working with the **MTS payments platform** or similar transaction processing systems. * Familiarity with scripting languages (e.g., Shell, Perl) and job scheduling tools. * Strong problem\-solving and analytical skills. * Excellent communication and collaboration abilities. ### **Preferred Qualifications:** * Experience in financial services or payment processing environments. * Knowledge of DevOps practices and CI/CD pipelines. Familiarity with ITIL processes and service management tools. * *Applicants* ***must be currently authorized to work in the United States*** *on a full\-time basis. This position* ***does not offer sponsorship*** *for employment visa status or work permit now or in the future.* I n return for your expertise, we offer opportunities for growth, career development, and a competitive compensation and benefits package—all within an innovative and collaborative work environment. Are you ready to help us transform the payments ecosystem? To learn more about ACI Worldwide, visit our web site at **www.aciworldwide.com** Job ID **(Requisition \#19861\)** *ACI Worldwide is an AA/EEO employer in the United States, which includes providing equal opportunity for protected veterans and individuals with disabilities, and an EEO employer globally.* **Important Notice About Recruitment Scams** Job seekers should be aware of ongoing recruitment scams where individuals or organizations impersonate legitimate companies to offer fake job opportunities. These scams often involve requests for personal information, payments, or interviews through unofficial channels. Please be cautious and verify any communications claiming to be from our company ( www.aciworldwide.com / @aciworldwide.com). The ACI Worldwide recruitment team will always follow official channels and will never request payment. *\#LI\-LF1* *\#LI\-Hybrid* ACI Worldwide is a global leader in mission\-critical, real\-time payments software . Our proven, secure and scalable software solutions enable leading corporations, fintechs and financial disruptors to process and manage digital payments , power omni\-commerce payments , present and process bill payments , and manage fraud and risk . We combine our global footprint with a local presence to drive the real\-time digital transformation of payments and commerce.

jobs.title: Team Lead, Software Engineer - Data
jobs.description: If you are looking for a career at a dynamic company with a people\-first mindset and a deep culture of growth and autonomy, ACV is the right place for you! Competitive compensation packages and learning and development opportunities, ACV has what you need to advance to the next level in your career. We will continue to raise the bar every day by investing in our people and technology to help our customers succeed. We hire people who share our passion, bring innovative ideas to the table, and enjoy a collaborative atmosphere. **Who we are:** ACV is a technology company that has revolutionized how dealers buy and sell cars online. We are transforming the automotive industry. ACV Auctions Inc. (ACV), has applied innovation and user\-designed, data driven applications and solutions. We are building the most trusted and efficient digital marketplace with data solutions for sourcing, selling and managing used vehicles with transparency and comprehensive insights that were once unimaginable. We are disruptors of the industry and we want you to join us on our journey. At ACV we focus on the Health, Physical, Financial, Social and Emotional Wellness of our Teammates and, to support this, we offer: * Multiple medical plans including a high deductible, low cost health plan * Company\-sponsored (paid) Short\-Term Disability, Long\-Term Disability, and Life Insurance * Comprehensive optional benefits such as Dental, Vision, Supplemental Life/AD\&D, Legal/ID Protection, and Accident and Critical Illness Insurance * Generous paid time off options, including uncapped vacation days, the greater of 3 paid sick days or in accordance with the applicable state or local paid sick leave law, 6 paid company holidays, 2 floating holidays, parental leave, bereavement leave, jury duty leave, voting leave, and other forms of paid leave as required by applicable law or regulation * Employee Stock Purchase Program with additional opportunities to earn stock in the Company * Retirement planning through the Company’s 401(k) **Who are we looking for:** We are looking for an exceptional Team Lead, Software Engineer to lead, architect, and elevate our engineering team. We need a leader who thrives in a fast\-paced, collaborative environment and is passionate about solving complex technical challenges. The ideal candidate has a strong foundation in software development, database design, multi\-cloud environments, and in\-memory data technologies. You bring deep technical expertise in software development, demonstrate strong communication and collaboration skills, and embrace a hands\-on, problem\-solving mindset to tackle ACV’s most challenging data engineering problems. In this dual\-impact role, you will serve as a senior technical authority while directly managing and mentoring a team of talented software engineers. You will bridge the gap between high\-level business strategy and technical execution, ensuring your team ships high\-quality, scalable software while fostering an environment of continuous growth and collaboration. If you are passionate about solving complex architectural challenges and are equally invested in developing the careers of those around you, this is the perfect opportunity. This is a hands on keyboard and team lead/manager role. **What you will do:** * Directly manage a small team of software engineers responsible for VIN Decoder domain, owning their performance, growth, and day\-to\-day engagement. * Conduct regular 1:1s, provide actionable and constructive feedback, and map out clear career progression paths for your direct reports. * Cultivate a collaborative, inclusive, and psychologically safe team culture where engineers are empowered to innovate and take ownership. * Provide technical leadership through mentoring, coaching, and strong design/code review feedback, helping raise overall engineering quality. * Facilitate effective communication across engineering, product, and business teams to ensure alignment and successful delivery. * Actively participate in feature development, code reviews, and technical problem\-solving across the team's core services. * Own scrum agile methodologies within the team. Facilitate and lead core Agile ceremonies including sprint planning, daily stand\-ups, backlog grooming/refinement, sprint reviews, and retrospectives. * Drive the technical vision for your team’s domain, making critical decisions on multi\-cloud infrastructure, in\-memory technologies, and overall system architecture. * Drive predictable execution against team commitments, balancing delivery, quality, and operational excellence. * Establish clear priorities, roadmaps, and execution plans aligned with organizational objectives. * Monitor and improve key engineering and business metrics related to system reliability, delivery performance, and customer outcomes. * Ensure software solutions are secure, scalable, maintainable, and aligned with ACV engineering standards. * Architect, develop, and maintain robust Python backend services operating seamlessly across a complex multi\-cloud infrastructure. * Partner closely with Product Managers to define technical roadmaps, scope projects, translate epics into actionable user stories, and deliver features on time. * Foster a culture of ownership, accountability, collaboration, and continuous improvement. * Identify technical, operational, and delivery risks and proactively drive mitigation plans. * Collaborate with engineering leaders across ACV to improve development practices, operational processes, and platform capabilities. * You will need to maintain standard Eastern Time (ET) working hours to ensure seamless collaboration with your team and direct reports * Participate in on\-call rotation * Other duties as assigned. **What you will need:** * Ability to read, write, speak and understand English. * Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field (or equivalent work experience) * 0–2 years of people management experience preferred, including mentoring, developing engineers, and running effective Agile/sprint ceremonies * 5\+ years hands\-on production experience programming in Python preferred * 2\-4\+ years of experience working with Terraform/Infrastructure as Code concepts * 3\-5 years of active experience building, maintaining, and optimizing automated pipelines * 2\-4 years of hands\-on experience applying domain driven design principles to architect and build complex systems * Experience architecting and designing systems from the ground up, including making pragmatic decisions for scalability, reliability, and maintainability. * Experience with in\-memory data processing, database monitoring and diagnostic tools, preferably DataDog. * Strong experience integrating 3rd\-party APIs, implementing authentication \& authorization and developing asynchronous data flows. * Strong experience developing unit and integration\-tests, and setting expectations for test strategy and coverage * Strong communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to work effectively in a fast paced global team environment. * Deep practical experience operating within and leading Agile development environments, with a strong understanding of how to run effective sprints and agile ceremonies Our Values Trust \& Transparency \| People First \| Positive Experiences \| Calm Persistence \| Never Settling At ACV, we are committed to an inclusive culture in which every individual is welcomed and empowered to celebrate their true selves. We achieve this by fostering a work environment of acceptance and understanding that is free from discrimination. ACV is committed to being an equal opportunity employer regardless of sex, race, creed, color, religion, marital status, national origin, age, pregnancy, sexual orientation, gender, gender identity, gender expression, genetic information, disability, military status, status as a veteran, or any other protected characteristic. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements. If you have a disability or special need that requires reasonable accommodation, please let us know. For information on our collection and use of your personal information, please see our Privacy Notice. No immigration or work visa sponsorship provided for this position. **Compensation:** The compensation range for this position is listed in the "Job Details" section at the bottom of this posting. Please note that final compensation will be determined based upon the applicant's relevant experience, skill set, location, business needs, market demands, and other factors as permitted by law.

jobs.title: Responsible AI Review Program Manager
jobs.description: * **We're considering candidates based in the United States**, **and those who have the ability to work in the U.S. without any type of visa sponsorship. Please note that we offer W2 employment and benefits to individuals located in Washington state or Texas. Candidates located in any other state would be operating as a 1099 contractor. This individual must also be comfortable working PST hours** **Work Location Flexibility:** Currently, this role provides the option for remote work; however, flexibility from our consultants is crucial for both our team and clients. Our project activities are dictated by client requirements, which, at times, might necessitate in\-person collaboration. Should a client’s onsite or return\-to\-office policy evolve, consultants must comply with those expectations. We strive to offer as much advance notice and assistance as possible in such circumstances that arise.**\*** **As a Responsible AI Review PM for AG Consulting Partners, a typical day might include the following:** * Reviewing Responsible AI (RAI) Impact Assessments and providing clear, actionable feedback based on HR Divisional Lead guidance and internal Responsible AI standards. * Evaluating AI\-enabled systems, agents, and third\-party technology implementations and making initial recommendations for approval or rejection, supported by compliance documentation and oversight. * Analyzing associated system deliverables (such as post\-launch support plans, monitoring documents, and scope outlines) to ensure alignment with Responsible AI policies and best practices, such as fairness monitoring, human\-in\-the\-loop safeguards, and abuse prevention. * Tracking engagement status and updates in the HR RAI Program Case Management Tool to ensure ongoing visibility and accountability across initiatives * Responding to inquiries from stakeholders across HR and the Responsible AI, Privacy, Legal, and Data Governance teams, offering thoughtful guidance and fostering a culture of ethical AI development. * Navigating complex or ambiguous compliance scenarios by driving clarity, prompting stakeholders to think analytically, and recommending risk\-aware, scalable solutions—grounded in Responsible AI principles and policy expectations. * Collaborating cross\-functionally with peers across the HR RAI team, the Office of Responsible AI, and other compliance functions to align on strategy and maintain high standards of AI governance throughout the lifecycle—from intake through post\-deployment monitoring. * Applying project management best practices—balancing strategic thinking with attention to detail, ensuring strong communication, and proactively addressing blockers or risks * Quickly developing subject matter expertise on evolving AI compliance requirements by engaging with internal documentation, prior case reviews, and team mentorship. * Educating technical and non\-technical stakeholders about Responsible AI standards to ensure thorough documentation and compliance. * Identifying new Responsible AI risk areas and proactively flagging potential issues to the HR Division Lead. **This job is for you if:** * You’re energized by reviewing AI use cases and impact assessments, identifying gaps, and helping teams interpret Responsible AI compliance requirements with clarity. * You’re detail\-oriented and analytical, with a strong risk\-based mindset and the ability to think critically about how AI systems, algorithms, and agents impact people, processes, and outcomes. * You thrive in fast\-paced environments with lots of ambiguity and enjoy working independently while still being highly collaborative. * You’re a natural communicator who can clearly present your point of view and influence stakeholders across legal, engineering, HR, and leadership teams. * You love building and improving processes, from tracking program engagement to evaluating post\-launch support, monitoring, and oversight plans. * You learn quickly, ask great questions, and aren’t afraid to say “I’ll find out” when something is outside your expertise. * You’re passionate about ethical and responsible AI and want to play a role in helping teams develop AI solutions that are transparent, fair, and accountable. **Requirements** **You have:** * **5\+ years of experience in compliance, privacy, security, or AI risk governance.** * Demonstrated experience **reviewing AI assessments, applications, or technology deployments** to determine compliance with internal or external policies. * Proven ability to **interpret compliance requirements** and clarify ambiguous or emerging AI guidance. * Strong **project management skills**, including strategic thinking, attention to detail, and ability to manage timelines and cross\-functional deliverables. * Excellent **written and verbal communication** skills; ability to influence cross\-functional stakeholders and present findings clearly and credibly. * **Analytical mindset** with a risk\-based approach to problem\-solving. * Ability to **evaluate AI capabilities and potential misuses or unsupported uses**, and prompt system owners or stakeholders to think critically. * **Quick learner** who can **independently ramp up** on AI concepts, documentation, and technical or regulatory guidelines. * Comfortable working independently and managing priorities in a **fast\-paced, ambiguous environment**. * Strong sense of **curiosity, adaptability, and a collaborative working style**. * Ability to **leverage past compliance experience** to handle changing requirements effectively **You might also have:** * Experience working with or within **global technology companies** in a similar compliance, privacy, or AI governance function, either as a technologist, engineer, attorney, or compliance specialist. * Familiarity with **Responsible AI frameworks** (e.g., EU AI Act, U.S. NIST AI RMF), data protection practices (e.g. GDPR, CCPA), or regulatory expectations related to AI. * Exposure to **HR systems or processes**, particularly as they relate to AI governance, data ethics, or employee trust. **Benefits** **About Us** AG Consulting Partners, Inc. is a Redmond\-based boutique consulting firm. Our mission is to embrace the entrepreneurial spirit to relentlessly deliver an exceptional experience and results for our people and our clients. We take care of our people. Our excellent benefits to full\-time employees include competitive salary, medical, dental, vision, PTO, 401k matching, education reimbursement, wellness allowances, community and philanthropic events, and flexible career paths. See what our employees have to say about our company Working at AG Consulting Partners \| Glassdoor We’re humbled to be consistently acknowledged by local and national organizations for our success, including Consulting Magazine, Puget Sound Business Journal, and Inc. 5000\. We look forward to welcoming you to our team of amazing consultants and partners! Learn more about our firm at https://agconsultingpartners.com **Note: Applicants must be authorized to work for any employer in the U.S. We are unable to provide assistance or sponsorship for employment Visas and Visa extensions at this time.** **The compensation for this position is tailored to reflect your unique skill set, relevant experience, and the current dynamics of the job market. We strive to ensure that our compensation package is competitive and fair, taking into account various factors to provide a rewarding opportunity for our team members.** **The annual salary range for this role is: 115,000 \- 130,000 in addition to our comprehensive benefits package for our W2 employees. 1099 contractors are subject to a different salary band, upon discussion.**

jobs.title: Process Engineer
jobs.description: Location: Exton, PA, US, 19341 Business Unit: FARO Creaform Posting Date: Sep 24, 2026 Job Description: **With FARO CREAFORM, possibility takes form.** We give quality teams, production teams, maintenance teams, and designers the certainty to manufacture and design like never before — transforming 3D measurements into smarter decisions and endless possibilities. ***We believe that if it can be dreamed it can also be measured. And if it can be measured, it can also be realized.*** We are seeking a **Process Engineer**, for our Process Engineering team located in the Exton, PA area. **The Salary range for the position is $80,000 \- $100,000\.** **How you will make a difference @ FARO Creaform:** * Support product development initiatives into manufacturing processes through NPD process by completing various manufacturing related tasks such as, Design for Manufacturing (DFM), validation protocols and workflow improvements. components and screens for migration complexity, define native module and screen replacement patterns, and set the technical standard the rest of the Android team follows during the transition. * business problems into scalable technical solutions and communicate effectively with both technical and non\-technical stakeholders. **Required Qualifications:** * Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Systems Engineering, or a related technical discipline. * **8\+ years** of software engineering experience with strong Android development expertise. * Deep proficiency in Kotlin and modern Android frameworks, with Jetpack Compose preferred. * Working knowledge of React Native sufficient to assess existing React Native code, plan a native migration, and bridge between React Native and native modules during a phased transition. * Strong experience with mobile architecture patterns, modularization, and large\-scale app development. * Experience with CI/CD pipelines, Gradle optimization, and mobile observability tools. * Solid understanding of API design, performance tuning, and secure mobile development. * Proven track record of technical leadership and cross\-team influence. * Strong collaboration skills, with the ability to work effectively across a globally distributed engineering team spanning the US, Spain, and India. **Preferred** * Direct experience
