jobs.title: Partner Manager, Microsoft Co-sell
jobs.description: **About Anthropic** ------------------- Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems. **About the role** ------------------ Claude is available to enterprises through Microsoft Foundry, and the Microsoft partnership has become one of our most important paths to market. Many of the largest enterprises in financial services, healthcare and life sciences, and the public sector buy Microsoft first, and we want Claude to be the obvious choice when they do. As Partner Manager for Microsoft Co\-Sell, you will turn that partnership into pipeline and closed revenue. You will build and run joint sales plays with Microsoft's field organization, connect Anthropic account executives with their Microsoft counterparts on shared target accounts, and make sure deals that start in a co\-sell conversation actually close through Azure Marketplace. You will own your work end to end, from the details of a single stuck deal to the executive readout on how the partnership is performing. **Key responsibilities** ------------------------ * Own the co\-sell engine day to day: design joint sales plays with Microsoft around the strongest enterprise use cases, run account mapping with Microsoft sellers, and turn introductions into working groups and joint opportunities that show up as pipeline * Keep deals moving through Azure Marketplace, including private offers, billing setup, and partner attribution; track every opportunity through that process, know where it is stuck and who needs to act, and work with both sides until it closes * Run the regular pipeline and escalation rhythm with Microsoft * Give Anthropic and Microsoft leaders a clear view of what is working and what is blocked * Bring field insight back to our product and go\-to\-market teams * Own at least one major joint initiative with Microsoft, such as a flagship event, a product workstream, or deal operations **Minimum qualifications** -------------------------- * Experience owning a revenue or pipeline number through a partner or co\-sell motion, with results you can point to * Working knowledge of how enterprise deals transact through a cloud marketplace, including hands\-on experience unblocking stuck deals * Strong attention to detail and operational rigor, with the ability to turn that detail into a clear, concise story for executives * A record of taking full ownership of your work: closing loops and keeping stakeholders informed proactively * Ability to keep a stalled deal or program moving through repeated blockers until it is resolved * Ability to build trust across a large, matrixed partner organization, with field sellers and their leaders alike **Preferred qualifications** ---------------------------- * Experience selling or partnering around AI, ML, or developer platform products * Direct experience with Microsoft's partner ecosystem, such as Partner Center, Azure Marketplace, and the co\-sell program * Experience selling into financial services, healthcare and life sciences, or the public sector The annual compensation range for this role is listed below. For sales roles, the range provided is the role’s On Target Earnings ("OTE") range, meaning that the range includes both the sales commissions/sales bonuses target and annual base salary for the role. Annual Salary: $215,000 \- $300,000 USD **Logistics** ------------- **Minimum education:** Bachelor’s degree or an equivalent combination of education, training, and/or experience **Required field of study:** A field relevant to the role as demonstrated through coursework, training, or professional experience **Minimum years of experience:** Years of experience required will correlate with the internal job level requirements for the position **Location\-based hybrid policy:** Currently, we expect all staff to be in one of our offices at least 25% of the time. However, some roles may require more time in our offices. **Visa sponsorship:** We do sponsor visas! However, we aren't able to successfully sponsor visas for every role and every candidate. But if we make you an offer, we will make every reasonable effort to get you a visa, and we retain an immigration lawyer to help with this. **We encourage you to apply even if you do not believe you meet every single qualification.** Not all strong candidates will meet every single qualification as listed. Research shows that people who identify as being from underrepresented groups are more prone to experiencing imposter syndrome and doubting the strength of their candidacy, so we urge you not to exclude yourself prematurely and to submit an application if you're interested in this work. We think AI systems like the ones we're building have enormous social and ethical implications. We think this makes representation even more important, and we strive to include a range of diverse perspectives on our team. **Your safety matters to us.** To protect yourself from potential scams, remember that Anthropic recruiters only contact you from @anthropic.com email addresses. In some cases, we may partner with vetted recruiting agencies who will identify themselves as working on behalf of Anthropic. Be cautious of emails from other domains. Legitimate Anthropic recruiters will never ask for money, fees, or banking information before your first day. If you're ever unsure about a communication, don't click any links—visit anthropic.com/careers directly for confirmed position openings. **How we're different** ----------------------- We believe that the highest\-impact AI research will be big science. At Anthropic we work as a single cohesive team on just a few large\-scale research efforts. And we value impact — advancing our long\-term goals of steerable, trustworthy AI — rather than work on smaller and more specific puzzles. We view AI research as an empirical science, which has as much in common with physics and biology as with traditional efforts in computer science. We're an extremely collaborative group, and we host frequent research discussions to ensure that we are pursuing the highest\-impact work at any given time. As such, we greatly value communication skills. The easiest way to understand our research directions is to read our recent research. This research continues many of the directions our team worked on prior to Anthropic, including: GPT\-3, Circuit\-Based Interpretability, Multimodal Neurons, Scaling Laws, AI \& Compute, Concrete Problems in AI Safety, and Learning from Human Preferences. **Come work with us!** ---------------------- Anthropic is a public benefit corporation headquartered in San Francisco. We offer competitive compensation and benefits, optional equity donation matching, generous vacation and parental leave, flexible working hours, and a lovely office space in which to collaborate with colleagues. **Guidance on Candidates' AI Usage:** Learn about our policy for using AI in our application process.

jobs.title: Software Engineer - Generative UI, Input Experience
jobs.description: Most interfaces are designed months before anyone uses them. We're building the ones that aren't \- interfaces composed on demand, in response to what someone asked for, or what they're about to need. The biggest decisions are still ahead: what the frameworks look like, where the runtime boundary sits, how we tell a good generated interface from a bad one. You'd be making them \- working out how to meet the craft and polish people expect from Apple without giving up the range and surprise that make generative UI exciting. **Description** As one of the first engineers on a newly formed team, you will partner directly with Apple's design studio and AI teams to invent this paradigm. You'll help set the technical direction, shape the team's culture, and establish the bar for our engineering. One half of the job is interface craft: layout, motion, responsiveness, and the thousand details that make something feel native. The other half is building the system that decides at runtime what the interface should even be \- generating something a designer would normally draw. The work in front of us: productizing the execution runtime and hardening the security boundary around it; driving generation quality through prompt iteration, automated evaluation, and output validation; designing the UI frameworks that generated interfaces are built from; and shipping the features that people rely on. This requires a rare balance: rapid, highly ambiguous design exploration to find what feels right, followed by the rigorous engineering required to ship cross\-platform frameworks at Apple scale. You will partner with AI/ML teams, app teams, framework owners, security engineers, and designers across Apple to take features from idea to shipping. **Preferred Qualifications** Because this is a foundational role on a new team, we don't expect you to have every skill listed below. We are looking for deep expertise in a few areas, and the engineering fundamentals to learn the rest: Experience productizing a language runtime, interpreter, or VM under real workloads Experience designing a DSL, schema, or API surface that another system or model generates against Familiarity with sandboxing untrusted code and mediating its access to data and system capabilities Ability to reason adversarially about an API surface Experience defending against prompt injection \- guardrails, trust boundaries for retrieved content, personal data in context Experience evaluating nondeterministic systems: golden sets, automated judges, metrics that track what users notice Hands\-on experience with prompt design, tool definitions, structured output, and output validation Experience shipping a production ML\-backed feature at scale Strong design sensibility, and the judgment to tell when a generated interface isn't good enough **Minimum Qualifications** 6\+ years of software engineering experience Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or equivalent experience Expert\-level Swift, with production SwiftUI (or comparable declarative UI) Led an application or framework end to end, including its public API and its adopters Hands\-on experience building user\-facing features with generative models (shipped or prototyped) Experience setting technical direction across teams and mentoring engineers **Pay \& Benefits** At Apple, base pay is one part of our total compensation package and is determined within a range. jobs.title: Network Engineer
jobs.description: **Network Engineer** Join Aristocrat, a global leader in regulated gaming entertainment, where innovation, reliability, and alignment to regulations are essential to our operations. As an MSP Network Engineer, you will play a crucial role in developing and maintaining the network framework that supports MSP gaming operations. This position offers an exceptional opportunity to work in a highly regulated, 24x7 production environment. You will direct network builds and operational plans across our data centers and customer locations. Your knowledge will ensure the smooth performance and security of our vital systems, greatly influencing our worldwide gaming networks. **What You'll Do** * Construct, align, and improve secure, scalable network builds for Class 3 MSP gaming systems. * Take ownership for network build decisions from start to finish across primary and secondary data centers as well as customer environments. * Define technical standards, reference architectures, and guidelines applicable to networking of MSP devices. * Maintain high uptime, fault resistance, and efficiency of vital MSP network infrastructure. * Lead complex triage efforts across routing, VPNs, firewalls, and Multi Site networks. * Drive root cause analysis, corrective actions, and long\-term reliability improvements. * Analyze performance and resource trends; lead proactive efforts to improve resource use and efficiency. * Build and maintain resilient network infrastructures aligned with cybersecurity guidelines and gaming regulatory requirements. * Lead network change planning and risk assessment within formal change and configuration management processes. * Partner with gaming regulators and internal compliance teams to ensure compliant system operation. * Lead technical execution of new site deployments, infrastructure upgrades, and network modernization efforts. **What We're Looking For** * Bachelor’s degree in computer science, computer engineering, or equivalent experience. * CCNA or equivalent networking certification preferred. * 5\+ years of hands\-on enterprise network engineering experience. * Expert\-level understanding of routing and networking protocols (BGP, OSPF, IPSec, QoS, TCP/IP). * Deep hands\-on experience with enterprise Palo Alto firewalls, Arista Products, and F5 Products. * Strong experience with network monitoring, diagnostics, and analytics platforms. * Proven experience crafting and supporting highly available, regulated, or critically important environments. * Strong security approach and experience implementing secure network architectures. * Ability to work independently, lead technical initiatives, and influence cross\-functional teams. * Ability to obtain required Tribal Gaming licenses which may include providing fingerprints, background checks, financial statements, and any other applicable licensing requests. **Travel Expectations** * None **Additional Information** This role is subject to mandatory background screening and regulatory approvals. As part of moving into this role, you may be required to complete a criminal background check, submit fingerprints, and obtain licenses or registrations with applicable gaming regulatory authorities. Aristocrat operates in a highly regulated environment and holds licenses in over 340 gaming jurisdictions worldwide. To meet our global compliance obligations, you will be required to provide the disclosure of relevant personal and background information to government agencies, sovereign nations/tribal regulators, and other applicable gaming regulatory bodies. This is a condition of Aristocrat’s gaming licenses. jobs.title: Radiation Physicist - Cabarrus Levine Cancer FT
jobs.description: **Department:** 37303 Atrium Health Cabarrus \- Oncology: Radiation **Status:** Full time **Benefits Eligible:** Yes **Hou****rs Per Week:** 40 **Schedule Details/Additional Information:** As needed to cover clinical responsibilities ***This position is Sign\-on Bonus eligible. Based on eligibility.*** **Pay Range:** $99\.75 \- $159\.60 Interested applicants are invited to join Atrium Health Levine Cancer’s physics practice working alongside a dynamic care team. Atrium Health Levine Cancer (AHLC) provides patients with access to nationally renowned physicians and state\-of\-the\-art treatments at 25\+ cancer care locations across the Carolinas, including 10 radiation therapy centers in the Greater Charlotte, NC area. Atrium Health is recruiting a staff Medical Physicist to support clinical services at our Northern Area radiation therapy clinics (AHLC Cabarrus, AHLC Stanly and AHLC University City). These facilities collectively feature 2 Varian Truebeams (Cabarrus), one Varian Clinac iX (University) and one Trilogy linac (Stanly), all with Surface Image Guidance setup and motion management systems. The treatment planning system is Varian Eclipse (v16\.1\) and ARIA is the oncology EMR. Each clinic has a CT scanner to support clinical simulations The interested candidate would join a team of 5 other medical physicists, 5 dosimetrists and 4 physicians dedicated to supporting the Northern Area clinics. Atrium Health’s Charlotte clinics are home to 50\+ physicists, dosimetrists and medical physics assistants dedicated to supporting external beam and modalities across our network. The 7 other Greater Charlotte\-region Atrium Health Levine Cancer Radiation Therapy clinics are equipped with CT Simulators (GE/Philips), as well as Varian treatment planning (Eclipse v16\.1\), EMR (ARIA 15\.6/16\.1\) and Clinac/TrueBeam treatment delivery systems, with one clinic equipped with RayStation (v2023B) TPS, Mosaiq EMR and an Elekta Infinity linear accelerator. AHLC’s Charlotte\-area clinics have active SBRT and SRS programs and employ Surface Image Guidance Technology in all facilities. Our network of clinics also includes the Proton and Advanced Radiation Therapy Center which features the 2\-state region’s only proton beam delivery system, Gamma Knife\-based SRS and an active radiopharmaceutical therapy program. MIM Maestro image management software including AI contouring tools is also utilized. A full complement of QA tools and technologies are available. Active clinical projects include knowledge\-based planning techniques, AI contouring, clinical implementation of Cherenkov radiation in radiotherapy and QA standardization using a cloud\-based platform. Additionally, our Charlotte area clinics currently host trainees from the Carolinas College of Health Sciences in radiation therapy and medical dosimetry. Physicists also serve as mentors in the joint Atrium Health/Atrium Health Wake Forest Baptist CAMPEP\-approved medical physics residency program. In 2025, the Charlotte campus of the Wake Forest University School of Medicine opened with its inaugural class of medical students. It is anticipated that opportunities for academic faculty physicist roles will be available to interested and appropriate candidates. Interested candidates will join a collaborative environment where physicists work across facilities on projects impacting patients' network\-wide. **Major Responsibilities:** * Performs delivery of non\-standard, standard and complicated treatment planning and techniques which may include high dose radiation (HDR), low dose radiation (LDR) and stereotactic radiosurgery (SRS). Performs radiation surveys of patients exposed to radioactive sources; regularly performs radiation surveys of treatment rooms. * Calibrates various therapy machines, measures instruments against national standards, and measures therapy beam data for treatment planning purposes. Leads and facilitates the troubleshooting process, works collaboratively with Medical Engineers. Operates and performs quality assurance (QA) on equipment as required. * Writes specifications and commissions therapy equipment and accessories and designs new techniques and ancillary equipment. Performs and oversees commissioning and acceptance testing for therapies and accessories, and for standardizing equipment calibration. * Collaborates with other senior staff to develop and maintain a QA program for departmental treatment modalities and imaging devices. Works with Physicians to gather data, analyze outcomes and develop new processes and protocols. Develops, implements and oversees the department radiation safety policies. * Tracks and monitors data or parameters directly affecting patient dose and verifies algorithms used in pertinent dose calculations. Enters and validates data in treatment planning systems. Performs data collection and provides benchmark information for Institute, National and International protocols; performs physics measurements and oversight fo  commissioning and calibration of linacs, simulators and brachytherapy sources, clinical dosimetry of external beams and implant sources, patient setup, computerized treatment planning for special procedures that may include: HDR, LDR, total body irradiation (TBI), stereotactic radiosurgery, stereotactic radiotherapy, gamma knife and cyberknife. * Excellent interpersonal skills and the ability to communicate effectively with physicians, staff, patients and their families. * Excellent problem solving abilities and analytical skills to compare data. **Physical Requirements and Working Conditions:** * Must lift up to 20 lbs. frequently and up to 50 lbs. occasionally. * May push up to 500 lbs. 50 to 200 feet. * Exposed to mechanical, electrical, and radiation hazards. * Operates all equipment necessary to perform the job. * Exposed to a normal office environment. *This job description indicates the general nature and level of work expected of the incumbent. It is not designed to cover or contain a comprehensive listing of activities, duties or responsibilities required of the incumbent. Incumbent may be required to perform other related duties.* **Our Commitment to You:** Advocate Health offers a comprehensive suite of Total Rewards: benefits and well\-being programs, competitive compensation, generous retirement offerings, programs that invest in your career development and so much more – so you can live fully at and away from work, including: **Compensation** * Base compensation listed within the listed pay range based on factors such as qualifications, skills, relevant experience, and/or training * Premium pay such as shift, on call, and more based on a teammate's job * Incentive pay for select positions * Opportunity for annual increases based on performance **Benefits and more** * Paid Time Off programs * Health and welfare benefits such as medical, dental, vision, life, and Short\- and Long\-Term Disability * Flexible Spending Accounts for eligible health care and dependent care expenses * Family benefits such as adoption assistance and paid parental leave * Defined contribution retirement plans with employer match and other financial wellness programs * Educational Assistance Program Note: Eligibility for programs listed above may depend on your FTE or status (e.g., full\-time, part\-time, per diem, temporary, etc.); please ask a Recruiter for more information during an interview. **About Advocate Health** Advocate Health is the third\-largest nonprofit, integrated health system in the United States, created from the combination of Advocate Aurora Health and Atrium Health. Providing care under the names Advocate Health Care in Illinois; Atrium Health in the Carolinas, Georgia and Alabama; and Aurora Health Care in Wisconsin, Advocate Health is a national leader in clinical innovation, health outcomes, consumer experience and value\-based care. Headquartered in Charlotte, North Carolina, Advocate Health services nearly 6 million patients and is engaged in hundreds of clinical trials and research studies, with Wake Forest University School of Medicine serving as the academic core of the enterprise. It is nationally recognized for its expertise in cardiology, neurosciences, oncology, pediatrics and rehabilitation, as well as organ transplants, burn treatments and specialized musculoskeletal programs. Advocate Health employs 155,000 teammates across 69 hospitals and over 1,000 care locations, and offers one of the nation’s largest graduate medical education programs with over 2,000 residents and fellows across more than 200 programs. Committed to providing equitable care for all, Advocate Health provides more than $6 billion in annual community benefits. Directs and standardizes calibration of radiation producing equipment, ensures dose accuracy, patient safety, and maintains quality assurance (QA) program. Provides education and training in medical radiation physics and oversees department radiation safety and data management.

jobs.title: Lead Snowflake Architect
jobs.description: **AvaWatz is building Trusted AI for mission\-critical environments where accuracy, reliability, and security matter.** We develop advanced AI, machine learning, data intelligence, and autonomous systems for complex operational environments across defense, homeland security, aviation, infrastructure, and other high\-consequence applications. Our work goes beyond developing AI models. We focus on putting AI into real\-world operations: integrating complex data, creating intelligent workflows, enabling human\-machine decision support, and deploying AI securely in environments where conventional cloud\-based solutions often aren't an option. We are currently hiring for two Snowflake positions in the Dallas\-Fort Worth area. The position requires the person to be on\-site. NO Visa Sponsorship available. No Third Party! **Lead Snowflake Data Architect** We are seeking a **Lead Snowflake Data Architect** to lead the assessment, design, and evolution of a modern enterprise data architecture built around Snowflake. This role will develop a comprehensive understanding of the existing data landscape, identify its shortcomings, define the target\-state data architecture and platform strategy, and establish scalable patterns for data ingestion, integration, governance, and consumption. The ideal candidate will have deep hands\-on Snowflake architecture experience and demonstrated experience designing and implementing **Data Mesh architectures**, including domain\-oriented data ownership, data products, federated governance, and self\-service data capabilities. This senior technical leadership role requires the ability to move between enterprise\-level architecture, detailed technical design, and collaboration with engineering, analytics, security, and business stakeholders. **Key Responsibilities** * Lead discovery and documentation of the existing enterprise data landscape, including data sources, applications, databases, warehouses, pipelines, APIs, and downstream consumers, including assessment of current Snowflake implementations, data models, ingestion processes, integrations, security controls, and governance practices. Identify technical debt, architectural constraints, scalability issues, and opportunities for modernization * Define the enterprise **Snowflake platform strategy** aligned with business, analytics, AI/ML, security, and governance objectives; develop a **target\-state data architecture and technical blueprint** covering data ingestion, storage, transformation, sharing, governance, security, and consumption. * Establish architectural principles, standards, reference architectures, and reusable design patterns, and design scalable architectures supporting structured, semi\-structured, streaming, batch, and near\-real\-time data, as well as approaches for integrating Snowflake with cloud platforms, SaaS applications, APIs, data lakes, analytics tools, and AI/ML environments. * Design and guide implementation of a **Data Mesh operating and technical architecture** and standardized **data ingestion patterns** for batch, streaming, CDC, API\-based, file\-based, and event\-driven data. **Snowflake Platform / FinOps Engineer** **Position Summary** We are seeking an experienced **Snowflake Platform / FinOps Engineer** to analyze, optimize, and improve the operational and financial efficiency of an enterprise Snowflake environment. This role will combine deep Snowflake platform expertise with **FinOps, usage analytics, performance engineering, and cost optimization**. The engineer will analyze Snowflake consumption and usage metadata, identify immediate cost\-saving opportunities, establish cost\-attribution and monitoring mechanisms, and recommend longer\-term improvements to platform configuration and workload management. A key initial responsibility will be conducting a focused Snowflake cost and usage assessment and producing an actionable **quick\-win optimization memo** identifying opportunities that can reduce unnecessary consumption without adversely affecting performance or business operations. **Key Responsibilities** **Snowflake Cost Analysis** * Analyze historical Snowflake consumption, compute usage, storage utilization, cloud services consumption, and credit expenditure; Identify the major drivers of Snowflake costs across: Virtual warehouses, databases, and schemas, teams and business units, Users and service accounts, applications and workloads, ETL/ELT pipelines, BI and analytics workloads * Identify underutilized or inefficient Snowflake resources by analyzing warehouse sizing, utilization, concurrency, idle time, auto\-suspend configurations, scaling policies, and query behavior, and evaluate storage growth, retention policies, Time Travel usage, Fail\-safe implications, transient tables, staging areas, and unnecessary data duplication. * Analyze Snowflake metadata and system views, including ACCOUNT\_USAGE and INFORMATION\_SCHEMA, to understand platform behavior and identify high\-cost queries, workloads, users, applications, and processing patterns. * Evaluate Snowflake features and configurations for their cost/performance tradeoffs. * Partner with data engineering and analytics teams to address inefficient workloads and pipelines and establish Snowflake FinOps practices that provide visibility, accountability, and governance around platform consumption. * Develop cost allocation and showback/chargeback methodologies by department, project, workload, environment, or data product. * Establish tagging and resource\-classification standards to improve cost attribution. * Define budgets, thresholds, alerts, and resource monitors. * Develop KPIs for Snowflake efficiency and cost management and establish mechanisms to detect unexpected consumption increases. * Recommend governance processes to review and approve high\-cost workloads or platform changes. * Monitor and optimize overall Snowflake platform health and performance and analyze query profiles and identify performance bottlenecks. * Recommend improvements to clustering, partition pruning, query design, caching, warehouse sizing, and workload management, and support platform configuration, security, access management, automation, and operational best practices. * Work with architects and engineering teams to ensure platform designs balance scalability, reliability, performance, and cost. * Develop executive\-friendly reporting explaining Snowflake consumption and cost drivers, and build dashboards and recurring reporting for Snowflake usage, consumption, and optimization KPIs. Benefits: * 401(k) * Dental insurance * Health insurance * Paid time off Application Question(s): * Do you need any visa sponsorship now or in the future to work in the USA? Ability to Relocate: * Dallas, TX 75243: Relocate before starting work (Required) Work Location: In person

jobs.title: Continuous Improvement Engineer
jobs.description: **Job Description** BAE Systems is seeking a Lean Six Sigma Green Belt Continuous Improvement Engineer to support our work as a prime contractor on a high\-profile U.S. Navy weapon system. A strategic mindset, a passion for continuous improvement, technical agility, and the ability to collaborate effectively across diverse program areas are important traits we expect the successful candidate to possess and demonstrate. This position is responsible for driving operational excellence among various program areas to execute Process Improvement and Kaizen\-type events in a non\-manufacturing environment. The candidate will analyze complex workflows and documentation to eliminate waste—reducing process steps and optimizing efficiency—while identifying opportunities to integrate AI and other digital tools to automate manual tasks and allow team members to focus on high\-value work. Additionally, the candidate will take a proactive approach in analyzing how updates to various external documentation impacts internal documentation and processes to ensure seamless alignment and compliance. Candidate will also be required to support other Quality Department operations as needed. A limited amount of travel to off\-site locations could be required. **About BAE Systems and the U.S. Navy’s Strategic Systems Programs (SSP)** Our organization has supported the U.S. Navy’s Strategic Systems Programs (SSP) continually since the program’s inception in the 1950s. SSP developed the first sea\-based, underwater\-launched Strategic Weapon System (SWS), a defense system that is truly critical to our national security. For more than six decades, SSP has maintained and upgraded this weapon system and we have been there every step of the way. The sea\-based SWS is the ultimate stealthy weapon system and is the first leg of the U.S. nuclear triad. With over 70% of our nation’s nuclear arsenal its importance to maintaining world peace cannot be overstated. The development of Columbia, the most advanced nuclear\-powered, nuclear\-armed submarine ever designed, as well the next D5LE2 weapon system is under way and will begin to be rolled out over the next decade. The Navy projects this system to be operational through 2084, meaning the program will have a total life span of more than 120 years. This is a unique program and BAE Systems employees on this program understand they are part of an important legacy. **Required Education, Experience, \& Skills** * Bachelor’s degree and 6\+ years of professional work experience in process improvement, operational excellence, or a related field in a systems integration and/or program management work environment (Non\-manufacturing environment). * Certified Lean Six Sigma Green Belt. * Proven experience facilitating Kaizen\-like events and utilizing transactional Lean methodologies to streamline workflows and reduce waste in “invisible” processes. * Experience executing Current State Mapping and Root Cause Analysis against existing, locally\-maintained process guidance to improve the performance of Standard Work. * Experience supporting high visibility/high impact process improvement projects on\-time with critical stakeholder buy\-in and engagement. * Experience working in or for an ISO 9001\-certified organization, or familiarity with ISO 9001 Quality Management System concepts. * Proficiency as an agent of change and help to foster a culture of continuous improvement within the organization. * Strong interpersonal and influencing skills to interact with diverse work teams across multiple program areas. * Proficiency in Microsoft Office tools and process mapping software. **Preferred Education, Experience, \& Skills** * Certified Lean Six Sigma Black Belt or desire to pursue further certifications. * Experience as an Effective and Impactful Kaizen Facilitator * Experience identifying and integrating AI tools or automation software to optimize business processes. * Experience working within a defense prime contractor environment, specifically supporting U.S. Navy weapon systems. * Detailed knowledge of the SSP T9001 Quality Management System framework. * Familiarity with how external documentation impacts internal documentation and processes to ensure seamless alignment and compliance. **Pay Information** Full\-Time Salary Range: $101398 \- $172377 Please note: This range is based on our market pay structures. However, individual salaries are determined by a variety of factors including, but not limited to: business considerations, local market conditions, and internal equity, as well as candidate qualifications, such as skills, education, and experience. Employee Benefits: At BAE Systems, we support our employees in all aspects of their life, including their health and financial well\-being. Regular employees scheduled to work 20\+ hours per week are offered: health, dental, and vision insurance; health savings accounts; a 401(k) savings plan; disability coverage; and life and accident insurance. We also have an employee assistance program, a legal plan, and other perks including discounts on things like home, auto, and pet insurance. jobs.title: Piping/Mechanical Designer - Facilities
jobs.description: **Job Description** BAE Systems is seeking a Piping Designer to drive the conceptualization and technical execution of piping systems for maintenance and sustainment projects supporting energetic manufacturing processes at the Holston Army Ammunition Plant (HSAAP). You will be responsible for developing precise piping designs, isometric drawings, and material specifications necessary to ensure the safe and efficient integration of new capabilities and the sustainment of existing chemical production facilities. **Job Description** The Piping Designer will provide essential technical expertise to support the design and construction of projects aimed at increasing and sustaining chemical production capacity. This role requires a high degree of technical competence in applying piping design principles to solve complex modernization challenges within a high\-hazard environment. You will operate within a matrixed organization, coordinating closely with the Engineering Manager and Process Engineers to translate P\&IDs into actionable construction documents. (PHA) and Root Cause Analysis (RCA) specifically regarding piping integrity and leak prevention. * Ensure all designs are conducted in strict accordance with safety regulations, ASME codes, and quality standards. **Required Education, Experience, \& Skills** **Qualifications** * Strong fundamentals of piping design and the ability to apply technical knowledge to specialized chemical production processes. * Proven ability to develop detailed design packages from conceptual P\&IDs or undefined project outlines. * Experience in a high\-hazard or regulated manufacturing environment (energetics/chemical experience is a significant plus). * Ability to communicate technical design requirements effectively to internal stakeholders and government customers. * **Education:** Associate’s or Bachelor’s Degree in a technical field (Mechanical Engineering or Design Technology) preferred. * **Industry Experience:** 3\+ years of experience in the chemical process industry, or 6\+ years of relevant industrial piping design experience. * **Design Lifecycle:** Demonstrated experience in the full design lifecycle, from conceptual routing through construction and commissioning. * **Technical Breadth:** Proficiency in mechanical piping systems, including pumping, HVAC, and vessel connections. * **Standards \& Tools:** + Working knowledge of applicable codes and standards (e.g., ASME B31\.3, UFC). + Proficiency in design software (e.g., AutoCAD, Inventor, and Plant 3D) for generating technical drawings. + Expertise in Microsoft Office Suite for documentation and material tracking. * **Technical Literacy:** Expert ability to read and interpret P\&IDs and other engineering documents. **Preferred Education, Experience, \& Skills** **Preferred Education, Experience, \& Skills** * **Education \& Tenure:** Degree from an accredited institution with 10\+ years of progressive experience in industrial piping design for chemical facilities. * **Specialized Industry Knowledge:** Deep experience in Energetics and related processes, specifically within Department of Defense (DoD) project frameworks. * **Chemical Facility Expertise:** Proven track record in the design of piping systems utilizing acids, bases, and solvents for energetic material production. * **Regulatory \& Safety Mastery:** Expert\-level knowledge of explosives site safety (DDESB) and environmental regulations (EPA, TDEC, etc.). * **Advanced Analysis Tools:** Proficiency in Caesar II or similar piping stress analysis software and Computational Fluid Dynamics (CFD) to inform design feasibility. * **Operational Context:** Experience providing design support within a 24/7 manufacturing environment. * **Integration Expertise:** Experience managing the piping integration of Vendor Skids into complex chemical manufacturing processes. * **Hardware Knowledge:** Deep familiarity with industrial valves, actuators, positioners, and specialized plant instrumentation. * **Technical Design:** Ability to lead the generation of comprehensive engineering design packages to verify project scope and material requirements. **Pay Information** Full\-Time Salary Range: $96623 \- $164259 Please note: This range is based on our market pay structures. However, individual salaries are determined by a variety of factors including, but not limited to: business considerations, local market conditions, and internal equity, as well as candidate qualifications, such as skills, education, and experience. jobs.title: CXO AI Engineer
jobs.description: **Innovate with purpose** At BILL, we believe in empowering the businesses that drive our economy. By replacing outdated financial processes with innovative tools, we help businesses—from startups to established brands—make smarter decisions and gain control of their operations. And we don't stop there: we're creating the future of financial automation so businesses can spend more time on what matters. Working here means you become part of a vision\-driven team that's ready to tackle challenges and build cutting\-edge solutions. We value purpose, drive, and curiosity—and we thrive in a fast\-paced, ever\-changing environment. We're remote\-first, with office spaces in San Jose, CA and Draper, UT — and opportunities to connect in person when it counts. BILLders collaborate to deliver real impact for businesses that need more time in their busy weeks. BILL builds high performing teams and we seek to hire the best talent for every role. We're committed to building a workplace that fosters inclusion and diverse perspectives, valuing each person's unique skills and experiences. We'd love to hear from you—you might be just what we're looking for, whether in this role or another. ✨ Let's give businesses more time for what matters. Customer Experience Operations at BILL handles 60K\+ customer contacts per month across chat, phone, and email. We support SMB, mid\-market, and enterprise customers with a mix of internal and BPO teams across four countries. We're standing up a new team inside CXO focused on building agentic AI systems that automate manual work, catch things before they fall through cracks, and give leaders visibility into their operations. The work isn't new. We've been building AI tools and delivering value ad hoc, but now it's our mandate. This is a founding team. You'd be shaping the architecture, the workflows, and the culture from the ground up. There's existing work to build on, but no inherited playbook to follow. You'll work directly with CARE leaders, QA, Advocacy, and WFM to identify what to automate and validate that it's working. In this role, you will: * Automate repetitive operational workflows: CES reporting, QA transcript analysis, knowledge article maintenance, SOP\-driven case workflows. Deploy standardized automations across Slack and Salesforce at scale. * Flag stalled handoffs, aged cases, SLA breach risks, and duplicate cases before they become problems. Review DevRev/Cresta transcripts to ensure bots are behaving as expected. * Give leaders self\-serve access to data and insights. Deliver automated weekly/monthly business intelligence on cadence (site health, volume, SLA, CES). Detect escalation patterns and repeat contacts that nobody is connecting the dots on. * Build memory architecture: bots that look at staffing, feedback, transcripts, and agent work together at scale. Know what happened last week and what's coming next. You will also: * Connect and deploy orchestration layers (MCP, custom connectors) to automate CX business workflows and productize internal tools * Measure operational reliability and system accuracy to ensure business metrics are being achieved: contacts deflected, cost avoided, hours saved. Design escalation patterns so the system knows when to surface to a human. * Partner with the data team on structured data layers that keep AI outputs trustworthy. Productize what works so it scales across the org. We'd love to chat if you have: * 5\+ years building and deploying production systems. Python required. SQL strongly preferred. * 2\+ years working with LLMs in production: prompt configuration, tool use, function calling, RAG pipelines, agentic frameworks (MCP, custom orchestration, etc.) * Experience building LLM orchestration and integration layers that connect AI agents to business systems. Multi\-step workflows, tool coordination, memory management, error recovery. * You understand context engineering: accuracy depends on what information reaches the model. You've structured context, routing logic, and retrieval pipelines for these systems at scale. * You know how to measure operational reliability of AI systems: are they actually delivering the business outcomes they're supposed to? * Comfort with ambiguity. You'll define the approach, not just implement specs. * You can translate between technical implementation and business value: hours saved, contacts deflected, cost avoided. * Familiarity with customer support operations: contact routing, SLAs, agent workflows, quality assurance. * Bias toward shipping. Deploy, measure, iterate. Bonus points if you also have: * Experience with Salesforce integrations or CX/support tooling (DevRev, Cresta, knowledge management systems) * Data modeling or analytics background (dbt, Redshift, Trino) * Experience building tools for non\-technical end users *Visa Sponsorship: Please note that this position is not eligible for visa sponsorship. Applicants must have authorization to work in the United States without requiring visa sponsorship now or in the future.* **What's in it for you?** Redefining how businesses automate their work is a fast\-paced, exciting, and fun environment. But we also have benefits and perks to ensure the magic isn't only experienced by our customers, but by our employees as well. Here is a preview of some of the amazing benefits here at BILL: * 100% paid employee health, dental, and vision plans (choose HMO, PPO, or HDHP) * HSA \& FSA accounts * Life Insurance, Long \& Short\-term disability coverage * Employee Assistance Program (EAP) * 11\+ Observed holidays and wellness days and flexible time off * Employee Stock Purchase Program with employee discounts * Wellness \& Fitness initiatives * Employee recognition and referral programs * And much more Don't believe us? Check out our culture, benefits, and teams on our career site, LinkedIn Life, or YouTube pages. BILL is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We believe our best ideas come from the unique stories, perspectives, and experiences of our team members. We welcome people of all backgrounds, abilities, and identities to bring their authentic selves and contribute to our culture. We are committed to a transparent, inclusive hiring process that reflects our values. If you need accommodations at any stage, please contact interviewaccommodations@hq.bill.com. To ensure a fair evaluation, our Candidate Integrity Policy prohibits the use of unapproved external assistance, including generative AI, during live interviews or assessments. Doing so will result in a review and potential disqualification. Our Applicant Privacy Notice describes how BILL treats the personal information it receives from applicants.

As a leading global financial services company at the heart of the global financial system, we influence nearly 20% of the world’s investible assets. Every day, our teams harness cutting\-edge AI and breakthrough technologies to collaborate with clients, driving transformative solutions that redefine industries and uplift communities worldwide. Together, we power the future of finance – and this is what \#LifeAtBNY is all about. Join us and be part of something extraordinary. In this role, you’ll make an impact in the following ways: * Collaborate with cross\-functional teams to design, develop, and maintain scalable web applications using Python/Java for back\-end services. * Implement RESTful APIs and microservices in Python/Java, ensuring robust integration with front\-end components and data platforms. * Develop intuitive and responsive user interfaces using Angular/React, adhering to best practices in web development and accessibility. * Integrate and query data from Snowflake, optimizing data pipelines and managing data storage for performance and reliability. * Participate in the entire software development lifecycle, including requirements gathering, design, coding, testing, and deployment. * Write clean, maintainable, and well\-documented code across the stack, supporting code reviews and knowledge sharing within the team. * Troubleshoot, debug, and resolve technical issues across back\-end, front\-end, and data platform components. * Contribute to continuous improvement by suggesting enhancements to application architecture, code quality, and development processes. * Support the implementation of security best practices throughout the stack, including data protection and secure authentication mechanisms. * Collaborate with business users and other stakeholders to deliver user\-centric solutions that align with business objectives. * Stay current with emerging technologies in Python/Java, Angular/React, and Snowflake, applying new insights to improve application performance and reliability. * Assist in the preparation and maintenance of technical documentation, deployment scripts, and user guides as needed. * Engage in Agile development practices, participating in daily stand\-ups, sprint planning, and retrospectives * Use and champion AI\-assisted development tools and agentic coding workflows, applying them hands\-on to accelerate delivery and code quality. jobs.description: **Firm overview** Bates White is a boutique consulting firm based in Washington, DC. OpenAI, Databricks, AWS (e.g., Bedrock, SageMaker AI) and Google Cloud Vertex AI / Gemini), and evaluate and onboard new platforms as needs evolve. * Develop, orchestrate, and maintain multi\-step agent workflows, including tool use, function calling, retrieval\-augmented generation (RAG), and integration with enterprise data sources, applications, and APIs. * Apply a thorough understanding of how LLMs and emerging AI systems work, covering model selection, prompt design, context management, embeddings and vector stores, and the tradeoffs among inference, retrieval, and fine\-tuning to select the right approach for each use case. * Partner with business stakeholders and firm leadership to translate business requirements into robust, production\-grade AI solutions. * Build reusable frameworks, components, and pipelines that enable the broader data engineering team to develop, test, and scale AI solutions efficiently across cloud platforms. * Establish and apply responsible AI practices, including data privacy and security, prompt injection and abuse mitigation, and evaluation and guardrails, in alignment with the firm’s AI governance policies and client contractual obligations. * Monitor, evaluate, and continuously improve the accuracy, performance, cost, and reliability of deployed AI systems, including through token usage optimization. * Build and maintain CI/CD pipelines and automated testing for AI workflows and agents, and manage the model lifecycle including version upgrades, deprecations, and migrations as providers release new models. * Extend AI solutions to multi\-modal use cases as needed, incorporating vision, audio, or other modalities alongside text\-based LLMs. * Stay current with the rapidly evolving AI landscape and advise the team on emerging models, tools, and techniques and their potential applications, including alternatives to the firm’s primary Azure\-based stack (e.g., AWS, Google Cloud/Gemini). **What you’ll bring to the table** * Bachelor’s degree in computer science, data science, engineering, or a related field required; advanced degree preferred. * Minimum 7 years’ experience in software engineering, data engineering, or a closely related technical field. * Minimum 3 years’ hands\-on experience building AI solutions, specifically with large language models (LLMs) and agent\-based systems. * Thorough understanding of LLM architecture, capabilities, and limitations, with the ability to reason about and adopt new AI systems as they emerge. * Proficiency in Python and modern AI/ML frameworks and libraries; familiarity with multi\-modal models (e.g., vision, audio) is a plus. * Demonstrated experience building agentic workflows, RAG pipelines, and LLM integrations using frameworks such as LangChain, LlamaIndex, Semantic Kernel, or comparable tooling. * Experience with enterprise AI platforms such as Azure AI Foundry, Azure OpenAI, or Databricks or comparable platforms on AWS (e.g. Bedrock, SageMaker AI) or Google Cloud (e.g. Vertex AI, Gemini). * Experience working with vector databases and embedding models. * Proficiency in prompt engineering, model evaluation, and the use of guardrail and safety tooling. * Proficiency working with REST APIs and integrating AI systems into enterprise applications and data pipelines. * Familiarity with MLOps/LLMOps tooling (e.g., MLflow, Weights \& Biases, LangSmith) for experiment tracking and model monitoring. * Familiarity with Microsoft Azure and other major cloud providers (AWS, Google Cloud) and cloud\-based data services. The firm is Azure\-focused but open to experience with other platforms. * Familiarity with data privacy, security, and responsible\-AI considerations for enterprise AI systems is preferred. * Experience with SQL and working with both structured and unstructured data sources are advantageous. * Strong problem\-solving and analytical skills. * Ability to work effectively under dynamic circumstances, tight deadlines, and high\-pressure situations. * Ability to successfully work with individuals of varying backgrounds, levels, and departments. * Excellent oral and written communication skills and ability to effectively communicate complex technical and AI concepts to diverse audiences. * May require more than 40\.0 hours per week to perform the essential duties of the position. **What you can expect from us** We are committed to providing an exceptional employee experience. You can expect: * Competitive compensation—the salary range for this position is $160,000 to $190,000\. This position is also eligible for bonus compensation on a discretionary basis. The actual salary offered for this position will be determined based on job\-related, non\-discriminatory factors including qualifications and experience, education, external market data, and internal equity. Comprehensive benefits package—includes tuition reimbursement up to $75K, low healthcare premiums, wellness benefits, and more!* * Hybrid work environment with three coordinated in\-office days per week. * Open culture where your voice is heard, your input is sought, and your contributions are rewarded. * Fun and engaging culture including frequent social events. * Amenities that include a fitness center, rooftop terrace, standing desks, espresso, fresh fruit, breakfast and afternoon snack, billiards, and ping pong. * Employee\-driven community outreach program featuring fundraising events (e.g., trivia, game shows, cooking competitions, etc.), volunteer opportunities, and matching funds along with our pro bono program. * Investment in your career through training programs, an assigned mentor and peer coach, and frequent feedback. * Networking opportunities through employee interest groups, Women’s Network, International Network, Diversity\-Inclusion Council, and BWProud Network. jobs.description: **At Bayer we’re visionaries, driven to solve the world’s toughest challenges and striving for a world where 'Health for all Hunger for none’ is no longer a dream, but a real possibility. Serve as the site\-wide technical authority for all HVAC and refrigeration systems across GMP and non\-GMP facilities, providing expert\-level guidance on design, operation, maintenance, qualification, and compliance of HVAC and refrigeration infrastructure critical to pharmaceutical manufacturing, including sterile Class A and B filling environments and critical temperature\-controlled storage environments. **YOUR TASKS AND RESPONSIBILITIES** * Serve as the site technical authority for all HVAC and refrigeration systems, including chillers, air handling units (AHUs), cooling towers, boilers, cleanroom air systems, exhaust systems, humidification/dehumidification systems, building automation systems (BAS/DeltaV/Desigo), compressors, evaporators, condensers, control systems, alarm systems, and associated utilities supporting \+5°C and \-30°C cold rooms; * Lead and ensure the reliability, compliance, and continuous improvement of HVAC and refrigeration systems and GMP\-critical infrastructure, including chilled and hot water systems, HEPA certification and air balancing programs, ISO 8 and sterile Class A/B environments, and SAP work order processes; * Ensure HVAC and refrigeration systems maintain required environmental conditions and operate in full compliance with GMP, quality, regulatory, and environmental requirements applicable to a pharmaceutical manufacturing site; * Provide expert troubleshooting and technical support for HVAC and refrigeration system failures, excursions, and performance issues, including root cause analysis, corrective action development, and recurrence prevention; * Lead the development, optimization, and continuous improvement of preventive, predictive, and reliability\-centered maintenance strategies for all HVAC and refrigeration assets, including spare parts management, lifecycle planning, and standardized maintenance procedures and SOPs; * Maintain the technical integrity of HVAC and refrigeration asset information in the CMMS, including equipment records, PM plans, spare parts, and failure code strategy; * Support the qualified state of controlled\-temperature and GMP HVAC environments through qualification, requalification, temperature mapping, environmental monitoring review, and quality system activities including deviations, CAPAs, change controls, and risk assessments; * Monitor and trend HVAC and refrigeration performance, alarm history, temperature data, energy use, and system reliability metrics to proactively identify risks, drive continuous improvement, and respond to environmental and utility excursions; * Provide technical leadership and design review for HVAC and refrigeration\-related capital projects, system upgrades, obsolescence remediation, and facility modifications, including contractor/vendor oversight; * Leverage CMMS, Building Management Systems (Desigo, DeltaV), and industrial automation systems to support maintenance execution, operational excellence, and ongoing improvement efforts. **WHO YOU ARE** Bayer seeks an incumbent who possesses the following: **Required Qualifications:** * Bachelor’s Degree or equivalent in a relevant engineering or technical discipline; * Demonstrated technical expertise in HVAC and industrial refrigeration systems and operations in regulated environments; * Strong knowledge of GMP, OSHA, environmental requirements, and permit\-to\-work processes applicable to HVAC and refrigeration systems; * Proven ability to coordinate and oversee contractor/vendor activities in the field, ensuring safe work execution and adherence to approved procedures; * Exceptional troubleshooting and problem\-solving skills to diagnose equipment or system failures, identify deviations or risks, and drive corrective actions; * Proficiency with CMMS platforms such as SAP PM, Maximo, or equivalent for work order management and maintenance data integrity; * Ability to read and interpret P\&IDs, mechanical drawings, equipment manuals, and technical documentation to support maintenance and system decisions; * Strong communication and collaboration skills to interface effectively with Maintenance, Engineering, Operations, Quality, EHS, and external vendors; * Excellent planning, organization, and execution ownership to manage multiple priorities and ensure work is completed to specification. **Preferred Qualifications:** * Bachelor’s Degree with 8\+ years’ experience or equivalent combination of education and experience; * HVAC or Refrigeration certificated program with 12\+ years’ experience; * 5\+ years’ experience in maintenance, reliability, or manufacturing operations within a regulated environment (pharmaceutical, biotech, food, or chemical); * Experience supporting HVAC qualification, validation, temperature mapping, and environmental monitoring in GMP facilities; * Familiarity with building automation systems (Desigo, DeltaV) and industrial control integration for HVAC systems. Employees can expect to be paid a salary between $131,600\.00 \- $197,400\.00\. Additional compensation may include a bonus or commission (if relevant). Additional benefits include health care, vision, dental, retirement, PTO, sick leave, etc. This salary range is merely an estimate and may vary based on an applicant’s location, market data/ranges, an applicant’s skills and prior relevant experience, certain degrees and certifications, and other relevant factors. This posting will be available for application until at least 10/4/2026\. \#LI\-US \#LI\-AMS **YOUR APPLICATION** Bayer offers a wide variety of competitive compensation and benefits programs. jobs.title: Principal Software Engineer (IAM)
jobs.description: Black Duck Software, Inc. helps organizations build secure, high\-quality software, minimizing risks while maximizing speed and productivity. Black Duck, a recognized pioneer in application security, provides SAST, SCA, and DAST solutions that enable teams to quickly find and fix vulnerabilities and defects in proprietary code, open source components, and application behavior. With a combination of industry\-leading tools, services, and expertise, only Black Duck helps organizations maximize security and quality in DevSecOps and throughout the software development life cycle. Black Duck is seeking a **Principal Software Engineer** to serve as a **technical leader for the company's identity, authentication, authorization, and access management platforms**. This role will drive the architecture, design, implementation, security, scalability, and operational excellence of critical identity services that support customers, partners, and internal engineering teams. NOTE: We can hire this position in either Canada (AB, BC, ON) or in the US (East coast or Central ideally). The successful candidate will combine deep expertise in modern identity technologies with strong software engineering and architectural leadership skills. They will influence technical direction across multiple teams, establish engineering standards, mentor engineers, and help shape the future of secure, scalable SaaS platforms. **Key Responsibilities** * Lead the architecture, design, and evolution of enterprise\-scale identity and access management solutions. * Serve as the organization's technical authority for authentication, authorization, federation, and identity lifecycle management. * Design and implement secure, scalable, and resilient software systems that support multiple products and engineering teams. * Provide technical leadership and architectural guidance across cross\-functional initiatives. * Drive engineering excellence through software design reviews, code reviews, mentoring, and the establishment of engineering best practices. * Partner with engineering, product, security, and operations teams to deliver secure, reliable, and highly available services. * Lead technical investigations, evaluate emerging technologies, and recommend solutions aligned with business and engineering objectives. * Improve platform observability, maintainability, performance, and operational efficiency. * Influence long\-term technology strategy and help shape the engineering roadmap. * Mentor engineers and technical leaders across the organization. * Promote effective adoption of AI\-assisted development tools and modern software engineering practices throughout the software development lifecycle. * Help advance the organization's AI maturity by identifying opportunities to improve engineering productivity, software quality, and delivery outcomes through responsible use of AI technologies. **Required Qualifications** * Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or equivalent practical experience. * 10\+ years of software engineering experience, including architecture and technical leadership responsibilities. * **Extensive experience designing, implementing, and operating Identity and Access Management (IAM) and Customer Identity and Access Management (CIAM) solutions.** * **Deep hands\-on experience with modern identity platforms such as Auth0,** **Okta****, Microsoft Entra ID (Azure AD), Ping Identity, or similar technologies.** * **Expert understanding of** **OAuth 2\.0****,** **OpenID Connect (OIDC), SAML, Multi\-Factor Authentication (MFA), federation, token\-based security, and modern authentication patterns.** * Experience building and operating identity solutions at scale for customer\-facing SaaS applications. * Strong experience designing and building distributed systems, APIs, and cloud\-native applications. * Deep understanding of software architecture, security principles, and modern engineering practices. * Experience leading technical initiatives that span multiple teams and organizations. * Strong communication skills with the ability to influence technical direction and build alignment across diverse stakeholders. * Familiarity with AI\-assisted software development tools and a solid understanding of how AI can improve engineering effectiveness throughout the software development lifecycle. **Preferred Qualifications** * Experience leading identity platform migrations, consolidations, or modernization initiatives. * Experience designing Zero Trust, Single Sign\-On (SSO), and enterprise federation architectures. * Experience with cloud infrastructure, containerized environments, and modern SaaS platforms. * Experience operating in highly regulated or security\-focused environments. * Experience with security, privacy, compliance, or audit requirements for enterprise software systems. * Experience evaluating, implementing, or promoting AI\-enabled development tools and engineering workflows. **What Success Looks Like** * Serves as the organization's recognized expert for identity architecture and authentication technologies. * Establishes scalable, secure, and reliable identity services that support current and future business needs. * Influences technical direction and engineering standards across multiple teams. * Raises engineering quality, security, and operational maturity throughout the organization. * Successfully advances adoption of modern engineering practices, including effective use of AI to improve developer productivity and software quality. * Delivers long\-term architectural improvements while remaining actively engaged in hands\-on technical leadership. *Black Duck is an equal opportunity employer. We consider all applicants for employment without regard to race, color, national origin, religion, sex, gender identity or expression, age, disability, sexual orientation, veteran or military service status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law. Black Duck complies with all applicable laws prohibiting employment discrimination in every jurisdiction where it operates and provides reasonable accommodations to individuals with disabilities in accordance with applicable law.*

jobs.title: Senior Analytics Engineer, AI & DX Analytics
jobs.description: Block builds simple, powerful tools that make progress towards an economy that’s truly open to all. Each of our brands unlocks different aspects of the economy for more people. Square makes commerce and financial services accessible to sellers. Cash App is the easy way to spend, send, and store money. Afterpay is transforming the way customers manage their spending over time. TIDAL is a music platform that empowers artists to thrive as entrepreneurs. Bitkey is a simple self\-custody wallet built for bitcoin. Proto is a suite of bitcoin mining products and services. Together, we’re helping build a financial system that is open to everyone. Join us. #### **The Role** The AI \& DX (Developer Experience) Analytics team exists to measure and improve Block's developer experience and investment in AI. We turn raw engineering signals (agent session data, pull request and CI activity, and AI spend) into reporting and analysis that shape leadership's AI investment decisions, and drive improvement in AI ROI and developer experience. Your work will be the trusted source of truth that engineers and executives use to decide where AI investment is working and where to redirect it. We're hiring a Senior Analytics Engineer to own parts of that pipeline end to end. This is a broad, high\-visibility role with a lot of white space: you will instrument new telemetry at the source and build production pipelines that turn it into governed data, then turn that governed data into executive\-facing reporting and the analysis that surfaces concrete opportunities to improve AI ROI and developer experience. You'll also help pioneer one of the most consequential open problems in the industry right now: measuring the productivity impact of an increasingly AI\- and agent\-augmented engineering workforce, where there is no textbook answer and real room to set the standard. You'll define new metrics and craft the visual narrative — the charts, dashboards, and presentation materials — that make them land with an executive audience. AI\-first workflows are central to how this team operates and critical to succeeding in this role: using AI coding agents is a default part of how you build and maintain pipelines and dashboards. You'll excel in this role if you're as comfortable defining and visualizing a brand new executive\-facing metric from a messy signal as you are debugging why a pipeline silently stalled overnight. **You Will** ------------ **Instrumentation \& Telemetry:** * Instrument and extend the raw telemetry captured about AI usage, code changes, CI/CD activity, and spend — building new data capture, not only transforming what already exists. This is core to the role, as evolving AI tools and increased AI adoption constantly creates new signals that need to be captured. * Partner with data engineers on production ETL pipelines that land that telemetry into governed tables, with the freshness monitoring, backfills, and alerting that keep it trustworthy, rather than a one\-off script. * Define new metrics out of ambiguous or evolving signals, and earn stakeholder trust in a new number by validating and reconciling it until it holds up. **Dashboards \& analysis:** * Build and ship the executive\-facing dashboards and visualizations that turn governed metrics into decision\-ready reporting — with the polish and precision a room of executives will scrutinize. * Run the analysis that a new chart or metric needs and anticipate questions that an executive audience will ask, then bring senior stakeholders a recommendation, not just a number, and defend the methodology behind both. * Translate complex, technical findings into a clear narrative: the headline chart and the one sentence that makes an executive act on it. **Across both:** * Use AI coding agents as a default part of how you write, test, and maintain data pipelines, dashboards, and analyses. * Partner across data engineering, applied AI, and data science teams to keep telemetry connected end to end — the raw signal you capture directly feeds the session classifiers, not just the dashboards you build. * Turn what the data shows into action: flag where AI spend isn't paying off or where developer friction is most costly, and push the tooling, process, or investment changes that address it. * Push the industry\-frontier work of quantifying AI and agent productivity impact — there's no established playbook, and this team sets one. **Qualifications** ------------------ **You are:** * Self\-sufficient across the full analytics loop: instrumentation, pipeline building, metric definition, and dashboards — not someone who hands off past the query. * At home in messy, evolving telemetry, with the judgment to know when a new number is right and when it needs a second look before an executive sees it. * A strong product thinker: you get at what a stakeholder actually needs from a metric or chart, not just what they asked for. * Comfortable with ambiguity on a genuinely unsolved problem — measu ng, data engineering, or business intelligence, owning production data pipelines and insights end to end. * Strong SQL and Python, with hands\-on experience building and operating data pipelines against a cloud data warehouse such as Snowflake. * Experience partnering with engineering teams to instrument new event or telemetry data, not only transforming what's already captured. * Experience building dashboards or internal tools that non\-technical stakeholders rely on to make decisions. * Comfort with git, CI/CD systems, and debugging production pipeline failures such as retries and backfills. **Even better:** * Experience with a metrics\-governance or semantic\-layer system, such as a metrics store, dbt semantic layer, or LookML. **Technologies we use and teach:** * SQL (Snowflake), Python, TypeScript and React, Git, CI/CD pipelines, a governed metrics store, AI coding agents, and LLM\-based classification tooling. We’re working to build a more inclusive economy where our customers have equal access to opportunity, and we strive to live by these same values in building our workplace. Block is an equal opportunity employer evaluating all employees and job applicants without regard to identity or any legally protected class. We will consider qualified applicants with arrest or conviction records for employment in accordance with state and local laws and “fair chance” ordinances. We believe in being fair, and are committed to an inclusive interview experience, including providing reasonable accommodations to disabled applicants throughout the recruitment process. We encourage applicants to share any needed accommodations with their recruiter, who will treat these requests as confidentially as possible. While there is no specific deadline to apply for this role, U.S. roles are typically open for an average of 55 days before being filled by a successful candidate. Please refer to the date listed at the top of this job page for when this role was first posted. Block takes a market\-based approach to pay, and pay may vary depending on your location. U.S. locations are categorized into one of four zones based on a cost of labor index for that geographic area. The successful candidate’s starting pay will be determined based on job\-related skills, experience, qualifications, work location, and market conditions. These ranges may be modified in the future. Zone A: $163,600—$245,400 USD Zone B: $155,400—$233,200 USD Zone C: $146,900—$220,300 USD Zone D: $139,000—$208,600 USD**Application Guidelines** Candidates may submit up to 9 active applications within a 60\-day period. Reapplications to the same role are accepted 90 days after a previous application has been reviewed. **Use of AI in Our Hiring Process** We may use automated AI tools to evaluate job applications for efficiency and consistency. These tools comply with local regulations, including bias audits, and we handle all personal data in accordance with state and local privacy laws. Contact us here with hiring practice or data usage questions. *Every benefit we offer is designed with one goal: empowering you to do the best work of your career while building the life you want. Remote work, medical insurance, flexible time off, retirement savings plans, and modern family planning are just some of our offering.* *Block, Inc. jobs.title: Sr. Manager, Data Analyst
jobs.description: **About** Bloomingdale’s makes fashion personal and fun, aspirational yet approachable. Our mission is to guide and inspire our customers to make style a source of creative energy in their lives. We will always strive to make Bloomingdale’s like no other store in the world. Across all brand touchpoints — from Bloomingdales.com to our newest small store concept, Bloomie’s — everyone plays a critical role bringing our mission to life. Our inclusive culture promotes diversity of background, thought and opinion. Regardless of position, we believe all colleagues have a voice and access to share their thoughts with every level of leadership. Our colleagues are passionate, driven, entrepreneurial and collaborative, while having a lot of fun along the way. **Job Overview** Bloomingdale's is looking for a Senior Manager of Data Analytics to lead the company’s team in building industry\-leading dashboards, reporting, and insights. They will lead the integration and development of advanced analytics across the Marketing, Digital and Customer functions. The ideal candidate will have the technical aptitude to work with the Data Science and Data Engineering teams to create seamless transitions across the functions that derive key insights for business users to leverage in a usable format for making decisions. In addition, it is critical that they can translate complex concepts into simple, actionable ways for business users to understand and execute. The candidate will possess strong communication and organization skills to execute both short\- and long\-term projects. The Senior Manager of Data Analytics will be responsible for working with a wide variety of both Macy’s and Bloomingdale’s colleagues and external vendors on data requirements to support strategic business needs and developing the expertise of a team of Data Analysts. This person will report to the Senior Director of Data Science, Engineering and Advanced Analytics. **Essential Functions** * Recruit, lead, coach, and mentor a team of talented data analysts across, Digital, Marketing, Customer, and DEI functions in ushering a new era of innovative analytics at the company. * Lead alignment of best\-in\-class analytics for Bloomingdale’s including coordination with leadership. * Mentor team members in translating business requirements into technical solutions in a way that is responsive to the needs of stakeholders. * Balance both leading a team and jobs.description: Security Engineer, Senior**The Opportunity:** Everyone is trying to “harness the cloud”, but not everyone knows how to secure it.
