jobs.title: Associate Director, AI Transformation (US)
jobs.description: AI is transforming how brands and agencies create content at scale. Through an AI\-first approach and deep expertise across first\-party and third\-party generative AI solutions, we help brands and agencies transform their end\-to\-end creative workflows from ideation to activation, to deliver AI\-powered content services with speed, scale, and governance. We also function as a continuous product innovation engine, feeding repeatable customer solutions straight into the product roadmap to accelerate product\-led growth. This is a customer\-facing value and advisory role. You will bring a strong understanding of how the end\-to\-end content supply chain operates, from ideation and production through activation and measurement, so you can advise customers' creative teams with credibility and be accountable for the value each engagement is designed to deliver. **WHAT YOU'LL DO** * Engage with customer creative orgs to learn their brand system, production model, and the metrics leadership cares about * Communicate with executives through outcomes and insights (not status updates), and with designers, editors, and creative directors in their own language * Define and prioritize high\-impact use cases with stakeholders: build the value hypothesis, hold engagements accountable to it, and measure/communicate progress toward realized outcomes * Advise on deploying and scaling AI\-powered creative pipelines across the end\-to\-end content supply chain, helping customers grow from one proven workflow to full production volume * Recognize and mitigate risks from ill\-defined use cases, insufficient scale, and customer readiness gaps * Understand what creative teams care about and give honest guidance even when it's not what they want to hear * Facilitate workshops that help creative teams map their production flow to AI workflows * Bring in creative technology, engineering, product, and program specialists as needed * Keep cross\-functional teams aligned and synthesize customer feedback for product teams * Train customer teams and transition ownership cleanly so value continues after the engagement ends * Map future\-state AI\-powered workflows to current\-state processes and roles, and build a change\-management plan * Drive solution adoption through enablement sessions, demos, and partnership with Customer Success and Enablement teams **WHAT YOU'LL NEED** * A strong track record of owning business outcomes with enterprise customers, rather than simply completing tasks and moving on * Real instinct and confidence for building and sustaining trust with executives, including a willingness to reach out boldly rather than waiting to be looped in * A self\-directed style that creates momentum proactively, since this role rewards leading from the front over passive participation * Concrete examples of past work that translated into measurable business impact for a client * Hands\-on experience with creative production workflows or content supply chains, ideally gained at enterprise companies or agencies * A background in creative operations, digital asset production, or content supply\-chain management, specifically, is a plus * A genuine, end\-to\-end understanding of how the content supply chain works, from strategy and planning through production, activation, and measurement * Enough comfort with technology and product to hold credible conversations about feasibility and capability, ideally including hands\-on experience in the Adobe ecosystem (Creative Cloud, Firefly, or GenStudio) or working knowledge of AI creative platforms like ComfyUI, Runway, or Claude Design * Experience working within an agile, pod\-based software development lifecycle * Strong influence and facilitation skills, since this role involves coordinating specialists and cross\-functional teams without direct authority over them * Good judgment for knowing when a situation calls for bringing in deeper expertise rather than trying to solve it solo * Bonus points for familiarity with specific creative workflows such as Assets at Scale, 3D, video, or product\-asset production, or broader experience with AI\-enabled workflow transformation in a creative or content\-operations setting * Willingness to travel within the US (10–20%) **ABOUT US** Born in 2001, Code and Theory is a digital\-first creative agency that sits at the center of creativity and technology. We pride ourselves on not only solving consumer and business problems, but also helping to establish new capabilities for our clients. With a global client roster of Fortune 100s and start\-ups alike, we crave the hardest problems to solve. We have teams distributed across North America, South America, Europe, and Asia. The Code and Theory global network of agencies is growing and includes Kettle, Instrument, Left Field Labs, Create Group, Current, and TrueLogic. Striving never to be pigeonholed, we work across every major category: from tech to CPG, financial services to travel \& hospitality, government and education to media and publishing. We value the collaboration with our client partners, including but not limited to Adidas, Amazon, Con Edison, Diageo, EY, J.P. Morgan Chase, Lenovo, Marriott, Mars, Microsoft, Thomson Reuters, and TikTok. The Code and Theory network is comprised of nearly 2,000 people with 50% engineers and 50% creative talent. We're always on the lookout for smart, driven, and forward\-thinking people to join our team. *The compensation range for this role is $145,000 \- $200,000 and spans multiple levels. We're open to hiring at the level that best matches the right candidate's experience. Actual compensation is influenced by a wide array of factors including but not limited to skill set, level of experience, budget, and location.*

jobs.description: **Job Summary and Responsibilities** As an IT Software Engineer, you will be instrumental in elevating our user experience by designing, implementing, and enhancing robust applications within a dynamic, cloud\-hosted environment. You'll be at the forefront of digital transformation, contributing to every stage of the application lifecycle, from intricate configuration management to comprehensive testing. This role offers a unique opportunity to build scalable, maintainable solutions, directly impacting our operational efficiency and user satisfaction. If you're a skilled Salesforce developer with a passion for innovation and best practices, eager to tackle challenging projects, you'll thrive in our collaborative team. Every day you will leverage your expertise in Apex, LWC, and other Salesforce technologies to develop and maintain high\-quality solutions, ensuring they align with business requirements and architectural best practices. You'll engage directly with stakeholders to gather intricate business requirements, translating them into precise technical specifications. From meticulous unit and integration testing to leading peer reviews and managing the product lifecycle of assigned modules, your contributions will be vital. You'll also play a key role in supporting product release management functions, developing test plans, and ensuring a seamless transition to operational teams. Your excellent problem\-solving abilities, coupled with a meticulous attention to detail and strong debugging skills, will enable you to translate complex business problems into elegant technical solutions. Ideally, you'll hold Salesforce Certified Platform Developer I, with Platform Developer II being highly desired, showcasing your commitment to excellence and continuous learning.* Develops and maintains robust, scalable Salesforce solutions aligned with business needs and best practices. * Performs application design, configuration, testing, and implementation for medium to high complexity projects. * Translates business requirements into technical specifications for development or configuration build. * Leads product release management functions, including test plan development and user acceptance testing. * Manages the product lifecycle of assigned modules, including administrative tasks and enhancement requests. * Contributes to application standards, policies, procedures, and conducts peer reviews of configuration work. **Job Requirements** * Bachelor’s degree or equivalent knowledge and skills obtained through a combination of education, training, and experience in a Healthcare environment **Required** * 2\-4 years’ experience working in IT as an Application Systems Analyst or Technical analyst type role **Required** * **Preferred:** Salesforce Certified Platform Developer I Highly Desired: Salesforce Certified Platform Developer II Where You'll Work Inspired by faith. jobs.title: ERP Data Engineer
jobs.description: **JOB PURPOSE** The ERP/Data Engineer is responsible for administering and enhancing the organization’s ERP platform (SAP Business One), engineering data integrations, and managing the SQL Server environment to ensure reliable, high\-quality data operations. This role supports enterprise reporting, analytics, and system workflows by designing ETL processes, building data pipelines, and maintaining cross\-system data integrity. The ERP/Data Engineer acts as a key technical resource supporting SAP B1, SQL Server databases, business applications, ETL workflows, and reporting platforms, ensuring performance, accuracy, and security across mission\-critical systems. **ESSENTIAL JOB FUNCTIONS** ERP Administration (SAP Business One) · Administer SAP B1 including user provisioning, roles/permissions, license management, password resets, and account maintenance. · Develop and manage SQL\-based queries and SAP Query Manager reports to support operational and financial data needs. · Configure Boyum add\-on components including custom fields, validations, form logic, and workflow rules. · Create and manage SAP UDFs, UDTs, and modify database structures as required for business processes. · Perform data imports and structured uploads into SAP B1 using Data Transfer Workbench (DTW), ensuring high data quality and control. · Collaborate with SAP support partners for escalated issues, enhancements, and ERP optimization. Data Engineering, ETL, \& Integration Development · Design, build, test, and maintain new ETL workflows and data pipelines to enable reliable data movement between business systems. · Develop transformation logic, mapping rules, and data validation processes to ensure data consistency across platforms. · Troubleshoot integration failures, missing or unprocessed records, API issues, and message\-queue disruptions. · Implement monitoring, error handling, and alerting dataflows to proactively detect and resolve issues. · Work with business stakeholders to define data requirements, integration needs, and pipeline specifications. SQL Server Engineering \& Database Administration · Develop SQL Server schemas, tables, views, stored procedures, and SQL Agent jobs to support operational workflows. · Monitor, troubleshoot, and optimize SQL performance; maintain linked servers and scheduled job execution reliability. · Manage SQL Server security including user accounts, permissions, and audit logs. · Perform database restores, testing, and environment validation as required. · Execute database cleanup tasks, maintain staging areas, and ensure removal of outdated or resolved error records. **Application \& Cross\-System Support** · Serve as point\-of\-contact for field users experiencing EHR, ERP, or other application\-related issues, including access errors and system disruptions. · Manage application accounts, roles, dashboards, and custom reporting in Cobblestone Contract Management. · Ensure data synchronization accuracy between ERP and integrated business applications. · Participate in vendor meetings for system updates, implementations, and issue resolution. Business Intelligence \& Reporting · Develop dashboards and reports in Power BI, Tableau, and Report Builder to support decision\-making across the organization. · Build and manage SQL views and report datasets optimized for performance and accuracy. · Refresh and modernize legacy reports to align with current systems and business definitions. · Support future cloud\-based reporting initiatives and data warehouse integrations. Documentation, Quality, \& Continuous Improvement · Document ETL processes, data flows, integration logic, and system procedures. · Conduct data quality checks, implement validation routines, and improve error detection mechanisms. · Identify opportunities to automate and streamline operational tasks. · Support incident investigations with root cause analysis and corrective action plans. **QUALIFICATIONS** **Education \& Experience** · Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Data/Analytics, or a related field; equivalent combination of education and professional experience may be considered. · 5\+ years of experience in data engineering, ERP administration, SQL development, or related enterprise IT roles. Technical Skills · Strong proficiency in Microsoft SQL Server (T\-SQL, stored procedures, agent jobs, views, indexing, roles/permissions). · Experience with SAP Business One administration, Query Manager, DTW, and Boyum add\-ons preferred. · Understanding of ETL processes, data transformation methods, and pipeline development best practices. · Experience troubleshooting data integrations, APIs, and system\-to\-system workflows. · Hands\-on experience with BI tools (Power BI, Tableau, or similar). · Familiarity with cloud data concepts (Azure preferred). **Core Competencies** · Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and problem\-solving skills. · Ability to work in a fast\-paced environment with shifting priorities. · Excellent communication skills (written and verbal). · High attention to detail and strong documentation discipline. · Ability to maintain confidentiality and handle sensitive information responsibly. · Customer\-service orientation and teamwork mindset. **PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS** · Prolonged periods sitting or standing at a computer workstation. · Regular use of phones, video calls, and electronic communication tools. · Occasional lifting of office materials up to 50 lbs. **WORK ENVIRONMENT** · This is a hybrid role requiring onsite presence on a weekly basis. Remote work opportunities are available following successful onboarding and demonstrated proficiency in the role, subject to business needs. · Office environment with standard IT equipment. · Regular interaction with staff, vendors, and cross\-functional teams. · Deadlines and operational demands may require prioritization and rapid response. Disclaimer The above statements are intended to describe the general nature and level of work being performed by people assigned to this classification. They are not to be construed as an exhaustive list of all responsibilities, duties, and skills required of personnel so classified. All personnel may be required to perform duties outside of their normal responsibilities from time to time, as needed. Pay: $92,000\.00 \- $116,000\.00 per year Benefits: * 401(k) * Dental insurance * Flexible schedule * Health insurance * Paid time off * Vision insurance Work Location: Hybrid remote in Plymouth, MI 48170

jobs.title: Mechanical Systems Engineer
jobs.description: **About Us** We are a global climate technologies company engineered for sustainability. We create sustainable and efficient residential, commercial and industrial spaces through HVACR technologies. We protect temperature\-sensitive goods throughout the cold chain. And we bring comfort to people globally. Best\-in\-class engineering, design and manufacturing combined with category\-leading brands in compression, controls, software and monitoring solutions result in next\-generation climate technology that is built for the needs of the world ahead. Whether you are a professional looking for a career change, an undergraduate student exploring your first opportunity, or recent graduate with an advanced degree, we have opportunities that will allow you to innovate, be challenged and make an impact. Join our team and start your journey today! **Job Description:** ==================== The Systems Engineer works as part of a multi\-disciplinary team to undertake custom industrial refrigeration and gas compression system equipment design \- performing calculations, making component selections, and building documentation for our customers according to requirements of their project. The engineer supports the delivery of project related engineering results and is responsible for the work they're assigned by the Project Engineer. Success in this position requires the candidate to work efficiently in both a collaborative and independent environment, be safety conscious, have good interpersonal skills with both internal and external customers, pay high attention to details, and have a strong motivation for delivering objectives. **As A Systems Engineer, You Will:** ==================================== * Review and interpret codes and standards (ASME, CRN, NFPA, AWS, IBC, etc.) for system compliance. * Make system component selections while generating a project Piping and Instrumentation Diagram (P\&ID). Confer with Mechanical Design Engineers on standard products included in the project. * Conduct all necessary calculations, design reviews with production, and develop all custom documentation required for project execution. * Review and approve production drawings for custom systems, adding recommendations to improve design, reduce costs, or increase production efficiency. Chip in as a technical resource to the shop, customers, sales, and other departments to address and resolve questions and problems. * Prepare specifications for custom equipment and work with procurement to obtain quotations. * Participate in multi\-functional teams to address new design issues and resolve problems to ensure the continuous, ongoing improvement of processes and methods. **Required Education, Experience and Skills:** ============================================== * Bachelor's Degree in Mechanical Engineering or other relevant field with 1\+ years of engineering experience. Ability to understand and address a wide variety of technical problems with little mentorship. * Ability to communicate technical concepts clearly and concisely in writing and other presentation formats. Working experience with AutoCAD or similar 2D CAD software. * Must be an outstanding teammate, willing to learn from experienced staff and capable of introducing positive changes. Ability to travel 5\-10%. * Legal work authorization in the United States \- Sponsorship will not be provided for this role **Preferred Education, Experience \& Skills:** ============================================== * Previous experience with Compression systems or other pressure piping systems. Experience with Piping and Instrumentation Diagrams (P\&ID). * Understanding of manufacturing BOM structure and ERP. * Previous experience in heat transfer products or thermodynamic systems. * Ability to coordinate and lead teams with varied strengths to implement changes and improvements. \#LI\-Hybrid \#LI\-KC2 **Our Commitment to Our People** Across the globe, we are united by a singular Purpose: Sustainability is no small ambition. That’s why everything we do is geared toward a sustainable future—for our generation and all those to come. Through groundbreaking innovations, HVACR technology and cold chain solutions, we are reducing carbon emissions and improving energy efficiency in spaces of all sizes, from residential to commercial to industrial. Our employees are our greatest strength. We believe that our culture of passion, openness, and collaboration empowers us to work toward the same goal \- to make the world a better place. We invest in the end\-to\-end development of our people, beginning at onboarding and through senior leadership, so they can thrive personally and professionally. Flexible and competitive benefits plans offer the right options to meet your individual/family needs: medical insurance plans, dental and vision coverage, 401(k) and more. We provide employees with flexible time off plans, including paid parental leave, vacation and holiday leave. Together, we have the opportunity – and the power – to continue to revolutionize the technology behind air conditioning, heating and refrigeration, and cultivate a better future. Learn more about us and how you can join our team! **Our Commitment to Inclusion \& Belonging** At Copeland, we cultivate a strong sense of inclusion and belonging where individuals of all backgrounds, and with diverse perspectives, are embraced and treated fairly to enable a stronger workforce. Our employee resource groups play an important role in culture and community building at Copeland. **Work Authorization** Copeland will only employ those who are legally authorized to work in the United States. This is not a position for which sponsorship will be provided. Individuals with temporary visas such as E, F\-1 with OPT or CPT, H\-1, H\-2, L\-1, B, J or TN, or who need sponsorship for work authorization now or in the future, are not eligible for hire. **Equal Opportunity Employer** Copeland is an Equal Opportunity/Affirmative Action employer. We are committed to providing a workplace free of any discrimination or harassment. jobs.title: Drafting Technician – MEP Construction
jobs.description: Description: At Corvant, we provide specialty HVAC, plumbing, and mechanical services to mission\-critical commercial and industrial environments. Our teams support essential facilities across data centers, healthcare, manufacturing, logistics, and education. We deliver end\-to\-end solutions across the facility lifecycle, including design, prefabrication, installation, controls integration, and ongoing service. As one of the fastest\-growing platforms in our space, we are focused on operational excellence, technical expertise, and building a high\-performing team. We are currently seeking a Mechanical Drafting Technician for large commercial MEP construction projects. The Drafting Technician plays a vital role within the Virtual Design Coordination (VDC) department, supporting the design and planning of HVAC and plumbing systems for commercial construction projects. This position involves creating and reviewing technical drawings, managing submittals, and assisting project managers to ensure that all documentation, designs, and schedules are aligned with project goals. The Drafting Technician is responsible for working closely with various stakeholders, including internal teams, subcontractors, and vendors, to ensure that all project details are accurately captured and communicated. A strong background in mechanical trade knowledge, software tools like Revit, AutoCAD and Navisworks, as well as attention to detail, are essential for this role. The core areas of responsibility are listed below, however other duties and responsibilities may be required to meet business needs and objectives. Requirements: **Core Areas:** **Drafting \& Design Support:** * Create, update, and maintain accurate technical drawings for HVAC and plumbing systems using Revit, AutoCAD and other relevant Autodesk design tools. * Ensure that all designs meet company standards and project specifications. * Coordinate with engineers, project managers, and other team members to develop detailed, constructible designs and shop drawings. **Submittals \& Documentation:** * Prepare, review, and manage submittals, ensuring that all documentation is accurate, organized, and submitted within required timelines. * Measure and verify all submittals for accuracy, completeness, and compliance with project requirements. * Assist in the composition of RFIs (Requests for Information), ensuring clear communication and addressing any design discrepancies. **Project Manager Support \& Coordination**: * Provide drafting and design support to project managers by preparing drawings, schedules, and forecasts. * Help project managers by ensuring that all documents, including submittals, RFIs, and coordination drawings, are available and up\-to\-date. * Participate in meetings (both internal and external) to provide technical input and clarify design elements. **Scheduling \& Forecasting:** * Assist in the creation and updating of project schedules, ensuring that timelines are accurate, and forecasts reflect actual project progress. * Collaborate with project teams to forecast material needs, resources, and other design elements. **Software \& Tools:** * Use Viewpoint Teams to manage and track project documents, submittals, and RFIs. * Utilize Revit and AutoCAD for fabrication drawings, Revit for 3D design models, and Navisworks for model coordination. * Apply Bluebeam to mark up and review drawings and manage the document review process. **Organization \& Planning:** * Ensure that all project documentation, designs, and files are organized and accessible, both digitally and physically. * Assist with document management and version control to prevent errors and confusion during the project lifecycle. * Help maintain a well\-organized workflow and planning process for all design and drafting tasks. **Culture \& Teamwork:** * Foster effective communication with internal teams, subcontractors, and vendors to ensure smooth collaboration and the successful execution of projects. * Actively participate in internal and external meetings, contributing technical expertise and insights to enhance project outcomes. * Promote a positive and collaborative work environment by supporting colleagues and maintaining a focus on safety, efficiency, and quality. **Required Skills and Abilities:** * Proficiency in Revit, AutoCAD and Navisworks for drafting and design work. * Knowledge of Bluebeam and ProjectSight for document management and collaboration. * Strong understanding of trade concepts, especially for HVAC and plumbing systems. * Excellent organizational skills, with the ability to prioritize tasks and manage multiple projects simultaneously. * Ability to read and interpret construction documents, drawings, and specifications. * Strong communication skills, both written and verbal, with the ability to present technical information clearly to a variety of stakeholders. **Minimum Qualifications:** * Associate's degree or certification in Drafting, Mechanical Engineering, or a related field or equivalent experience. * Proficiency in Revit, AutoCAD and other Autodesk design, drafting and coordination software. * Familiarity with ProjectSight, Bluebeam, and Autodesk Forma and Procore preferred. * Basic knowledge of HVAC and plumbing systems, as well as related building codes and standards. **Physical Requirements** * Required to stand, walk, and sit. * Talk or hear, both in person and by telephone. * Use hand (s) and fingers to handle or feel objects or controls. * Reach with hand (s) and arm (s). * Regularly required to stoop, kneel, bend, crouch and lift up to 25 pounds \_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_ **Position Levels:** **Level 1:** * Entry\-level position with minimal experience in drafting and design. * Works under supervision to assist with the preparation of basic design documents and drawings. * Focuses on learning the company's design standards and developing proficiency with required software. **Level 2:** * Moderate experience in drafting and design, with the ability to work more independently. * Can prepare and update technical drawings with limited supervision. * Assists in the preparation of submittals, RFIs, and project forecasts. **Level 3:** * Advanced drafting and design experience, capable of managing more complex projects and tasks. * Can create, review, and update detailed drawings independently. * Assists with leading meetings, coordinating with project teams, and managing documentation for large projects. **Level 4:** * Expert\-level drafting professional with extensive experience in managing and coordinating all aspects of drafting for large\-scale mechanical projects. * Leads and mentors junior team members and ensures the smooth flow of information across the project lifecycle. * Demonstrates mastery in design tools and provides technical guidance to project managers and other teams. **Corvant is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees, fostering growth and opportunity regardless of race, color, religion, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, national origin, disability, veteran status, or any other protected status.** FLAOPS

jobs.title: Staff Machine Learning Engineer
jobs.description: We exist to wow our customers. We know we're doing the right thing when we hear our customers say, "How did we ever live without Coupang?" Born out of an obsession to make shopping, eating, and living easier than ever, we're collectively disrupting the multi\-billion dollar e\-commerce industry from the ground up. We are one of the fastest\-growing e\-commerce companies that established an unparalleled reputation for being a dominant and reliable force in South Korean commerce. We are proud to have the best of both worlds — a startup culture with the resources of a large global public company. This fuels us to continue our growth and launch new services at the speed we have been since our inception. We are all entrepreneurs surrounded by opportunities to drive new initiatives and innovations. At our core, we are bold and ambitious people that like to get our hands dirty and make a hands\-on impact. At Coupang, you will see yourself, your colleagues, your team, and the company grow every day. Our mission to build the future of commerce is real. We push the boundaries of what's possible to solve problems and break traditional tradeoffs. Join Coupang now to create an epic experience in this always\-on, high\-tech, and hyper\-connected world. **Role Overview** As our **Staff Machine Learning Engineer for Coupang Media Group (CMG), Offsite Ads**, you will be responsible for defining and building the next generation of machine learning systems, optimization platforms, and AI\-native advertising products that power Coupang's rapidly growing offsite advertising business. The Coupang Media Group (CMG) provides advertisers with a comprehensive suite of marketing solutions designed to help brands reach customers and accelerate business growth. While CMG established a leading advertising marketplace within Coupang's ecosystem, Offsite Ads extends advertiser reach beyond Coupang\-owned properties, enabling brands to engage customers across the broader internet while leveraging Coupang's unique commerce signals, first\-party audience assets, and deep understanding of shopper intent. Since its inception in 2025, the Offsite Ads business has experienced exceptional growth, achieving more than 2x year\-over\-year revenue growth for consecutive years. As we continue to scale, we are investing heavily in world\-class machine learning, large\-scale AI infrastructure, and next\-generation advertising technologies to build one of the industry's most advanced commerce media platforms. This is a unique opportunity to join and shape a fast\-growing organization with significant revenue impact and strategic importance to Coupang. You will work on some of the most challenging problems in modern advertising, including large\-scale prediction systems, bidding optimization, auction dynamics modeling, generative retrieval, foundation models, LLM\-powered advertising solutions, and agentic AI systems. Our vision extends beyond traditional offsite advertising. We are building the foundational technology that will evolve into a comprehensive advertising ecosystem spanning demand\-side platforms (DSP), supply\-side platforms (SSP), ad exchanges, and AI\-powered marketing solutions that connect advertisers with customers across the open internet. **What You Will Do** * Design and build machine learning models and systems that improve ad targeting, ranking, bidding, and campaign performance across Coupang's Offsite Ads platform. * Develop large\-scale prediction and optimization models, including CTR, CVR, GMV, and bidding optimization. * Apply modern AI technologies such as LLMs, embeddings, agentic AI, and deep learning to solve complex advertising challenges. * Build scalable ML infrastructure and production systems that enable rapid experimentation and reliable model deployment. * Define success metrics, evaluate business impact, and continuously improve model performance through data\-driven experimentation. * Partner closely with Product, Engineering, Data Science, and business teams to solve high\-impact customer and advertiser problems. * Drive projects from concept to production with strong ownership and accountability for business outcomes. * Mentor engineers and contribute to a culture of technical excellence, innovation, and continuous learning. **Basic Qualifications** * Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Machine Learning, Statistics, Mathematics, Electrical Engineering, or a related quantitative field. * 6\+ years of industry experience developing and deploying machine learning solutions in production environments. * Strong foundation in machine learning, deep learning, statistical modeling, optimization, and large\-scale data systems. * Hands\-on experience developing production\-grade ML systems using Python and/or Java. * Strong experience with PyTorch and modern deep learning architectures for prediction, ranking, recommendation, retrieval, or optimization problems. * Demonstrated ability to solve complex and ambiguous bu ch as PyTorch, XGBoost, LightGBM, Scikit\-learn, MLflow, Kubeflow, Spark, and Airflow. * Demonstrated ability to solve ambiguous problems, drive technical strategy, and deliver measurable business impact. * Strong communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to influence stakeholders across multiple functions. * Comfortable operating in a fast\-paced, high\-growth environment with a strong sense of ownership and customer focus. **Pay \& Benefits** Our compensation reflects the cost of living across several US geographic markets. At Coupang, your base pay is one part of your total compensation. The base pay for Staff position ranges from $164K/year to $282K/year. Pay is based on several factors including market location and may vary depending on job\-related knowledge, skills, and experience. **General Description of All Benefits** * Annual bonus is 0\-20% of the base salary * Medical/Dental/Vision/Life, AD\&D insurance * Flexible Spending Accounts (FSA) \& Health Savings Account (HSA) * Long\-term/Short\-term Disability * Employee Assistance Program (EAP) program * 401K Plan with Company Match * 18\-21 days of the Paid Time Off (PTO) a year based on the tenure * 12 Public Holidays * 6 weeks Paid Parental leave * Pre\-tax commuter benefits * MTV \- \[Free] Electric Car Charging Station **General Description of Other Compensation** "Other Compensation" includes, but is not limited to, bonuses, equity, or other forms of compensation that would be offered to the hired applicant in addition to their established salary range or wage scale. *Coupang is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to actual or perceived race (including traits historically associated with race, including but not limited to hair texture and protective hair styles), color, religion, religious creed (including religious dress and grooming practices), sex or gender (including pregnancy, childbirth, breastfeeding, and medical conditions related to pregnancy, childbirth or breastfeeding), gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, ,ancestry, national origin (including language use restrictions), age (40 and over), physical or mental disability, medical condition, genetic information, HIV/AIDS or Hepatitis C status, family status (including but not limited to marital or domestic partnership status), military or veteran status, use of a trained dog guide or service animal, political activities or affiliations, ancestry, citizenship, family and medical leave status, status as a victim of any violent crime, or any other characteristic or class protected by the laws or regulations in the locations where we operate.* **Recruitment Process and Others** **Recruitment Process** * Application Review \- Phone Interview \- Onsite (or Virtual Onsite) Interview – Offer * The exact nature of the recruitment process may vary according to the specific job and may be changed due to scheduling or other circumstances. * Interview schedules and the results will be informed to the applicant via the e\-mail address submitted at the application stage. **Details to Consider** * This job posting may be closed prior to the stated end date for application if all openings are filled. * Coupang has the right to rescind an offer of employment if a candidate is found to have submitted false information as part of the application process. * Those eligible for employment protection (recipients of veteran's benefits, the disabled, etc.) may receive preferential treatment for employment in accordance with applicable laws. **Privacy Notice** Your personal information will be collected and managed by Coupang as stated in the Application Privacy Notice located below: https://www.coupang.jobs/privacy\-policy/ *If you need assistance and/or a reasonable accommodation in the application of recruiting process due to a disability, please contact us at* *usrecruiting@coupang.com**.* **Requisition ID: R0078849**

jobs.description: Credit Acceptance is proud to be an award\-winning company recognized both locally and nationally across multiple workplace categories. Our world\-class culture is shaped by dedicated team members who are driven to succeed as professionals individually and together as a team. Backed by a strong product, exceptional people, and a stable financial foundation, we’ve grown into a leading provider of used and new car financing across the country. Our Engineering and Analytics Team Members utilize the latest technology to develop, monitor, and maintain complex practices that help optimize our success. Our Team Members value being challenged, are encouraged to express their ideas, and have the flexibility to enjoy work life balance. We build intrinsic value by partnering with all functions of our business to support their success and make strategic business decisions. We focus on professional development and continuous improvement while enjoying a casual work environment and Great Place to Work culture! At Credit Acceptance, the Staff Infrastructure Engineer is a senior individual contributor responsible for technical leadership of core infrastructure platforms, with a primary focus on compute, containerization, virtualization, and storage. This role is designed for an engineer who is deeply hands\-on and systems\-oriented, with a strong ability to solve infrastructure challenges through automation and code. This role provides technical leadership and mentorship but does not include people management responsibilities. The Staff Infrastructure Engineer owns complex, cross\-cutting infrastructure challenges, setting technical direction, and reducing operational friction across the environment. This role partners closely with engineering leadership, cloud, network, security, and application teams to design and evolve resilient, scalable, and cost\-effective infrastructure platforms. A defining characteristic of this role is a strong Infrastructure as Code (IaC) and automation mindset. The Staff Infrastructure Engineer approaches infrastructure as a software problem—using code, APIs, and automation to deliver repeatable, scalable outcomes, improve reliability, and accelerate delivery. In addition, this role is expected to explore and adopt emerging techniques such as AI\-assisted and agent\-based workflows where they meaningfully improve infrastructure operations and engineering productivity. **Outcomes and Activities** * This position will work from home; occasional planned travel to an assigned Southfield, Michigan office location may be required. However, this position is permitted to work at a Southfield, Michigan office location if requested by the team member * Provide technical leadership across compute, storage, networking, Linux, Windows and K8S platforms, ensuring high availability, performance, and security. * Design and implement enterprise\-scale infrastructure solutions that are maintainable, cost\-effective, and aligned with business strategy. * Act as a force multiplier by identifying systemic issues, simplifying complex systems, and reducing operational toil through automation. * Define and drive Infrastructure as Code (IaC) standards using tools such as Terraform, Ansible, PowerShell, Python, or equivalent. * Lead the evaluation, experimentation, and adoption of AI\-enabled tooling and agent\-based workflows for infrastructure operations, troubleshooting, and optimization. * Partner with Infrastructure, Cloud, Security, and Application teams to design end\-to\-end solutions spanning data center and cloud environments. * Perform impact analysis for complex changes and proactively identify risk across multiple systems and platforms. * Serve as a senior escalation point, leading root cause analysis and driving durable corrective actions. * Define, document, and socialize engineering standards, reference architectures, and best practices. * Mentor engineers and raise the technical bar through coaching, design reviews, and knowledge sharing. * Influence infrastructure and platform roadmaps and long\-term strategy in partnership with engineering leadership. * Participate in incident response, disaster recovery planning, and on\-call rotations as needed * Share technical design decisions and reference architectures for assigned domains, partnering with Infrastructure leadership for prioritization and alignment * Reduce operational toil, incident recurrence, or manual effort through platform improvements and automation Improve infrastructure reliability, scalability, or delivery velocity through sustained, measurable outcomes * **Competencies** : The following competencies describe how you will be successful in this role: * Customer Empathy: Customer Empathy is the ability to understand the perspectives, pain points, and experiences of customers. It involves actively putting oneself in the customer’s shoes, comprehending their needs and challenges, and using that understanding to provide a better, more custo nt platforms (Ansible, Puppet, etc.). * Experience with Kubernetes platforms and orchestration (Rancher, OpenShift, EKS Anywhere or similar). * Experience with observability and monitoring platforms. * Experience with disaster recovery design, execution, and testing. * Background influencing or defining platform or infrastructure strategy at the organizational level. * Deep experience with enterprise virtualization platforms such as VMware, including cluster design, lifecycle management, performance tuning, and availability. Exposure to or hands\-on experience with alternative or emerging hypervisor and virtualization solutions (e.g., KVM\-based platforms, cloud\-native virtualization, or vendor\-neutral hypervisors), including evaluation, proof\-of\-concept, or migration planning. * **Knowledge and Skills** * Demonstrated ability to own ambiguous, high\-impact problems, drive them to durable, well\-documented solutions. * Experience acting as a technical leader across teams—influencing architecture and outcomes without direct authority. * Strong troubleshooting skills with a track record of resolving complex production issues across multiple infrastructure layers. Curiosity and demonstrated interest in modern automation techniques, including AI\-assisted or agent\-based approaches, with a focus on practical operational value. * **Target Compensation:** A competitive base salary range from $122,001 – $178,935\. This position is eligible for an annual variable bonus of cash and equity, between 10\-20%. Bonus amounts are based on individual performance. Bonus amounts are based on individual performance. Final compensation within the range is influenced by many factors including role\-specific skills, depth and experience level, industry background, relevant education and certifications. INDENGLP \#zip \#LI\-Remote **Benefits** * Excellent benefits package that includes 401(K) match, adoption assistance, parental leave, tuition reimbursement, comprehensive medical/ dental/vision and many nonstandard benefits that make us a Great Place to Work **Our Company Values:** To be successful in this role, Team Members need to be: * Positive by maintaining resiliency and focusing on solutions * Respectful by collaborating and actively listening * Insightful by cultivating innovation, accumulating business and role specific knowledge, demonstrating self\-awareness and making quality decisions * Direct by effectively communicating and conveying courage * Earnest by taking accountability, applying feedback and effectively planning and priority setting **Expectations:** * Remain compliant with our policies processes and legal guidelines * All other duties as assigned * Attendance as required by department **Advice** ! We understand that your career search may look different than others. Our hiring team wants to make sure that this would be a fit not just for us, but for you long term. If you are actively looking or starting to explore new opportunities, send us your application! **P.S** . We have great details around our stats, success, history and more. We’re proud of our culture and are happy to share why – let’s talk! jobs.title: Director, Solutions Data Centers
jobs.description: **Job Title** Director, Solutions Data Centers **Job Description Summary** This individual leads the design and articulation of integrated facilities management (IFM) solutions for hyperscale, colocation, enterprise, and AI/HPC data center portfolios. This is a client\-facing, pursuit\-critical role that converts complex critical\-environment requirements into deliverable operating models, staffing plans, and commercial constructs. The role carries a deliberate and heavy emphasis on engineering solutioning and engineering staffing — building the critical\-facilities engineering organization that sits at the center of every data center mandate: staffing and shift\-coverage models, licensure and qualification matrices, wage and total\-rewards strategy, labor\-market feasibility, and recruiting ramp plans. **Job Description** **ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS \& RESPONSIBILITIES** * Lead solution architecture for data center IFM pursuits — new business, expansions, renewals, and rebids — across single\-site, regional, and global portfolios. * Interrogate client requirements (RFI/RFP/RFQ, SLAs, KPIs, MOPs/SOPs, uptime standards, Uptime Institute tier and criticality classifications) and translate them into a defensible operating model. * Build the labor model, organizational chart, span of control, and scope matrix that underpin the price — and defend every assumption in internal governance and client\-facing sessions. * Partner with Sales, Operations, HR, Talent Acquisition, Procurement, Finance, EHS, Sustainability, Legal, and Technology to assemble one integrated solution rather than a collection of functional inputs. * Author and orchestrate the technical response: solution narrative, staffing plan, mobilization and transition plan, technology stack, governance model, risk register, and assumptions and exclusions schedule. * Lead solution workshops, site walks, due\-diligence visits, and client orals; present and defend the engineering and FM approach to client engineering leadership and procurement. * Conduct win/loss reviews and feed outcomes back into standard solution assets, benchmark libraries, and pricing templates. * Maintain a reusable library of data center solution components — role profiles, coverage models, PM libraries, scope matrices, and benchmark staffing ratios. * Design the critical\-facilities engineering operating model: on\-site engineering teams, 24x7x365 shift coverage, on\-call and escalation structures, remote operations center integration, and vendor\-augmented models. * Solution the maintenance program across all critical systems — MV/LV electrical distribution, switchgear, UPS and battery plant, static transfer switches, PDUs, generators and fuel systems, chillers, CRAC/CRAH units, pumps, cooling towers, liquid cooling and direct\-to\-chip systems for AI/HPC densities, BMS/EPMS, fire detection and suppression, and building envelope. * Set the engineering technology approach: CMMS/EAM configuration, asset hierarchy and tagging standards, BMS/EPMS integration, remote monitoring, analytics, digital twin and reliability reporting. * Quantify the engineering solution — headcount, overtime, shift differentials, tools, test equipment, PPE, training, spares and critical\-spares strategy, and subcontracted specialist services. * Build engineering staffing models by site and by portfolio: role mix (Chief Engineer, Critical Facilities Manager, Lead/Shift Engineer, Critical Facilities Engineer, Controls/BMS Technician, Electrical and Mechanical Technicians, Fire Life Safety specialists, EHS and Compliance roles), FTE counts, shift rotations, relief factors, vacation and absence coverage, and overtime assumptions. * Define qualification and licensure matrices by jurisdiction — electrical and mechanical licenses, stationary/operating engineer licenses and client\-specific critical\-environment certifications. * Partner with Talent Acquisition on the recruiting ramp plan — sourcing channels, pipeline build ahead of award, hiring sequencing against go\-live, contingency and contractor bridge strategies. * Benchmark proposed engineering ratios (engineers per MW, per critical system, per square foot) against internal and industry data, and articulate the rationale for any deviation. **REQUIRED EDUCATION, EXPERIENCE AND QUALIFICATIONS** **Required** * Bachelor's degree in Mechanical or Electrical Engineering, Facilities/Construction Management, or a related technical discipline; equivalent military or trade\-progression experience will be considered. * 10\+ years in facilities management, critical facilities operations, or engineering services, including 5\+ years with direct data center or mission\-critical environment accountability. * 5\+ years in FM solutions development, bid management, or a senior operations role with direct ownership of staffing models and cost build\-ups. * Demonstrated experience building critical\-facilities engineering staffing models and defending them to sophisticated technical clients. * Working command of data center infrastructure: electrical distribution and redundancy topologies (N\+1, 2N, 2N\+1\), UPS and generator systems, mechanical cooling including liquid cooling, BMS/EPMS, and fire life safety. * Fluency in FM commercial models, SLA/KPI regimes, and pricing mechanics; advanced Excel modeling capability. * Excellent written and verbal communication; able to author a technical solution narrative and present it to C\-suite and engineering audiences alike. * Willingness to travel domestically (typically 25\-30%). **Preferred** * Experience supporting hyperscale, colocation, or AI/HPC clients and their standardized operating requirements. * Certifications such as PE, CEM, CFM, ATD/ATS (Uptime Institute), CDCP/CDCS, PMP, LEED AP, or NFPA 70E * Experience with union environments, prevailing wage. * Global or multi\-region portfolio solutioning experience. * Prior experience with major CMMS/IWMS platforms and asset data standardization. **OTHER DUTIES** This job description is not designed to cover or contain a comprehensive list of activities, duties or responsibilities that are required of the employee. Other duties, responsibilities and activities may change or be assigned at any time with or without notice. Cushman \& Wakefield also provides eligible employees with an opportunity to enroll in a variety of benefit programs, generally including health, vision, and dental insurance, flexible spending accounts, health savings accounts, retirement savings plans, life, and disability insurance programs, and paid and unpaid time away from work. In addition to a comprehensive benefits package, Cushman and Wakefield provide eligible employees with competitive pay, which may vary depending on eligibility factors such as geographic location, date of hire, total hours worked, job type, business line, and applicability of collective bargaining agreements. The compensation that will be offered to the successful candidate will depend on factors such as whether the position is covered by a collective bargaining agreement, the geographic area in which the work will be performed, market pay rates in that area, and the candidate’s experience and qualifications. The company will not pay less than minimum wage for this role. The compensation for the position is: $ 144,500\.00 \- $170,000\.00 Cushman \& Wakefield is an Equal Opportunity employer to all protected groups, including protected veterans and individuals with disabilities. Discrimination of any type will not be tolerated. In compliance with the Americans with Disabilities Act Amendments Act (ADAAA), if you have a disability and would like to request an accommodation in order to apply for a position at Cushman \& Wakefield, please call the ADA line at **1\-888\-365\-5406** or email Accommodations@cushwake.com. Please refer to the job title and job location when you contact us. INCO: “Cushman \& Wakefield”

jobs.title: Sr. DevOps Engineer [545]
jobs.description: **D\-Wave Quantum Inc. (NASDAQ: QBTS)** is a leader in the development and delivery of quantum computing systems, software, and services. It is the world’s first commercial supplier of quantum computers, and the first and only to offer dual\-platform quantum computing products and services, spanning both annealing and gate\-model quantum computing technologies. D\-Wave’s mission is to help customers realize the value of quantum today through enterprise\-grade systems available on\-premises and via its Leap™ quantum cloud service, which offers 99\.9% availability and uptime. More than 100 organizations across commercial, government, and research sectors trust D\-Wave to address complex computational challenges using quantum computing. Learn more about realizing the value of quantum computing today and how D\-Wave is shaping the quantum\-driven industrial and societal advancements of tomorrow: www.dwavequantum.com. **About the role** D\-Wave is seeking a Senior DevOps Engineer to join our DevOps team in New Haven, reporting to the DevOps Engineering Manager. In this role, you will design, build, and operate hybrid infrastructure platforms spanning on\-premises environments, Kubernetes clusters, cloud services, and CI/CD pipelines. Your primary focus will be on developing and operating on\-prem Kubernetes platforms, while supporting cloud environments such as AWS. You will also play a key role in advancing our observability capabilities, improving system visibility through logging, metrics, dashboards, and alerting. Working closely with hardware, software, and DevOps teams, you will own systems end\-to\-end and drive improvements in how infrastructure is provisioned, automated, and maintained. This role is ideal for an engineer who enjoys working across the stack, solving complex operational challenges, and building reliable, scalable platforms. **What you'll do** * Design, build, and operate Kubernetes platforms, primarily on\-prem, including cluster architecture, networking, storage, and lifecycle management * Develop and maintain hybrid infrastructure across on\-prem and cloud environments with a focus on reliability, scalability, and maintainability * Design and optimize CI/CD pipelines (e.g., GitHub Actions) to enable automated, low\-touch build and release processes * Manage AWS infrastructure, including multi\-account environments, IAM, networking, and shared services * Implement and maintain infrastructure\-as\-code and automation solutions (e.g., Terraform, Ansible) * Design and operate virtualized platforms and VM\-based workloads * Define and enforce standards for containerization, including image management, versioning, and security practices * Build and support containerized applications running on Kubernetes (on\-prem and cloud\-based) * Develop and mature observability platforms, including metrics, logging, dashboards, and alerting * Design actionable monitoring and alerting systems to improve reliability and incident response * Support infrastructure for hardware\-integrated systems, including OS deployment and lifecycle management * Improve operational efficiency by automating manual processes and enhancing system reliability * Collaborate cross\-functionally to ensure consistent practices across hybrid environments * Participate in incident response and root\-cause analysis, driving continuous improvement **About You** * Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or equivalent practical experience * 4\+ years of experience in DevOps, infrastructure, or systems engineering * Deep, hands\-on experience architecting and operating bare metal Kubernetes platforms from the ground up in production environments, including cluster design, networking, scalability, and reliability * Strong Linux system administration and troubleshooting skills in production environments * Experience working with AWS, including multi\-account environments * Experience designing and operating CI/CD pipelines * Proficiency with infrastructure\-as\-code and automation tools (e.g., Terraform, Ansible) * Experience with Docker and containerized workloads in production * Experience with virtualization platforms (e.g., VMware, KVM, Proxmox, Hyper\-V) * Familiarity with monitoring and observability tools (e.g., Prometheus, Grafana, ELK, Zabbix) * Solid understanding of networking fundamentals (e.g., VLANs, routing, firewalling) * Ability to own systems end\-to\-end in complex, distributed environments **A D\-Waver's DNA** * We look at the future and say “why not”; we see possibilities where others see problems or routines. We show the way ahead and are committed to achieving ambitious goals. * We practice straight talk and listen generously to each other with empathy. We value different opinions and points of views. We ensure that we connect outside as well as inside to learn from others and inspire each other. * We hold ourselves accountable for delivering results. We make decisions \& take responsibility so that we can act \& support each other. * As leaders we motivate \& engage our teams to undertake beyond what they originally thought possible, by developing our teams \& creating the conditions for people to grow and empower themselves through enabling \& coaching. **Our Compensation Philosophy is Simple but Powerful:** We believe providing D\-Wavers with company ownership, competitive pay, and a range of meaningful benefits is the start of creating a culture where people want to give the best they’ve got — not because they’re simply making money, but because they’ve fallen in love with our vision, mission, values, and team. **During the interview process, your Recruiter will review our total rewards (base, equity, bonus, perks, benefit, culture) offerings. The final offer is determined by your proficiencies within this level.** **Inclusion:** We celebrate diverse perspectives to drive innovation in our pursuit. Our employees range from distinguished domain experts with decades of experience in their respective fields, to bright and motivated graduates eager to make their mark. Our diverse and innovative team will make you feel appreciated, supported and empower your career growth at D\-Wave. **The Fine Print:** No 3rd party candidates will be accepted *It is D\-Wave Systems Inc. policy to provide equal employment opportunity (EEO) to all persons regardless of race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, sexual orientation, gender identity, genetic information, physical or mental disability, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state/provincial, local law.* The base pay range for this role is: $124,000 – 186,000 USD per year (New Haven)

jobs.title: Staff Software Engineer, Agent Quality
jobs.description: **Staff Software Engineer \- Agent Quality** ============================================ #### **P\-1567** At Databricks, we are obsessed with enabling data teams to solve the world’s toughest problems, from security threat detection to cancer drug development. We do this by building and running the world’s best data and AI platform so our customers can focus on the high\-value challenges that are central to their own missions. The Databricks AI Research organization is pushing the frontier of next\-generation enterprise AI. We believe a company's data is its greatest competitive advantage, and we're building the models and agents that unlock it. Our work spans the full stack, from model training to advanced multi\-agent systems. As a Staff Software Engineer \- Agent Quality, you will be a founding member of a new team focused on evaluating and continuously improving Databricks' AI Agents. You will design and scale the infrastructure, tooling, and developer workflows that let researchers and engineers evaluate agents rigorously — driving a flywheel where evaluation results feed directly back into agent improvement across the full lifecycle, from development and training to production. **The impact you will have** ---------------------------- * Stand up the foundational evaluation infrastructure for Genie Agents, enabling rigorous benchmarking, regression detection, and quality measurement across research and product teams. * Build the flywheel that connects evaluation results back into agent improvement — closing the loop between production signals, training, and iterative development. * Shape the long\-term technical direction for agent quality infrastructure, with real influence over how Databricks measures and improves its first\-party agents and agent development platform. * Help shape the long\-term technical direction for agent quality infrastructure as Databricks expands its first\-party agents and agent development platform. **What we look for** -------------------- * 6\+ years industry experience building software systems * Strong Python programming skills, with experience building production or research infrastructure * Experience building or operating distributed systems, data pipelines, or large\-scale infrastructure with a focus on reliability, correctness, and operational maturity * Ability to design pragmatic but rigorous systems that produce trustworthy, reproducible signals for complex applications * Comfort working across ambiguous research and product boundaries, and partnering with both researchers and engineers to turn ideas into robust internal platforms * A high bar for technical quality, strong ownership, and the ability to influence roadmap and execution across multiple teams **Nice to have** ---------------- * Experience with devtools, CI/CD platforms, testing frameworks, observability tooling, or benchmarking infrastructure * Familiarity with how LLM or agent quality is measured — whether through evals, experimentation platforms, or production monitoring **Pay Range Transparency** Databricks is committed to fair and equitable compensation practices. jobs.title: Data Engineering Lead
jobs.description: At Deckers Brands, Together, Every Step is a promise kept that every employee can bring their authentic self, is valued and supported, as a whole person, at work and beyond. Together, Every Step is how we continue to deliver exceptional business results, experience an amazing place to work, and have a positive impact on the communities and world around us. **Job Title:** Data Engineering Lead **Reports to:** Sr. Manager, Data \& ML Engineering **Location:** US (Remote) Interested applicants must reside in one of the following approved states: Arizona, California, Colorado, Indiana, Massachusetts, Minnesota, New York, Oregon, Pennsylvania, Texas, Utah, Washington **The Role** As the Data Engineering Lead, you will be the senior technical voice within Deckers’ data and ML engineering organization. You’ll provide hands\-on leadership for data engineering design, build quality, and delivery standards across our enterprise data products. This role is all about setting the bar for technical excellence—establishing design patterns, coding standards, and review gates for distributed engineering teams, including external partners. You’ll build engineering capability through design review, pairing, coaching, and structured knowledge transfer, ensuring our data products are reliable, scalable, and ready to power business decisions. **We celebrate diversity\-of your background, your experiences and your unique identity. We are committed to ensuring an inclusive and equitable workplace where all of our employees can Come as They Are. We believe that when we bring our different perspectives to work, we are truly Better Together.** **Your Impact** * Provide day\-to\-day technical leadership for data engineering design, build quality, and delivery standards across enterprise data products. * Review designs and enforce coding standards across internal and partner engineering, acting as the technical review gate before build begins on significant work. * Own engineering standards for model design and naming, code review, CI/CD, testing, documentation, and deployment practices across distributed teams. * Lead the design and delivery of analytics\-ready data models and transformation layers using dbt, including staging, intermediate, and mart layers with tests, documentation, and governed release workflows. * Build and operate cloud\-native ingestion, transformation, and delivery pipelines on AWS, focusing on reliability, performance tuning, and cost efficiency. * Establish and maintain reusable data engineering patterns for ingestion, transformation, and delivery so that solutions are repeatable. * Provide technical direction across distributed engineering teams, including external delivery partners, and hold the technical quality of their output to Deckers standards. * Coach and develop data engineers and analytics engineers through design review, pairing, technical guidance, and structured knowledge transfer. * Reduce key\-person dependency by documenting engineering patterns, designs, and runbooks so that critical knowledge is retained by the organization. * Drive data quality practices within engineering, including source definitions, freshness monitoring, automated tests, reconciliation, and lineage expectations. * Lead root cause analysis and remediation for complex production data issues, strengthening patterns and controls. * Translate business needs from finance, sales, supply chain, product, and consumer stakeholders into scalable data engineering designs. * Partner with data architecture, cloud engineering, and security to align data product designs with enterprise architecture, security, privacy, and compliance requirements. **Who You Are** * Bachelor’s degree required, preferably in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or a related technical field; Master’s degree preferred. * 8–10 years of experience building enterprise\-grade data platforms, pipelines, and analytics\-ready data models. * 3\+ years providing technical leadership on data engineering delivery, including design review and standards enforcement. * Hands\-on experience using dbt as a primary transformation framework in production, including model design, testing, documentation, CI/CD, and release practices. * Strong experience delivering data pipelines on AWS (e.g., S3, Redshift, Glue, Athena, Lambda) and cloud data warehouse platforms. * Experience providing technical direction to distributed engineering teams, including external delivery partners. * Experience with data quality practices including automated testing, reconciliation, freshness monitoring, and lineage. * Experience supporting machine learning and advanced analytics use cases through curated, feature\-ready datasets is preferred. * Deep expertise in dimensional modeling and analytics engineering, including dbt best practices and SQL performance tuning. * Strong AWS data engineering skills including pipeline reliability, performance tuning, and cost awareness. * Ability to set and hold engineering standards across teams the role does not directly manage. * Strong design review, technical coaching, and knowledge transfer skills. * Ability to translate ambiguous business requirements into scalable and repeatable engineering designs. * Proficiency in SQL and Python, with working knowledge of orchestration tooling such as Airflow. * Familiarity with AI\-assisted development workflows and their application to pipeline development, refactoring, and documentation. * Excellent problem\-solving and root cause analysis skills. * Strong communication skills across technical and business stakeholders. * Comfortable working in a fast\-paced, matrixed, and global environment. **What We'll Give You –** * **Competitive Pay and Bonuses** **\-** We’ve created a variety of competitive compensation programs to foster career development, reward success and to show our employees just how much they’re valued. * **Financial Planning and wellbeing** **\-** No matter what financial goals our employees have set, we want to help them get there. Our plans provide powerful ways to protect income, pay for expenses and invest in the future. * **Time away from work** **\-** Sometimes we need time away to be with family, focus on our health or just simply recharge. Our plans support our employees’ needs to get out, get healthy and come back stronger than ever. * **Extras, discounts and perks** **\-** Being a valued member of the Deckers Brands team means more than just a paycheck. From generous discounts to community\-based programs, we offer a variety of cool extras * **Growth and Development** **\-** Deckers Brands was built on the idea of pursuing passion. That’s why we offer extensive opportunities and support for personal and professional development. * **Health and Wellness** **\-** There’s nothing basic about our comprehensive health and wellness programs and offerings. While at work and at play, we aim to support a healthy lifestyle. $122,300\.00 \- $165,000\.00 The salary range posted reflects the estimated minimum and maximum target for new hire salaries for this role in: Goleta, California (Remote) Individual pay will be determined by location and additional factors, including job related skills, experience, and relevant education or training. Your recruiter can share more about the specific salary for your preferred location during the hiring process. **Equal Employment Opportunity** **Diversity and inclusion are key to our success. We are proud to be an equal opportunity employer, and our employees are people with different strengths, experiences and backgrounds who share a passion for our brands. We welcome qualified applicants regardless of their race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, national origin, age, military or veteran status, mental or physical disability, medical condition and all the other beautiful parts of your identity.**

jobs.title: AI Engineering Associate
jobs.description: Dext Capital is a National, innovative, financial services company headquartered in the Portland Metro area. Dext offers strong benefits and is committed to leveraging technology while enabling our employees to grow in a high\-performance environment **Job Duties/Responsibilities:** * Work with departments such as Credit, Collections, Accounting, Marketing, Legal, and HR to understand their manual processes and find opportunities for AI automation * Turn business processes into working AI automations and help build a pipeline of future use cases with department leaders * Help design, build, and maintain reusable Claude Skills, Connections, and Plugins that departments can use directly, working jobs.title: Support and Community Specialist
jobs.description: ### **Role: Support and Community Specialist** **Department: Support** **Location: Nashville, Tennessee** **Reports into: Head of Support \- Americas (based in New York)** **Contract: Full Time** **About the role** Disguise is opening a hub inside Rock Nashville. This role is to be the primary Disguise representative at this location, as part of the Global Support Team. You will be the first person in that room. This is a support role first, with community and relationships being the core focus. You will be the face of Disguise to the touring world in Nashville, and the person video crews, screen programmers, production designers and content teams come to find when they want to test an idea, unblock a problem or learn something new, locally. You will build genuine relationships with the people who run the biggest tours in the world, and you will earn those relationships by being useful and by helping to reaffirm Disguise as the best products and partner best for the live industry. You will provide frontline software support on Disguise software and related systems, diagnose and repair basic hardware issues, provide in person and remote technical support, and be a certified trainer to raise the skill level of the local community. This role suits someone who is technically credible and genuinely enjoys people. *You will be based in the Disguise hub at Rock Nashville 4 days per week, with occasional travel to client sites, rehearsal venues and industry events. Flexibility to work occasional odd hours and weekends around rehearsal and load\-in schedules.* **What you will do** **Technical Support** * Provide frontline software support on Disguise Designer and related software to touring users in the region, including issues that surface during production rehearsals. * Take ownership of high\-priority cases and communicate directly with customers through to resolution. * Diagnose and resolve minor hardware issues on Disguise servers in the building, including imaging, licensing, cabling and component swaps. * Prepare and maintain demo systems in the office for customer sessions, testing and issue reproduction. **Community and Residency** * Act as the Disguise presence in Nashville, building and maintaining relationships across the touring production community, local vendors and partners to create an open door that touring professionals use by choice, not just when something breaks. * Run the office space day to day, hosting visiting crews, informal sessions and hands\-on time on Disguise systems. * Deliver training sessions, workshops and user meetups for local programmers, designers and video crews. * Represent Disguise at local industry events, and support trade shows and demos as required. **Feedback and Knowledge** * Report software and hardware issues to the Development and QA teams with clear, reproducible detail. * Feed field intelligence on touring workflows, competitive activity and unmet needs back to Product, Sales and Marketing. **Experience we are looking for** * **Disguise expertise:** Strong proficiency in Disguise Designer as a show programmer, in\-venue support engineer, or equivalent. Experience with other media servers such as Pixera, Watchout or Hippotizer will also be considered. * **Touring background:** Direct experience on large\-scale touring music productions, working closely with video teams under live deadlines. * **Video engineering:** Solid experience working on projects with video signals and routing, including progressive versus interlaced, colour bitrate, sampling, genlock and reading schematics. * **Troubleshooting:** Proven experience diagnosing complex technical problems calmly and quickly. * **Community instinct:** A track record of building relationships in a technical industry. You are known and trusted by people who work in production, and you enjoy teaching. * **Self\-direction:** Comfort operating with a remote/small team in a remote location. * **Nashville presence:** Existing roots in the Nashville production community, or a clear commitment to building them fast. **Skills, behaviours and values we are looking for** * High level of attention to detail: able to keep reports and documentation up to date * Winning mindset: being brave, bold and striving for growth * Driven: being proactive and passionate in seeking what might not immediately be apparent * Dependable: being both a team player and autonomous agent to drive results * Dynamic: being able to pivot quickly with an abundance of energy and resilience * No Ego: being approachable, authentic and humble **About Disguise** Disguise is the industry\-leading platform sitting at the heart of a new era of visual experiences. One powerful integrated system of software, hardware and services to help create the next dimension of real\-time spectacle. We partner with the biggest entertainment brands and companies in the world to deliver the A\-list of live music events, live TV broadcasts, immersive experiences, installations, theatre, film and TV production, corporate communications and brand product launches.
