jobs.title: Senior SOC Engineer - Agentic
jobs.description: **About SANS** Founded in 1989, SANS Institute (SANS) began as a cooperative research and education organization. Over the next 25 years, it grew to become the most trusted and widely recognized provider of information security training and certification in the world. Today, SANS has served more than 300,000 cybersecurity professionals around the world, with more than 60,000 earning Global Information Assurance Certification (GIAC) security certifications—the leading certification that provides assurance to employers that their people and prospective hires can do the job. At the heart of SANS is a community of practitioners, from auditors and network administrators to CISOs, who share their lessons learned and collaborate on solutions to the challenges they face. These experts, working across corporations, government agencies, and universities, come together to support and strengthen the global information security community. **Why SANS?** At SANS, our culture is defined by three pillars: Mission, Brand, and People. * Our Mission is to hire people who understand the importance fighting against cybersecurity threats. * Our Brand reflects a commitment to delivering the highest quality training. * Our People are grounded in a culture of fairness, honesty, customer focus, and a pragmatic approach. **What You’ll Achieve at SANS** We are seeking a *Senior SOC Engineer \- Agentic* to join our Security team. This role is a dual\-focus security engineering role. On one side, this engineer owns the design and buildout of our agentic SOC — building the detection engineering, automation, and AI agent infrastructure that allows a lean security team to operate at the scope of a much larger one. On the other, they serve as a hands\-on security engineer across the full breadth of the program: vulnerability management, cloud security, identity and access management, application security, architecture reviews, and compliance support. Initially the role will split roughly evenly between these two tracks. As the Agentic SOC matures and AI agents absorb more of the operational workload, the balance will shift — but the security engineering work never goes away. This is a role for someone who wants to do real security engineering today while building the systems that redefine what security engineering looks like tomorrow. As a *Senior SOC Engineer \- Agentic*, you will: * **Agentic SOC Buildout** + Design the architecture of the agentic SOC. Define how data flows through the detection and response pipeline, how agents are structured and orchestrated, where human\-in\-the\-loop checkpoints belong, and how the overall system evolves as we expand agent autonomy. + Build and own detection engineering. Write, tune, and maintain detections across our internal SIEM environment. Treat detection content as code — version\-controlled, peer\-reviewed, tested, measured. Establish the lifecycle of design deploy measure tune improve. + Translate SOC operations into automation. Identify the alert triage, investigation, and response work that is ripe for agent augmentation, and define what good looks like for each workflow before it gets handed to an agent. + Build automations and integrations across our stack. Connect our MSSP, EDR, SIEM, cloud infrastructure, and identity platforms through integrations, scripts, and playbooks — both deterministic automation where that is the right tool, and agent\-driven workflows where it is not. + Partner with AI Engineering to build and govern the agent stack. Co\-design the MCP servers and tool integrations that let agents work with security systems. Contribute to prompt design, evaluation harnesses, and feedback loops — and own the audit trails and checkpoints that keep agent actions safe and accountable. + Operate and improve. Monitor agent performance, investigate failures, tune behavior, and feed real\-world outcomes back into the system. The job does not end when something ships. * **Security Engineering** + Vulnerability management. Own the vulnerability identification, prioritization, and remediation tracking program. Work with engineering and infrastructure teams to drive risk reduction across the environment. + Cloud security. Assess and improve cloud security posture across AWS and Azure — identity and access management (IAM) policy review, configuration hardening, cloud\-native detection, and ongoing posture monitoring. + Identity and access management. Partner with IT and engineering on identity architecture, access reviews, privilege management, and authentication standards. + Application security. Conduct code reviews, threat models, and security assessments for internal applications and integrations. Partner with development teams to shift security left. + Security architecture reviews. Evaluate new technologies, integrations, and infrastructure changes for security risk. Provide pragmatic, risk\-based guidance. + Compliance and audit support. Support security compliance activities, evidenc  live with what you build. If you cannot sit with them and understand the work, you will build the wrong things. * Comfort with ambiguity. This program is being built, not maintained. * Unrestricted authorization to work in the USA; visa sponsorship is not available. Preferred qualifications include: * Experience with MSSP\-managed detection and response environments. * Detection\-as\-code experience: CI/CD pipelines for detection content, automated testing, content packaging. * Prior experience building SOAR playbooks (Tines, Torq, Cortex XSOAR, Splunk SOAR, or equivalent). * Incident response experience beyond Tier 1 — you have owned investigations end to end. * Cloud detection and response experience: audit logging, threat detection services, cloud security posture. * Identity\-focused detection experience (Entra, Okta, Active Directory, or similar). * Any hands\-on experience with LLM tooling: building with LLM APIs, agent frameworks (LangGraph, CrewAI, etc.), or MCP servers — even hobby\-level. * Familiarity with agentic development workflows — CLAUDE.md, Claude Code, GitHub Copilot/Codex, or similar AI\-assisted engineering tools. * Prompt injection and LLM adversarial thinking — particularly relevant since security agents constantly read attacker\-controlled data. **Benefits and Perks of Working at SANS** We’re committed to fair and equitable compensation. The expected salary range for this position is **$155,000 to $205,000 which is comprised of base salary and bonus**, depending on geographic location, skills, and experience. At SANS, pay equity and transparency are priorities. We offer a comprehensive benefits package that supports your total well\-being so you can be and deliver your best. This means caring for you and your loved ones' physical, financial, and mental health, as well as providing the flexibility you need to thrive personally and professionally: * **Financial Benefits**: Competitive base salary, bonus opportunities, and a 401(k) plan with company match. * **Health \& Wellness**: Robust medical, dental, and vision plans; company\-provided short term disability; optional long\-term disability, supplemental life and AD\&D insurance for employees and dependents; voluntary benefits including accident insurance and identity theft protection; fitness and wellness programs; and a company paid employee assistance program (EAP). * **Time Off \& Flexibility**: Generous paid time off, including volunteer time. * **Learning \& Development**: Access to professional development and SANS training opportunities. **Flexibility and Balance at SANS** We support our colleagues with the tools and flexibility they need to thrive, both professionally and personally. As a primarily remote work environment, we are committed to maintaining strong connections, collaboration, and a vibrant culture across virtual teams. While most roles operate remotely, some positions may require occasional in\-person presence depending on role\-specific or business needs. **SANS is an Equal Employment Opportunity Employer** SANS is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. We do not discriminate based on race, color, sex, age, national origin, religion, sexual orientation, gender identity, veteran status, disability, or any other federal, state, or local protected class. If, because of a medical condition or disability, you require a reasonable accommodation during the application process, or to perform the essential functions of a position, please contact SANS Human Resources. US Job Seekers: Click here to view the “Know Your Rights” poster. S ANS complies with all applicable state and local laws regarding the consideration of applicants with arrest or conviction records. For positions governed by federal and/or state banking regulations, SANS will adhere to relevant requirements when evaluating candidates with criminal histories. Employment eligibility in the United States is required. SANS does not provide visa sponsorship for this position.

jobs.title: Director, Product & Program
jobs.description: **About Savo** Savo™ is building the world’s first Human Intelligence Platform—capturing people’s unfiltered words in real time and transforming them into actionable insights. Our AI\-powered platform conducts real\-time, voice\-based structured interviews grounded in measurement science. A multi\-agent system extracts behavioral and cognitive signals from spoken language and translates them into evidence\-backed intelligence. We replace intuition and anecdote with science\-backed human intelligence. We're a small team of passionate builders just out of stealth, and we're looking for "unlocks" to help us scale. Learn more at savo.ai. **The Role** We’re looking for a Director who sits at the intersection of product and program. You own the sense\-making, requirement gathering, operations, coordination and execution of our roadmap end\-to\-end. You look around corners, connect the dots across disciplines, and turn ambitious product bets into shipped software. You bring operational rigor, deep product judgment, and technical fluency. You translate strategy into executable plans, hold the program together across engineering, science, and design, and own whether what we ship actually lands. This is a remote role with occasional travel (5–10%) for onsite and customer meetings. This is a builder role. You will design how Savo plans, ships, and validates work, then put that model into the tooling so it runs without being chased. Our stack is deliberately lean and still taking shape, which means the operating model you design is the one the company runs on. This role matters because: * Our platform sits at the intersection of real\-time voice, LLM inference, psychometric measurement, and enterprise data. It’s a frontier with few established playbooks and a hundred moving parts * We’re scaling quickly, and we can only move fast if someone owns roadmap execution end\-to\-end and makes the in\-flight calls without escalating every decision * Science, engineering, product, and customers all need to stay in lockstep, and that doesn’t happen by itself * Our product is a scientific measurement instrument, not just software. Release discipline must cover both feature quality and whether the measurements we produce can be trusted and defended **What You’ll Do** **Build the operating system** * Design how work moves from strategy through roadmap, development, and deployment, then build that model into our program management tooling (e.g., Linear, Asana, Jira) and the systems around it. The standard is a system people use because it is faster than the alternative * Build the automation layer yourself with AI enablement and developer collaboration: integrations across Linear, Slack, and Google Workspace, plus the scripts, agents, and workflows that generate status, metrics, and communications rather than a person assembling them **Own Roadmap Execution** * Own the execution of the product roadmap end\-to\-end, from PRD in hand through shipped, adopted, and measured * Run the operating system: requirements inputs, sprint cadence, backlog discipline, milestones, dependencies, critical paths, and a realistic read on the dates we’d like to hit * Make the in\-flight calls on scope, sequencing, and tradeoffs within your areas; escalate only the genuinely cross\-cutting decisions * Own outcomes alongside ship\-dates: did the bet move the metrics, did customers actually use it, did we learn what we set out to learn * Feed reality back into roadmap planning: what’s actually shippable, where the dependencies sit, what we’re learning from the work **Connect the Dots and Surface Tradeoffs** * Sit at the intersection of product, engineering, applied science, user experience, and customer operations, translating between them so no one is flying blind * Look around corners: spot the dependency nobody is talking about, the assumption that’s about to break, the customer commitment that’s about to collide with the roadmap * Surface the hard calls: scope vs. timeline vs. quality, build vs. buy, ship now vs. harden first. Either make them or shepherd the decision, depending on whose seat the tradeoff sits in **Drive Release Readiness and Quality** * Own the “is this shippable?” signal: coordinate QA, regression testing, user testing, launch checklists, rollout plans, and rollback criteria * Verify that what we said we’d build is what we actually shipped, and that the system operates as expected end\-to\-end * Build the operational rhythm (deploy cadence, incident response, on\-call norms) that earns enterprise client trust * Know when to cut scope to ship and when to hold the line on quality **What We’re Looking For** **Product and Program Craft** * Track record of owning product execution at high velocity and large scale: driving the decisions, the deliverables, and the outcomes for product areas you’ve been accountable for * Deep experience building complex, multi\-functional delivery teams from early\-stage chaos to enterprise\-grade repeatability, with command of sprints, backlogs, dependencies, and the instinct for which rigor to add when * Strong product judgment: you understand the product deeply, know the users, and can hold your own in any product conversation **Technical Fluency** * Technical self\-sufficiency: You have operated a production system and carried the responsibility when it broke. You can self\-serve data (SQL, notebooks), read a diff and a log and tell us what happened, and hold a technical position with an engineer without deferring. * You know how to work with engineers: ask the right questions, pin them down for the information you need, and surface the conversation the team hasn’t had yet * Conceptual grasp of AI/LLM systems, real\-time infrastructure, and other complex technology stacks. You know how they fail, how to test them, and what “release\-ready” looks like. * Experience shipping and operating scientific measurement instruments: products where the output is a score, rating, or classification about a person, and where the accuracy and defensibility of that measurement is a release\-blocker, not a nice\-to\-have **Mindset** * Curious: You ask, “what are we missing?” more than you say “we can’t” * Connector: You see the whole board, and you can’t stand watching good work fall through the cracks because nobody bridged the gap * Humble: You know what you don’t know, and you pull in the people who do * Builder: You’d rather move the program forward than be right on paper **Benefits** * Opportunity to shape the future of Narrative Intelligence from the ground up * Competitive salary and equity package in a high\-growth startup * Comprehensive health, dental, and vision insurance * Flexible work arrangements with remote options * Professional development budget for conferences and continuing education * Collaborative, innovative work environment with direct impact on product direction * Regular team events and company retreats * Paid time off and company holidays * 401(k) retirement plan

jobs.title: Manager, Technology Equipment Interference (TEI)
jobs.description: As a leader in Lawful and Location Intelligence, SS8 helps make societies safer. Our commitment is to extract, analyze, and visualize the critical intelligence that gives law enforcement, intelligence agencies, and emergency services the real\-time insights that help save lives. Our high performance, flexible, and future\-proof solutions also enable mobile network operators to achieve regulatory compliance with minimum disruption, time, and cost. SS8 is trusted by the largest government agencies, communications providers, and systems integrators globally. **Overview** We are seeking a Manager, Technology Equipment Interference (TEI) to lead a specialized technical team that evaluates, develops, integrates, and operationalizes technologies enabling authorized interaction with target technology environments and equipment, in support of government intelligence, investigative, and public\-safety missions. This role sits within SS8's broader Tactical Intelligence capability and works closely with Mediation, Location, Monitoring, Data Intelligence, and AI teams to deliver an integrated intelligence ecosystem rather than isolated technology products. The ideal candidate combines strong technical knowledge, operational understanding, leadership capability, and customer engagement skills — someone technically curious, mission\-focused, and entrepreneurial enough to build a new capability area and move it from concept to operational solution, while operating with the judgment and discretion sensitive intelligence technologies demand. **What You'll Do** ***Team Leadership*** * Build, lead, mentor, and develop a highly specialized multidisciplinary TEI technical team; establish technical priorities, roadmap, and performance objectives. * Create an environment that encourages innovation, technical excellence, and disciplined execution, working closely with engineering, product, tactical solutions, and customer\-facing teams — success here means standing up a world\-class TEI team. ***Technology \& Capability Development*** * Lead evaluation and development of technologies supporting authorized TEI and related tactical intelligence capabilities. * Define technical architectures and integration requirements, overseeing prototyping, testing, and transition into supported solutions. * Ensure TEI capabilities integrate effectively with SS8's broader intelligence platform. ***Operational Integration*** * Connect TEI capabilities across the SS8 portfolio: Mediation (lawful acquisition/delivery of communications and network data), Location (identifying and locating relevant devices/targets), Monitoring (authorized collection capabilities), and Data Intelligence \& AI (correlation, analysis, and AI\-driven prioritization). * Deliver an integrated intelligence ecosystem — measured by successful integration of TEI into SS8's broader Tactical and Intelligence portfolio and identification of strategic technology partners. ***Customer \& Mission Engagement*** * Engage directly with authorized government, intelligence, law\-enforcement, and public\-safety customers to understand operational requirements. * Translate mission requirements into technical and product requirements; participate in demonstrations, workshops, and trials. * Serve as a trusted technical SME supporting business\-development and sales teams on complex engagements — listening carefully to operational users and translating their challenges into requirements. ***Technology Partnerships*** * Identify technology companies, specialist vendors, and strategic partners that could extend SS8's TEI capabilities. * Evaluate potential technologies and lead technical due diligence for partnerships, licensing, investments, or acquisitions. * Develop integration strategies bringing external capabilities into SS8's broader intelligence ecosystem. ***Product \& Technology Strategy*** * Develop and maintain the TEI technology and capability roadmap; monitor developments in communications, mobile, cybersecurity, AI, and tactical intelligence technologies. * Identify technology gaps, recommend build/buy/partner/acquire strategies, and advise senior leadership on risks and opportunities — success is defined by delivering new capabilities that address validated customer requirements, and accelerating demonstrations and deployments while building reusable rather than one\-off capabilities. ***Security, Legal \& Compliance*** * Ensure all TEI activities are conducted within applicable legal authorities, customer authorizations, export\-control requirements, and SS8 governance. * Work closely with Legal, Compliance, Security, and executive leadership when evaluating new technologies; maintain appropriate controls and promote security\-by\-design practices throughout the team — a non\-negotiable measure of success in this role. **Required Experience \& Qualifications** * Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Telecommunications, Cybersecurity, or a related discipline, or equivalent professional experience. * Significant experience in telecommunications, cybersecurity, lawful intelligence, government technology, tactical systems, or related advanced technology environments. * Demonstrated experience leading technical or engineering teams. * Strong understanding of modern telecommunications and IP\-based communications technologies. * Experience taking complex technical capabilities from concept/prototype through integration and operational deployment. * Ability to communicate effectively with engineers, operational users, government customers, and senior executives — collaborative enough to work across engineering, product, sales, legal, security, and executive leadership. * Experience operating in environments involving sensitive or restricted information. **Nice to Have** * Experience with lawful intelligence, lawful interception, intelligence platforms, or government investigative technologies. * Understanding of mobile networks (LTE/5G), IP networking, and wireless technologies. * Familiarity with AI/ML and its application to intelligence analysis and operational workflows. * Experience working with U.S. and/or international government agencies, including classified or highly sensitive programs. * Experience evaluating technology companies for partnership or acquisition. * Advanced technical degree or equivalent specialized experience. **Join a company where your ideas, expertise, and ambition can make a real difference.** At SS8, we're committed to fostering a culture of collaboration, innovation, and continuous growth. Whether you're developing new solutions, supporting customers, or driving business success, you'll be part of a team that values your contributions and invests in your future. **Compensation \& Benefits** The expected base salary range for this position is $150,000 – $190,000\. Actual compensation will be determined based on the candidate's skills, experience, and qualifications. This role is also eligible to participate in SS8's corporate bonus program, subject to the terms of the applicable plan. We offer a comprehensive benefits package including medical, dental, vision, 401(k) with company match, and paid time off. At SS8 Networks, our approach to flexible work is centered on trust and optimized for culture, connection, clarity, and the evolving needs of our business. This role is hybrid, meaning it will be performed both from home and from SS8's Herndon, VA office on select days, as determined by the business needs of the team. SS8 does not accept unsolicited resumes from staffing agencies, search firms, or third parties. Any resumes submitted without a signed agreement in place will be considered the property of Company, and no fees will be paid if a candidate is hired as a result.

jobs.title: Digital Content Manager
jobs.description: SambaNova is a leader in next\-generation AI infrastructure, delivering a full\-stack inference platform for customers worldwide. At the core of SambaNova's technology is the RDU (Reconfigurable Dataflow Unit) — a chip built on a dataflow architecture rather than the traditional GPU model. Its decode performance is especially strong for agentic workloads like multi\-turn agents, code generation, and long\-running applications. jobs.title: 2027 Spring Co op CMC Synthetics Platform Process and Pharmaceutical Engineering Scientist Cambridge MA
jobs.description: **Job Title:** *2027 Spring Co\-op CMC Synthetics Platform Process and Pharmaceutical Engineering Scientist* * **Grade:** *Co\-op* * **Location:** *Cambridge, MA* * **Duration:** *6 months* **About the Job** Looking to launch your career at the cutting edge of healthcare? Join Sanofi for a chance to develop with mentoring and guidance from inspirational leaders while helping to make an impact on the lives of countless people worldwide. As **Spring Co\-op** in our **CMC Synthetics Platform Process and Pharmaceutical team**. As a co\-op in Pharmaceutical Engineering team of the CMC Synthetics Platform, you will contribute to advancing our understanding of how material properties at the particle and crystal scale influence downstream manufacturability and drug product performance. This position offers a unique opportunity to work across material science, process engineering, and computational modeling in support of next\-generation pharmaceutical development. This role will focus on bridging fundamental particles and crystal properties with process\-scale behavior in tablet manufacturing. The successful candidate will work on projects spanning single crystal property prediction, powder compaction simulation, and experimental analysis of tablet mechanical failure using digital image correlation (DIC). Through this work, you will help build mechanistic understanding and predictive tools that improve formulation robustness and manufacturability. We believe that integrating material science, simulation, and material sparing experimental techniques is critical to the future of pharmaceutical process development. In this role, you will have the opportunity to work at that interface—applying engineering fundamentals and material science tools to solve real development challenges, generate new scientific insight, and help advance more efficient and predictive approaches to oral solid dosage manufacturing. Ready to grow your skills while helping shape the future of healthcare? At Sanofi, you’ll be empowered to learn, ask questions, and bring your ideas to life – all while supported by inspiring mentors and collaborative teams. **About Sanofi** We’re an R\&D\-driven, AI\-powered biopharma company committed to improving people’s lives and delivering compelling growth. Our deep understanding of the immune system – and innovative pipeline – enables us to invent medicines and vaccines that treat and protect millions of people around the world. Together, we chase the miracles of science to improve people’s lives. **Main Responsibilities:** * Predict and analysis of single crystal material properties relevant to pharmaceutical development, including mechanical behavior, elastic properties, and anisotropy. Assist in evaluating how crystal structure and morphology influence downstream processing and manufacturability * Design and execute experimental studies to characterize tablet mechanical performance, including diametral compression and dynamic breakage testing. Use digital image correlation (DIC) and related imaging tools to quantify strain localization, crack initiation, and failure mechanisms. * Integrate experimental and modeling results to improve mechanistic understanding of material\-process\-performance relationships. Collaborate with scientists and engineers to translate findings into predictive frameworks that support formulation and process design. **About You** **Basic Qualifications:** * Currently pursuing a Master's or PhD degree in Chemical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Materials Science, Pharmaceutical Engineering, Biomedical Engineering, or related technical field. * Must be permanently authorized to work in the U.S. and not require sponsorship of an employment visa (e.g., H\-1B or green card) at the time of application or in the future. Students currently on CPT, OPT, or STEM OPT usually require future sponsorship for long term employment and do not meet the requirements for this program unless eligible for an alternative long\-term status that does not require company sponsorship. * Must be enrolled in an accredited college or university throughout the duration of the co\-op/internship. * Must be able to relocate to the office location and work 40hrs/week, Monday\-Friday, for the full duration of the co\-op/internship. * Strong interest in material science, solid mechanics, and pharmaceutical process engineering. * Familiarity with data analysis and scientific programming (e.g., Python, MATLAB, R, or similar). * Strong problem\-solving skills and attention to detail. * Autonomy and interest in lab experiments. * Ability to work collaboratively in a team environment. * Excellent communication skills to interact with scientists and engineers. **Preferred Qualifications:** * Exposure to solid\-state chemistry, crystal structure analysis, powder mechanics, or pharmaceutical unit operations. * Familiarity with molecular and solid\-state modeling tools such as Mercury, Materials Studio, or related crystallographic / molecular simulation software. * Experience with computational modeling tools (e.g., finite element methods, Abaqus, COMSOL, or similar). * Familiarity with experimental mechanics or imaging methods such as digital image correlation. * Experience analyzing scientific data and presenting technical results. **Why Choose Us** * Bring the miracles of science to life alongside a supportive, future focused team. * Stretch your skills through apprenticeships, internships, graduate programs, and international experiences that grow with you. * Learn from inspiring mentors and collaborative teams while contributing to real projects that shape the future of healthcare. Build your future with access to the latest tools, digital innovation, and continuous learning that keep you ahead of the curve. * **Compensation** The salary range for this position is **$45\-$57** hourly. All compensation will be determined commensurate with demonstrated experience. \#LI\-Onsite \#vhd

jobs.title: Software Engineer | Observability
jobs.description: SingleStore engineers build the real\-time data platform powering some of the world's most demanding applications. Our cloud\-native architecture enables high\-performance transactional and analytical workloads at scale, and our teams ship production code continuously throughout the year. We operate in a fast\-moving, highly collaborative environment where engineers own their work end\-to\-end and partner closely across Product, Sales, and Go\-To\-Market teams to deliver meaningful business impact. **Position Summary** We are seeking a Software Engineer to join the Observability Team and play a critical role in designing and delivering core capabilities for SingleStore's observability platform. This is a hands\-on engineering role with end\-to\-end ownership of features and projects at the intersection of distributed systems, cloud infrastructure, database technology, and AI\-powered observability. As a Software Engineer on this team, you will solve complex system\-level problems, contribute meaningfully to technical direction, and partner with Product and customer\-facing teams to ensure our platform meets the needs of enterprise customers and new adopters alike. What the team provides: Comprehensive customer observability over their workloads — enabling customers to understand their usage patterns, identify bottlenecks, optimize performance, and leverage powerful alerting capabilities. Our platform unifies traces, logs, and metrics through an open\-source\-first approach. This is an ideal role for an engineer who thrives on deep technical challenges, takes pride in building durable systems, and is excited about bringing AI\-powered observability experiences to customers. **What you'll do:** * Design and implement scalable observability features for traces, logs, and metrics — spanning ingestion, processing, storage, and visualization * Work across control plane and data plane components in a multi\-cloud environment (AWS, GCP, Azure), ensuring reliable operation and data consistency at scale * Build high\-throughput data pipelines that process telemetry data using OpenTelemetry Collector and related open\-source tooling * Develop and maintain alerting capabilities with Alertmanager, enabling customers to define, tune, and manage alerts with routing, inhibition, and notification management * Optimize time\-series data storage and query performance using SingleStore DB, handling high\-cardinality data and complex analytical queries * Contribute to data visualization dashboards in Grafana, creating intuitive customer\-facing experiences to explore telemetry data * Collaborate closely with Product Management to translate customer and business requirements into robust technical solutions * Investigate and resolve difficult issues in production and development environments, debugging data synchronization across distributed systems and cloud providers * Participate in on\-call rotations to ensure system reliability and respond to incidents promptly #### **Your Experience:** * 2\+ years of professional software development experience building distributed systems or backend services * Strong proficiency in Go (Golang) — experience with Rust, Python, or C\+\+ is also valuable * Deep understanding of distributed systems concepts: scalability, consistency, high availability, concurrency, and failure modes * Familiarity with distributed systems managed via Kubernetes * Demonstrated ability to design and build reliable, high\-performance system software * Experience working in environments where performance, scalability, and reliability are critical * Familiarity with observability concepts: traces, logs, metrics, APM, and monitoring patterns * Strong problem\-solving and debugging skills with the ability to root\-cause complex production issues * Excellent communication skills, both written and verbal, with ability to collaborate in multicultural, remote\-first teams * Code quality mindset: you value simplicity, performance, maintainability, and thorough testing **Preferred Qualifications** * Experience with time\-series data and understanding of metrics cardinality challenges * Proficiency with SQL and experience working with relational or distributed databases * Experience building cloud\-native SaaS platforms with multi\-tenant architecture * Multi\-cloud experience: working with AWS, GCP, Azure, or other cloud providers in a production setting * Kubernetes proficiency: operating, monitoring, or developing for Kubernetes clusters * Open\-source observability tools: hands\-on experience with Grafana, Alertmanager, Loki, Tempo, OpenTelemetry Collector, OTLP protocol * OpenTelemetry expertise: experience with, or active contributions to OTel projects * Time\-series database experience: Prometheus TSDB, InfluxDB, Mimir, TimescaleDB, or SingleStore * Experience with data pipeline technologies: Apache Kafka, Parquet, Arrow, or stream processing frameworks (Flink, etc.) * Experience working with AI agents or LLM\-powered applications, including agentic workflows for observability — enabling customers to query telemetry data in natural language * Experience in a SaaS or cloud\-native company delivering managed services to customers **About us:** SingleStore delivers our cloud\-native database with the speed and scale to power the world's data\-intensive applications. With a distributed SQL database that introduces simplicity to your data architecture by unifying transactions and analytics, SingleStore empowers digital leaders to deliver exceptional, real\-time data experiences to their customers. SingleStore is venture\-backed and headquartered in San Francisco with offices in Sunnyvale, Raleigh, Seattle, Boston, London, Lisbon, Bangalore, Dublin and Kyiv. Consistent with our commitment to diversity \& inclusion, we value individuals with the ability to work on diverse teams and with a diverse range of people. *To all recruitment agencies: SingleStore does not accept agency resumes. Please do not forward resumes to SingleStore employees. SingleStore is not responsible for any fees related to unsolicited resumes and will not pay fees to any third\-party agency or company that does not have a signed agreement with the Company.* SingleStore values individuals for their unique skills and experiences, and we're proud to offer roles in a variety of locations across the United States. You will work on the full GenAI stack hands\-on. **Build data and evaluation infrastructure.** Write data pipelines, labeling workflows, and evaluation frameworks. Reliable evals are a first\-class deliverable on this team. **Work on manufacturing, supply chain, and physical operations problems.** Slate operates a factory with a real supply chain. You will be exposed to AI problems in both areas: computer vision for quality inspection, predictive maintenance, and sensor data on the physical side; demand forecasting, inventory planning, supplier risk, and logistics on the supply chain side. We are particularly interested in candidates who are drawn to this kind of work. **Collaborate across the organization.** Work with Vehicle Engineering, Manufacturing, and Operations to understand requirements and translate them into AI systems that produce measurable output. **Who You Are** --------------- **Technically grounded in ML.** You understand how models are trained and evaluated, not just how to call an API. You have built something end\-to\-end — a project, a thesis, a production system — that demonstrates that. **Interested in physical and operational AI.** Candidates drawn to the intersection of AI and the physical world — manufacturing systems, robotics, logistics, industrial data — will find the most to work on and will ramp fastest. Not a requirement, but a clear differentiator. **A fast learner.** The GenAI landscape moves quickly and so does Slate. You pick up new tools and domains without needing everything handed to you. **Hands\-on.** You write code, run experiments, and ship things. jobs.title: Instructional Design Manager
jobs.description: **Job title \- Instructional Design Manager** Employment type \- Contract, with potential to convert to perm Engagement model \- Agency W\-2 Work location \- 100% remote Travel \- None expected Bill rate range \- To be confirmed Expected hours \- 40 hours per week Contract duration \- TBD Extension likely \- Month to month Conversion to perm \- Possible by mutual agreement, at $75,000 \- $95,000 Openings \- 1 Target start date \- Before the end of October 2026 **About Slater Certified®** Slater Certified® is an AI\-powered workforce development platform for the water and wastewater sector. It delivers self\-paced training that prepares professionals for licensure and continuing education, built around G.A.I.L. (Generative Artificial Intelligence Learning) \- an interactive tutor that gives real\-time feedback, personalized explanations and adaptive support, so someone studying on demand still gets guidance. The flagship course is a 40\-hour Wastewater Class 3 Operator Training recognized by the Georgia Secretary of State, alongside a 24\-hour continuing education course and an industrial wastewater program. Organizations can run a customized version, Powered by Slater Certified®, against their own workforce. Slater Certified, LLC is the workforce development arm of Slater Infrastructure Group, LLC \- an Alpharetta, Georgia infrastructure services firm founded in 1997, working across operations and maintenance, construction engineering and inspection, and environmental services for public and private clients. Slater Certified launched in July 2025 and is licensed in Alabama, California, Florida, Georgia and Mississippi. The team is small and moves fast. Technology choices are modern and made by the people who have to live with them, so the distance between an idea and a decision is short, and the distance between a decision and shipping it is shorter. Work is remote and the schedule is flexible. Ownership sits with the person doing the work, and there is real room to shape how things get built rather than inheriting someone else's process. **Position summary** Slater Certified® is an AI\-powered workforce development platform for the water and wastewater sector. We have a live catalog of courses, a generative AI tutor sitting alongside them, and considerably more content to build than we currently have the capacity to build well. We are hiring an Instructional Design Manager to own how our content gets made. This is a craft role first: taking raw material \- a technical manual, a regulation, an hour with a subject matter expert \- and turning it into a course that a working adult will actually finish. It is also a build\-from\-requirements role: given what a course needs to cover, you scope it, design it, and produce it. It starts as a contract role and it starts hands\-on, with no one reporting to you. As the content function grows, this is the role the other learning content creators report into. If it works on both sides there is a path to converting it to a full\-time position. **What this role owns in the first six months** * Has designed and shipped at least one full course end to end \- structure, content, assessments and supporting media. * Has built content for more than one learning style on the same material, rather than producing one format and calling it a course. * Has a documented, repeatable development process that someone else could follow, covering scoping, SME input, review and sign\-off \- the thing a growing content team will run on. * Has taken at least one course from a written requirement to a finished product without needing the requirement rewritten first. * Can point to a measurable improvement in learner completion or assessment performance on the courses worked on. **Key responsibilities** **Instructional design and content development** * Design and build course modules, assessments and learning pathways. * Build for different learning styles on the same material \- reading, video, worked example, practice, scenario, assessment \- so learners are not forced through one format. * Apply adult\-learning practice to an audience of working operators with limited study time. * Produce and direct supporting media: video, diagrams, scenario\-based exercises. * Keep content SCORM and xAPI compliant and fit for delivery on our platform. **Building courses from requirements** * Take a requirement \- from a customer, a regulator, or our own roadmap \- and scope what the course has to cover. * Run the discovery yourself: what the learner already knows, what the job actually demands, what the assessment has to prove. * Turn raw source material into a teaching structure \- a manual, a standard, a specification, or an hour with someone who has done the job for twenty years. * Estimate and schedule content work honestly, and hold the dates. **Subject matter experts, quality and review** * Work directly with our wastewater SMEs to get the technical content right. * Run the review process: SME va l feedback loop from learners. * Hold version control and change history on every course. * Keep content current as regulations, exam blueprints and industry practice change \- our courses carry state approvals, and the documentation behind them has to hold up. **Working with the platform** * Work with product and engineering so content fits how the platform delivers and assesses it. * Work with G.A.I.L., our generative AI tutor, so the content and the tutor reinforce each other rather than duplicating. * Use learner analytics to find where people stall, and fix the content rather than explaining the number. **Working solo, and working remotely** * This is a fully virtual role. You will work alone most of the day, with no one sitting next to you and no one checking whether you started. * Reach out first. Much of your input comes from software engineers, product and subject matter experts who are deep in their own work and will not volunteer it. * Keep your own pipeline full \- know what the next three pieces of work are, and go and get the direction you need rather than waiting to be handed it. * Say when you are blocked, early and in writing, rather than absorbing it quietly. **Growing into the team lead** * Set the content standards and templates the next hires will work to. * Review and raise the quality of other people's content as the team grows. * Help hire the content creators who will eventually report into this role. **Must have** * 5\+ years in instructional design, curriculum development or technical training development. * Genuine instructional design craft \- can take raw source material and build a course from it, not just produce content someone else has structured. * Designs for multiple learning styles and modalities on the same material, and can explain why each choice was made. * Has built courses from a written requirement, including doing the scoping rather than waiting for a specification. * Fluent in adult\-learning practice and competency\-based design. * Hands\-on with an LMS or LXP, and with SCORM / xAPI. * Can take a technical subject from a subject matter expert and turn it into something a non\-academic adult learner will actually finish. * Excels working solo. This is a fully virtual role and long stretches of it are unsupervised. * Proactive about pulling work and direction \- chases software engineers, product and SMEs for what is needed instead of waiting, and keeps their own queue full. * Ready to grow into leading a small content team, and wants to. **Nice to have** Construction\-sector experience is a significant advantage, and wastewater or industrial wastewater experience is a very significant one. Someone who has been on or around a plant already understands the work our learners do, and that shortens the ramp on every course we build. * Experience designing for a regulated or certification\-bearing field, or with state licensure and continuing education approval processes. * Has built assessments validated against an external exam. * Has managed or mentored other instructional designers or content creators. * Has used generative AI as part of a content development workflow. * Accessibility standards (WCAG, Section 508\) applied in practice. **Rate, term and conversion** Bill rate range \- To be confirmed Engagement model \- Agency W\-2 Expected hours \- 40 hours per week Overtime \- By prior written approval only Contract duration \- TBD Extension \- Month to month Conversion to perm \- Possible, by mutual agreement Salary band on conversion \- $75,000 \- $95,000 (Band B3\) Expenses \- Not reimbursable unless agreed in advance Benefits \- Not provided by Slater Certified during the contract term Work environment \- 100% remote Slater Certified® is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants receive consideration without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, veteran status, or any other protected characteristic.

Slater Certified launched in July 2025 and is licensed in Alabama, California, Florida, Georgia and Mississippi. The team is small and moves fast. Technology choices are modern and made by the people who have to live with them, so the distance between an idea and a decision is short, and the distance between a decision and shipping it is shorter. We are selling and building at the same time, with a small team and a lot of moving parts: prospects in conversation, clients being onboarded, courses in development, and commitments made in a sales meeting that engineering then has to deliver. We are hiring a Project Manager on a contract basis to be the bridge between sales and delivery. You hold the single picture of where everything stands \- who is in the pipeline, who is in flight and how far along they are, what we can sell today, what is coming and when, and what each of those depends on. When sales asks whether we can commit to a date, you are the person who knows. You will work directly with the VP of Sales, the CTBO and the engineering team, keeping logistics and pipeline moving. It is part project manager, part coordinator, part meeting facilitator \- hands\-on, no direct reports, and a lot of detail that nobody else is going to pick up. and leadership all use and all trust \- not three spreadsheets that disagree. * The existing pipeline, built up so far by our business development lead, has been taken over and turned into something that runs as a system rather than living in one person's head. * Every client in flight has a plan, a timeline, a named status and a next action, current enough that nobody has to ask. * A standing, accurate answer to “what can we sell today, what is coming, and when” \- so sales stops guessing and engineering stops being surprised. * Status reporting that leadership reads instead of requesting. * Meetings that end with decisions and owners rather than another meeting. **Key responsibilities** **Bridging sales and delivery** * Sit between the VP of Sales, the CTBO and engineering, and keep all three working from the same picture. * Translate what sales is promising into what engineering has to build, and flag the gap before a commitment is made rather than after. * Maintain what is sellable today versus what is on the roadmap, and keep that honest. * Chase the dependencies between the two sides \- the content, the configuration, the approval, the answer from a customer \- so nothing stalls quietly. **Pipeline and clients in flight** * Take handover of the pipeline as it stands today from business development, and make it current, complete and usable by everyone who needs it. * Track prospects through the pipeline: where each one stands, what it is waiting on, what it would take to close. * Run onboarding for clients in flight end to end, from kickoff to go\-live. * Keep the CRM and the delivery plan reflecting the same reality. * Be the point of contact who knows the status, an  * Own the Jira board: hygiene, flow, and whether it still describes how work actually moves. * Turn requirements into tickets with clear scope and acceptance criteria, and push back when a requirement is not ready. * Run the cadence \- planning, standups, retrospectives \- at whatever weight a small team can sustain without ceremony for its own sake. * Track work through the release path into TEST and on to production, and make sure nothing sits in a column because nobody noticed. **Meetings, status and reporting** * Facilitate the meetings: set the agenda, hold the time, and leave with decisions and owners written down. * Produce status reporting an executive can read in two minutes and an engineer can trust. * Identify risks early, escalate with a recommendation rather than a question, and manage scope changes including the schedule consequence. * Own the administrative detail that keeps a small company moving \- scheduling, follow\-ups, documentation, the things that fall through when everyone is busy. **Working solo, and working remotely** * This is a fully virtual role. jobs.title: Senior Magento Architect
jobs.description: **Who We Are** ServerMonkey is a global provider of enterprise IT hardware solutions, trusted by organizations that demand performance, reliability, and value. We deliver new and refurbished servers, storage, and networking equipment from leading OEMs, supported by rigorous testing, quality assurance, and fast turnaround times. Our mission is to help companies extend the life of their infrastructure, optimize budgets, and scale smarter through high‑quality hardware, lifecycle services, ITAD, and custom configuration. ServerMonkey is looking for a strategic and technical leader to own our e\-commerce technology stack. We are not just an online store; we are a complex Configure\-to\-Order (CTO) platform running on a highly customized Magento 2 environment hosted on AWS. **This role is fully in the office in Houston, TX.** You will lead the restructuring of our web team, bridging the gap between technical engineering, product data, and digital marketing. You’ll stabilize the platform, optimize our complex server configurator for speed and UX, own the cloud architecture end to end, and help extend our storefront into international markets and channels as you build a scalable architecture that drives revenue growth. **Key Responsibilities** **1\. Technical Strategy \& Platform Ownership** * **The Configurator:** Take full ownership of our custom server configuration tool. Lead initiatives to refactor legacy code, improve load times and enhance mobile usability * **The Roadmap:** Manage the end\-to\-end lifecycle of our Magento 2 Commerce platform, balance hands\-on development with high\-level strategy * **Performance \& Security**: Maintain Core Web Vitals, ensure PCI compliance and manage regular security patching and data protection standards * **Standardization:** Establish development standards, documentation and deployment processes to eliminate breaking changes in production * **Architecture Ownership:** Define and document the target\-state architecture — application, data, integration, and infrastructure layers — and own the technical decision record for major platform changes **2\. AWS Cloud Infrastructure \& Reliability** * **AWS Architecture:** Own the design and cost of our AWS footprint — EC2/ECS, Aurora MySQL (RDS), ElastiCache for Redis, OpenSearch, S3, CloudFront, Route 53, ALB, Auto Scaling Groups, and VPC/subnet/security group design * **Infrastructure as Code:** Drive everything through Terraform or CloudFormation/CDK — no manual console changes in production * **Scalability \& Peak Traffic:** Architect for promotional spikes and seasonal peaks with auto\-scaling, read replicas, queue\-based decoupling (SQS/SNS/EventBridge), and load testing ahead of major campaigns * **Resilience \& DR:** Multi\-AZ deployments, backup/restore strategy, documented RTO/RPO, and regular failover testing * **Security \& Compliance in the Cloud:** IAM least\-privilege, AWS WAF/Shield, Secrets Manager/Parameter Store, KMS encryption, GuardDuty, and CloudTrail auditing in support of PCI\-DSS * **Observability:** CloudWatch metrics, logs, and alarms paired with APM tooling so issues are caught before customers report them * **FinOps**: Continuously right\-size instances, manage reserved/savings plans, and report on cost\-per\-order infrastructure economics **3\. Team Leadership \& Restructuring** * **Build the “Triad”:** Restructure the department into three functional pods * **Platform Pod:** Internal and Agency Backend/Frontend developers * **Data Pod**: Product specialists managing complex compatibility rules * **Growth Pod:** Technical SEO and UX specialists * **Agency Management**: Act as the primary stakeholder for external agencies, holding them accountable for code quality, budgets, and deadlines * **Mentorship:** Hire, lead, and mentor technical talent to foster a forward\-looking, solution\-oriented culture * **Cloud Governance**: Set the standards for how the team and our agencies work in AWS — access controls, environment parity, change management, and release windows **4\. Business \& Marketing Alignment** * **Technical SEO**: Partner with marketing to solve faceted navigation issues, canonical tagging, and schema markup * **UX Excellence:** Translate complex hardware compatibility rules into a simple, guided buying experience * **Integrations:** Ensure data integrity between Magento, GA4, and our ERP (NetSuite) / Inventory systems * **International Growth**: Support expansion into international markets — multi\-store views, multi\-currency and multi\-language storefronts, localized payment methods, tax/VAT/duty handling, cross\-border shipping logic, and geo\-based CDN routing * **Channel Expansion:** Architect and maintain integrations with international and third\-party sales channels (marketplaces, distributor portals, B2B punchout) so catalog, pricing, and inventory stay consistent across every channel **Qualifications** * **Deep Magento 2 Knowledge:** You must understand the “why” behind performance bottlenecks. Is it a database deadlock, poor Varnish caching, or inefficient request flows? You need the technical authority to overrule agencies who claim the platform can’t run faster. Deep understanding of Magento 2 architecture (Cloud/On\-prem), PHP 7/8, MySQL, and caching strategies (Varnish/Redis/Elasticsearch) * **Customer\-Facing Platform Experience:** Proven track record architecting high\-traffic, revenue\-generating B2C and/or B2B storefronts where uptime, checkout conversion, and page speed directly affect the P\&L — not just internal tools or back\-office systems * **Extensive AWS Experience:** 4\+ years designing, deploying, and operating production e\-commerce workloads on AWS, with hands\-on depth in compute, networking, managed databases, caching, CDN, and security services. AWS Solutions Architect (Associate or Professional) certification strongly preferred * **International E\-Commerce Exposure:** Experience supporting cross\-border or multi\-region commerce — localized storefronts, currency and tax complexity, international shipping/compliance, hreflang and international SEO, and data residency/GDPR considerations * **Complex Logic Experience:** Our configurator relies on deep dependencies. You should have experience with Rules Engines, ERP integrations or CPQ (configure, price, quote) tools * **DevOps Mindset**: You care about CI/CD pipelines, automated testing, and server\-side performance (New Relic, Blackfire) to ensure sub\-2\-second load times, and you’ve built pipelines with tools such as CodePipeline/CodeBuild, GitHub Actions, or GitLab CI deploying into AWS * **Experience:** 7\+ years in Web Development/E\-commerce, with 3\+ years in a technical leadership or architect role **The “Complex Product” Factor:** Proven experience managing sites with massive catalogs or configurable products (50\+ options) is critical * **Stack Proficiency:** Familiarity with JavaScript (Knockout.js/React), REST APIs, Linux (RHEL/Ubuntu administration and shell scripting), and AWS/Azure infrastructure * **Communication:** Able to explain infrastructure trade\-offs and cost implications to non\-technical executives as comfortably as you debug a slow query **Bonus Points** * **Industry Knowledge:** Experience in IT Hardware, Servers, or Data Center industries * **Certifications:** Adobe Certified Expert – Magento Commerce; AWS Certified Solutions Architect or DevOps Engineer * **Systems:** Previous experience with NetSuite or similar ERP migrations * **Modern Frontend:** Experience with PWA Studio or Vue Storefront * **Adobe Commerce Cloud:** Hands\-on experience with Adobe Commerce Cloud (which runs on AWS) or a comparable managed Magento hosting platform * **Containers \& Orchestration:** Docker, ECS, or EKS in production * **Migration Experience:** Having led an on\-prem or co\-located e\-commerce platform migration into AWS * **Global Rollouts:** Having launched a storefront in a new country or region Position Type\- Full\-Time/Regular FSLA Exempt \#LI\-TT1 ServerMonkey is an equal opportunity employer *We are an Equal* *Opportunity/Affirmative* *Action Employer.*

jobs.title: Principal Software Development Engineer
jobs.description: At Sonos we want to create the ultimate listening experience for our customers and know that it starts by listening to each other. As part of the Sonos team, you’ll collaborate with people of all styles, skill sets, and backgrounds to realize our vision while fostering a community where everyone feels included and empowered to do the best work of their lives. At Sonos we want to create the ultimate listening experience for our customers and know that it starts by listening to each other. As part of the Sonos team, you’ll collaborate with people of all styles, skill sets, and backgrounds to realize our vision while fostering a community where everyone feels included and empowered to do the best work of their lives. As a **Principal Embedded Software Engineer** on the **Player API \& Control** team, you will lead performance\-critical and customer\-facing initiatives across the Sonos player stack. You will have a direct impact on the responsiveness, scalability, and reliability of core playback and control experiences. This role sits at the intersection of embedded systems, distributed communication protocols, telemetry, and cross\-platform API design. You will work across teams including App, Cloud, Security, Data, and QA to identify performance bottlenecks, design architectural improvements, and ensure measurable customer impact. If you love solving deep technical challenges, analyzing real\-world data, and delivering meaningful improvements to millions of listeners, we want to talk with you. This is a hybrid position, allowing for a combination of remote work and in\-office collaboration. Qualified applicants must live within commuting distance of our Boston or Seattle office locations and should expect to be in office a minimum of 3 days per week. **What You’ll Do** ------------------ * Lead performance and reliability initiatives across the Sonos APIs. * This engineer will work on Player Control components and participate in developing software for enabling new products * Collaborate across teams to mentor local junior peers and facilitate internal development and testing. * Participate in all aspects of the software development life cycle including planning, requirements, development, and testing. * Act as a customer advocate by participating in the product definition and planning process. * Support service initiatives that adhere to best practices for security, scalability, cost, and overall performance. * Identify and eliminate latency bottlenecks in player\-to\-app and player\-to\-cloud communication. * Design and implement architectural improvements (e.g., async command execution, protocol optimizations, reduced handshake overhead). * Use telemetry and customer data to correlate code changes to real\-world impact. * Partner cross\-functionally with App, UX, PM, and Data teams to improve end\-to\-end user experience. * Mentor engineers through design reviews, code reviews, architecture discussions, and root cause investigations. * Proactively investigate system\-level issues before they escalate into customer\-impacting problems. Present performance findings and architectural proposals to engineering leadership and broader forums. * **What You’ll Need** -------------------- ### **Basic Qualifications** * Bachelor’s Degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or equivalent experience. * 8\+ years of experience in embedded or systems\-level software engineering. * Strong proficiency in C\+\+. * Experience working with REST and/or WebSocket\-based APIs. * Experience debugging complex, multi\-threaded systems. * Experience working with telemetry, instrumentation, or performance measurement frameworks. * Deep understanding of networking fundamentals (TLS/mTLS, WebSocket, HTTP, LAN communication). * This role requires commuting distance to our main engineering office in Seattle or Boston. ### **Preferred Qualifications** * Experience optimizing embedded systems for performance and memory constraints. * Experience with secure communication protocols (TLS, DTLS, authentication flows). * Experience analyzing large\-scale telemetry datasets to drive engineering decisions. * Familiarity with distributed systems and device\-to\-device communication. * Experience with CI/CD systems and modern Git workflows. * Familiarity with Sonos architecture or similar control\-plane systems. * Experience presenting technical proposals to senior engineering leadership. **Impact of This Role** ----------------------- This role will directly influence: * Playback latency and responsiveness * Player Control components * Command execution performance across devices * Customer\-reported reliability metrics * Cross\-team API usability and scalability * The long\-term architecture of the Player API platform * This is a senior\-level IC5 role expected to operate with autonomy, technical depth, and cross\-team influence. of experience required with AutoCAD Civil 3D. * Must be able to pass a drug and alcohol test and have an acceptable motor vehicle record to drive a company vehicle. * This is not a remote position. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform essential functions. * While performing the duties of this job, the employee occasionally works in outside weather conditions. * The noise level in the work environment is usually moderate. **Why SMA?** Since 1985, **Souder, Miller \& Associates** has been a leader in providing engineering, survey, and environmental solutions across New Mexico. jobs.title: Data Scientist, Mail (US)
jobs.description: **Location** ------------ Remote \- United States; Hub \- New York; Hub \- San Francisco; Hub \- Seattle **Employment Type** ------------------- Full time **Location Type** ----------------- Remote **Department** -------------- Engineering, Product, Design, and MarketingEngineeringDataData Science *Superhuman offers a remote\-flexible working model for this particular role on the Mail team. This gives team members plenty of focus time and the flexibility to do their best work from wherever they're based, while staying closely connected to a collaborative, tight\-knit team culture. For those based in San Francisco, New York City, or Seattle, a hybrid setup is also available.* **About Superhuman** -------------------- Grammarly is now part of Superhuman, the AI productivity platform on a mission to unlock the superhuman potential in everyone. The Superhuman suite of apps and agents brings AI wherever people work, integrating with over 1 million applications and websites. The company's products include Grammarly's writing assistance, Docs’ collaborative workspace, Mail's inbox management, and Go, the proactive AI assistant that understands context and automatically delivers help. Founded in 2009, Superhuman empowers over 40 million people, 50,000 organizations, and 3,000 educational institutions worldwide to eliminate busywork and focus on what matters. Learn more at superhuman.com and about our values here. **The Opportunity** ------------------- Want to use data science to shape how one of the most beloved productivity products in the world grows, retains, and delights its users? This Data Scientist position is embedded in the Superhuman Mail business unit, working alongside Data Engineering, Finance, RevOps, and UX Market Research. Together, you act as one numbers\-and\-insights team, with a direct line to the leaders setting strategy and a shared mandate to move the metrics that matter. **Superhuman Mail is the fastest, most AI\-native email experience ever built.** It helps knowledge workers and teams fly through their inbox twice as fast, stay on top of what matters most, and collaborate without friction — saving users four hours every single week. Where email has barely changed in decades, Superhuman Mail is reimagining it from the ground up: AI that drafts replies in your voice, auto\-labels and triages incoming messages, surfaces follow\-ups before you drop the ball, and can even send emails on your behalf. It serves everyone, from individual professionals to Fortune 500 sales teams, and boasts a deeply loyal user base and a product people genuinely love. The data environment is rich, the growth questions are hard, and the opportunity to drive real impact — on acquisition, activation, retention, and expansion — is enormous. **Your work on Mail is part of a broader platform story.** The Superhuman Platform suite includes Grammarly's writing assistance, Mail, Docs, Databases, and Go, our proactive AI assistant. As a compound startup, we're building an integrated suite rather than separate tools — so insights you surface in Mail ripple across the full product portfolio, and cross\-product growth loops connect the dots between how users discover, adopt, and expand across the suite. Our products serve both consumers and enterprises, creating an unusually rich data environment. Our user base spans students and knowledge workers, individual users and Fortune 500 companies, universities and global enterprises, across a growing range of languages and markets. That breadth creates no shortage of important questions to own. This is an opportunity for those drawn to complex, high\-stakes growth problems — in a product people are passionate about — who want their work to measurably change outcomes. **What you’ll do** ------------------ * Be the embedded data science partner for the Mail core product team — shaping feature strategy, prioritization, and roadmap decisions with evidence, not just fielding ad hoc requests. * Define and own the metrics that matter for Mail: activation milestones, engagement depth, retention curves, and the leading indicators that tell us whether a new feature is actually changing how people work in their inbox. * Design and run experiments across the Mail product lifecycle — from onboarding and first\-week activation to long\-term habit formation — and build the measurement frameworks that separate signal from noise. * Shape the measurement strategy for Mail's AI features — Auto Drafts, Auto Labels, Auto Archive, Calendar, MCP, and the agentic capabilities on the roadmap — by defining quality frameworks and behavioral metrics that show whether AI is making users genuinely faster and more effective. * Figure out what makes Mail sticky: which features drive the deepest engagement, what the activation sequence looks like for users who become power users, and where in the funnel we're leaving value on the table. * Partner with product\-led and sales\-led growth to identify and quantify the  e messy middle. Mail is a product people are genuinely passionate about — the questions are hard, the feedback loop is fast, and the opportunity to shape how millions of people experience their inbox is real. **Qualifications** ------------------ * You have 5\+ years of data science experience and a track record of driving measurable impact for business and customers. * You have deep expertise in experimentation and causal inference. You’re fluent in A/B testing as well as quasi\-experimental and observational methods, and you know when to use each. * You’re fluent in Python and SQL, with strong data exploration and manipulation skills. * You have strong applied statistics skills and machine learning skills, and you use them to drive product and growth decisions. * You can translate ambiguous business questions into sound experimental designs, measurement plans, and metrics. * You influence cross\-functional partners and turn technical insight into action through clear communication, empathetic building, and openness to ideas from anywhere. * You’re a self\-starting, creative problem\-solver who distills problems to their core and thrives with ambiguity. * You have a bachelor’s degree in a quantitative field (statistics, mathematics, economics, computer science, data science, or a similar field); an advanced degree or equivalent practical experience is preferred. ### **Nice to have** * You have experience working at a fast\-growing startup, on AI\-native consumer products, and/or in B2B/SaaS. * You’ve been a strategic thought partner to product, growth, or business leaders, driving data\-driven decisions. * You’ve evaluated the quality of AI, LLM, or agentic products hands\-on. * You’re comfortable using AI\-assisted development tools like Claude Code or Codex to move faster, and you have the judgment to validate and supervise their output. * You’re familiar with experimentation platforms such as Statsig and modern data stacks such as Databricks. * You have experience with product\-led growth and/or lifecycle and marketing analytics. * You’ve helped data science teams establish the methods, standards, and processes they use to collaborate. **Compensation and Benefits** ----------------------------- Superhuman offers all team members competitive pay along with a benefits package encompassing the following and more: * Excellent health care (including a wide range of medical, dental, vision, mental health, and fertility benefits) * Disability and life insurance options * 401(k) matching * Paid parental leave * 20 days of paid time off per year, 12 days of paid holidays per year, two floating holidays per year, and flexible sick time * Generous stipends (including those for caregiving, pet care, wellness, your home office, and more) * Annual professional development budget and opportunities Superhuman takes a market\-based approach to compensation, which means base pay may vary by location. Our US locations are categorized into two compensation zones based on proximity to our hub locations. Base pay may vary considerably depending on job\-related knowledge, skills, and experience. The expected salary ranges for this position are outlined below by compensation zone and may be modified in the future. ### **US Zone 1 \- SF, SEA, NYC** $225,000 to $275,000 ### **US Zone 2** $202,000 to $247,500 **We encourage you to apply** ----------------------------- At Superhuman, we value our differences, and we encourage all to apply—especially those whose identities are traditionally underrepresented in tech organizations. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, gender expression or identity, sexual orientation, ancestry, national origin, citizenship, age, marital status, veteran status, disability status, political belief, or any other characteristic protected by law. Superhuman is an equal opportunity employer and a participant in the US federal E\-Verify program (US). We also abide by the Employment Equity Act (Canada).
