jobs.title: AI Information Security Engineer
jobs.description: **Who is Tenable?** Tenable® is the Exposure Management company. Over 40,000 organizations around the globe rely on Tenable to understand and reduce cyber risk. Our global employees support 65 percent of the Fortune 500, 50 percent of the Global 2000, and large government agencies. Come be part of our journey! **What makes Tenable such a great place to work?** Ask a member of our team and they'll answer, "Our people!" We work together to build and innovate best\-in\-class cybersecurity solutions for our customers; all while creating a culture of belonging, respect, and excellence where we can be our best selves. When you're part of our \#OneTenable team, you can expect to partner with some of the most talented and passionate people in the industry, and have the support and resources you need to do work that truly matters. We deliver results that exceed expectations and we win together! **Applicants must be authorized to work for any employer in the U.S. without sponsorship. We are unable to provide sponsorship for work visas of any kind at the time of hire, or at any point during employment. This includes, but is not limited to: F1\-OPT, F1\-CPT, H\-1B, TN, J\-1, etc** **Your Role:** As an AI Security Engineer on Tenable's Information Security team, you will help shape and mature our approach to securing AI both within Tenable's products and across the enterprise. AI introduces a new class of risk at the intersection of application security, cloud risk, and data governance, and you will be on the front lines of defining how we assess, test, and address it. You will apply hands\-on AI engineering experience alongside deep product security and application security skills to design security controls for AI systems, lead assessments, and help engineering teams ship AI features securely. You will establish security standards for responsible AI use, influence decisions across the organization, and build tooling that raises our security posture. This role is ideal for a practitioner who has spent real time building with AI systems, looking under the hood of model internals, and wants to channel that experience into a security specialty. **Your Opportunity:** * Design, implement, and maintain end\-to\-end security controls across the AI/ML lifecycle. * Conduct safety research, inspecting model internals (e.g., detecting hidden deception, latent knowledge, or unwanted concepts across layers) as a core methodology. * Perform AI safety assessments and threat modeling for AI/ML systems, identifying risks such as data poisoning, model evasion, model extraction, adversarial inputs, and integrity attacks. * Design and implement robust security guardrails, controls, and boundary mechanisms for Large Language Models (LLMs), Small Language Models (SLMs), and open\-source models. * Act as a subject matter expert in AI safety research by inspecting model internals to detect hidden deception, latent knowledge, or unwanted concepts, ensuring highly transparent and aligned AI outputs. * Continuously monitor the AI landscape for novel vulnerabilities and attack techniques, applying deep engineering experience to proactively defend enterprise AI deployments. * Develop security reference architectures for AI deployment patterns, including MCP servers and agentic AI workflows and harnesses. * Deploy controls to ensure model integrity, governance, and proper access control across models and feature stores. * Build AI\-driven tooling to strengthen cybersecurity posture across identity, incident management, vulnerability management, third\-party risk, and emerging AI threat vectors. * Perform AI safety, security assessments, threat modeling for AI/ML systems, identifying risks such as data poisoning, model evasion, model extraction, adversarial inputs, and integrity attacks. * Collaborate with software engineers, and product teams to integrate security best practices into AI development, training, validation, and deployment processes. * Drive Secure Software Development Lifecycle (SSDLC) and DevSecOps practices for AI\-powered products, including threat modeling, security testing, penetration testing, and CI/CD pipeline security automation. * Create security guidance, documentation, and training for internal engineering and development teams; develop metrics that drive desired security behaviors and outcomes. * Research emerging trends in AI security and contribute to innovative solutions that support Tenable's AI initiatives. **What You'll Need:** * 5 or more years of professional experience in information security or application security, with at least 1–2 years focused on securing AI/ML systems. * Master's Degree in Computer Science, Cybersecurity, Data Science, or a related field preferred; advanced degree preferred. * Deep understanding of AI\-specific security threats, including adversarial ML, data poisoning, prompt injection, model inversion, model evasion, and inference attacks. * Strong coding experience in Python and/or Go. * Experience with frameworks \& libraries such as PyTorch, Hugging Face Transformers, TensorFlow or similar. * Experience using specialized interpretability and probing tools/libraries such as TransformerLens, NNsight, Captum, or LIT (Learning Interpretability Tool). * Familiarity with mechanistic \& Architectural Concepts: inspecting internal model states, residual streams, attention patterns, activation steering, Sparse Autoencoders (SAEs), or feature attribution. * Strong understanding of the ML/AI lifecycle and the security risks associated with each stage. * Knowledge of cloud security platforms: AWS, Azure, or GCP including AI/ML\-related services. * Knowledge of data security principles, including encryption, masking, and tokenization. * Knowledge of SSDLC, DevSecOps, and security testing practices, including SAST, DAST, SCA, and threat modeling. * Knowledge of application security architecture best practices and patterns, including modern web applications, Docker, and microservices. * Ability to work cross\-functionally across engineering, product, and business teams. * Strong written and verbal comAAmunication skills; able to clearly translate complex AI security risks for both technical and non\-technical audiences. * Strong problem\-solving skills, attention to detail, and ability to lead projects with end\-to\-end ownership. * Self\-motivated and effective working independently and across distributed teams. **And Ideally:** * Hands\-on experience with AI red teaming, adversarial prompt testing, or LLM security assessments. * Familiarity of AI security frameworks and standards, including OWASP LLM Top 10 and the NIST AI Risk Management Framework. * Experience with application security assessment tools (Burp Suite, ZAP, Tenable WAS, etc). * Familiarity with AI governance frameworks (EU AI Act, NIST AI RMF, etc). * Background in cloud security or large\-scale SaaS product environments. * Security certifications: CISSP, CSSLP, SANS GIAC, CEH, or AI\-focused security certifications are a plus, but not necessary. \#LI\-Hybrid \#LI\-MS1 *We're committed to promoting Equal Employment Opportunity (EEO) at Tenable \- through all equal employment opportunity laws and regulations at the international, federal, state and local levels. If you need a reasonable accommodation due to a disability during the application or recruiting process, please contact* *Recruiting@Tenable.com* *for further assistance.* **Tenable Data Consent Statement** Tenable is committed to protecting the privacy and security of your personal data. This role will enable Tesla to meet the demands of used car operations, including third\-party lease vehicle intake, high\-volume trade\-in intake, recertification, and automation with wholesale buyer and auction vendors. You will lead the technical design and delivery of backend systems that automate the end\-to\-end used vehicle lifecycle — from intake and inspection through recertification and sale via retail or wholesale channels — while keeping customer and operator experiences fast, reliable, and intuitive as Tesla continues to expand. This is a hands\-on senior backend role. You will architect and operate high\-throughput, fault\-tolerant services, apply agentic AI to remove operational friction, and use AI coding agents as a regular part of how you design, implement, and ship. define SLOs; and build AI\-based anomaly detection to surface intake failures, inventory drift, integration breakage, and traffic/performance outliers before they impact operations * Write high\-quality, well\-tested code with regular use of AI coding agents; drive design and code reviews; mentor engineers on distributed systems and AI\-assisted engineering practice * Partner with Product, Sales, Fleet, Service, Finance, and engineering teams; communicate estimates, dependencies, and risks clearly **What You'll Bring*** Degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Physics, Math, or equivalent evidence of exceptional ability * 6\+ years of professional software engineering experience, including substantial ownership of production backend systems at scale * Proven expertise designing, building, and operating distributed systems: microservices or SOA, concurrency, consistency, fault tolerance, and graceful degradation * Expert\-level proficiency in at least one backend language used in large systems (Go, Java, Python, C\#, or equivalent), including production debugging of complex runtime issues * Deep, hands\-on experience with Kubernetes and containerized workloads, including deployment, scaling, resource management, and production operations * Experience operating high\-traffic or high\-throughput systems, including load, queueing, rate limiting, caching, and performance profiling * Strong data layer experience: relational databases (e.g. MySQL/PostgreSQL) plus at least one of Redis, Kafka/event streaming, or OpenSearch/Elasticsearch * Practical experience building agentic AI workflows to improve operational efficiency, including knowledge of the agentic loop (plan, tool use, observation, retry/correction) and grounding agents in reliable backend systems * Experience building AI\-based anomaly detection on production signals (metrics, logs, events, or operational data), and daily use of AI coding agents to accelerate design, implementation, review, and debugging * Clear communication and high agency; jobs.title: Validation Engineer, Industrial Energy Products
jobs.description: **What to Expect** We are seeking a validation engineer for the site\-level energy controller on our utility\-scale battery sites. That controller runs on embedded Linux. It manages settings, telemetry, and failover, and it talks to utility and SCADA equipment. You will run software\-centric SIL and HIL for it, build that regression with System Integration, and keep the work on the bench. You do not need to have already defined a validation program. You do need the instinct to look at a controller change and suspect which failure would escape, then go prove it. Our stack includes Go, Rust, and Python. We are language agnostic, and none of these is mandatory. **What You'll Do*** Run software\-centric SIL and HIL for the site\-level energy controller on embedded Linux — settings, telemetry, redundancy/failover, and utility/SCADA communications — so System Integration is testing the site, not the application * Propose the cases worth automating. For a controller change, look for the failures that would escape — restarts, partial writes, timed\-out peers, split state — and do not stop at a suite that only proves the happy path. System Integration and the software team decide which of those become permanent tests * Build that regression with System Integration: automated SIL and HIL that runs against controller builds and catches those cases before they become a system\-test problem. The team writes these tests in pytest * Validate Modbus, DNP3, and SCADA behavior on the bench, including timeouts, bad frames, and peer dropouts, on real equipment where the lab has it and in simulation where it does not * Debug the bench you share. You will not own rack bring\-up, but you will trace a failure from the application through TCP/IP to the port, and you will touch the hardware when that is the fastest way to separate a software bug from a wiring one * When the defect is below the application, follow it far enough to hand off a reproducible case. Kernel and OS depth is learned here. The work stays on the bench: no field deployments, no full\-site signoff **What You'll Bring*** Degree in Engineering (Software, Electrical, Computer, or a related field), or equivalent experience * Internship, co\-op, or up to a few years in test, embedded software, or controls. A new graduate with a strong lab or project record qualifies. Five years is not required * Evidence you think about how something fails, not only how to show it works. A project or internship where you found a case the obvious test missed * Some time on a bench, in SIL, or in HIL. You have written or changed a test, not only run one someone else wrote * Networking fundamentals enough to follow a conversation from the application toward the wire, and a willingness to debug on real hardware * One industrial protocol, or proof you can pick an unfamiliar one up quickly. Modbus, DNP3, or SCADA. All three is not required * Able to read code and change a test harness. Our stack includes Go, Rust, and Python. We are language agnostic, and none of these is mandatory * Able to write automated tests. We use pytest. Perform fire protection engineering tasks for new and existing facilities, including analysis/basis, plans, specifications, calculations, and estimates for acquisition of active and passive fire protection systems, such as: Water\-based fire suppression, standpipe, chemical\-based, and gaseous clean agent fire suppression systems. Fire pump and control systems, water supply and storage systems, firefighting access and fire hydrant systems. Advanced early warning and conventional fire alarm/detection and mass notification systems, fire alarm reporting systems. Smoke control/management systems, structural fireproofing systems, and firestop systems. Nationally recognized testing laboratory requirements, life safety and means of egress systems, fire\-resistance\-rated construction and opening protective systems. Facility mutual fire exposure protection, building code allowable facility size regulations, electrical hazard classifications, hazardous material/waste protection, life safety power supply, and marking/illumination of egress systems. In addition, the Fire Protection Engineer will: Coordinate with team members to execute project scope, create/manage schedules, and track/brief budget execution in conformance with project and customer requirements. Create project technical dashboard reports via Microsoft software (Power BI, Project, Excel, etc.). Facilitate the minimization of project delays by providing technical reviews and recommendations within predetermined timeframes. Prepare and deliver briefs supported by necessary project documentation to project team members, base personnel, and senior management. Ensure timely submission of submittals, reviews, and recommendations. Education: Graduate of an accredited Engineering college curriculum (4\-year degree minimum). Experience: Minimum of 6 years of Design Management and/or Design experience performing the tasks described above. It is highly desirable, but not required, to hold a current U.S. Professional Engineering (P.E.) license in the fire protection discipline. Demonstrated knowledge of broad\-based engineering principles and versed in the discipline being hired. Sound understanding of technical concepts, principles, and practices applicable to multi\-disciplined engineering project design. jobs.description: Texas Instruments (TI) is looking for an organized and analytical individual to fulfill an **AP Analytics and Compliance Analyst**. **Business Summary** Accounts Payable and Accounts Receivable (APAR) play a critical role in protecting the company’s financial assets, enabling customers and suppliers, and managing financial transactions across a complex global business. The AP Analytics and Compliance Analyst will work at the intersection of finance, data, technology and risk. ownership and source\-of\-truth alignment * Translate findings into clear recommendations and management readouts for operational and senior leadership **Process Improvement \& Transformation** * rollout and adoption of new systems and processes **Compliance, Controls \& Risk** * Support the design, implementation and monitoring of AP financial controls * Perform data\-driven control testing Security and other stakeholders to resolve control issues **Technology \& Payments** * Use Denodo, Spotfire, APIs and related technologies to automate data extraction, transformation, analysis and workflows * Build and integrate solutions using REST APIs, JSON and other system interfaces * Partner with IT to design, test and implement integrations and technical solutions * Develop prototypes and proof of concepts to demonstrate new capabilities * Identify practical opportunities to apply AI, machine learning and intelligent automation within APAR, with appropriate governance and protection of financial and customer data * Build expertise in AP, AR and payment flows, and identify ways to improve payment efficiency, security and customer or supplier experience **What Success transformation of the organization. **Qualifications** ------------------ **Required** * Minimum Bachelor’s degree in Data Analytics, Information Systems, Computer Science, Finance, Accounting or a SOX compliance and financial controls * Experience with data visualization and BI platforms such as Business Objects, Spotfire or equivalent * Working knowledge of SQL, Python or another scripting or programming language * Experience with ETL or ELT, data modeling, data quality and data lineage * Understanding of APIs, REST services, JSON and system integrations * Ability to translate complex business processes and problems into technical solutions * Experience with process improvement, project management or technology implementation * Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to tailor messages to different audiences * Ability to work independently across functions, influence without authority and manage projects through completion * Strong judgment, time management, strategic thinking and compliance mindset * Ability to proactively identify risks and opportunities and communicate recommended actions **Preferred** * Experience in accounts receivable, accounts payable, treasury, payments or other financial operations * Knowledge of PCI DSS and payment\-card security requirements * Understanding of international financial, privacy or payment compliance requirements * Experience with workflow automation or RPA technologies * Practical experience with generative AI, LLMs, AI agents or AI\-enabled workflow automation * Knowledge of machine learning, anomaly detection or predictive analytics * Understanding of identity and access management, segregation of duties, encryption and tokenization * Experience with fraud analytics or continuous controls monitoring **About Us** ------------ **Why TI?** * Engineer your future. We empower our employees to truly own their career and development. Come collaborate with some of the smartest people in the world to shape the future of electronics. * We're different by design. Diverse backgrounds and perspectives are what push innovation forward and what make TI stronger. We value each and every voice, and look forward to hearing yours. Meet the people of TI * Benefits that benefit you. We offer competitive pay and benefits designed to help you and your family live your best life. Your well\-being is important to us. Please find our country\-specific benefits here **About Texas Instruments** Texas Instruments Incorporated (Nasdaq: TXN) is a global semiconductor company that designs, manufactures and sells analog and embedded processing chips for markets such as industrial, automotive, data center, personal electronics and communications equipment. At our core, we have a passion to create a better world by making electronics more affordable through semiconductors. This passion is alive today as each generation of innovation builds upon the last to make our technology more reliable, more affordable and lower power, making it possible for semiconductors to go into electronics everywhere. jobs.title: Senior Test Engineer
jobs.description: **About Thea Energy:** Thea Energy is leveraging recent breakthroughs in stellarator physics and engineering to create a faster and simpler approach to commercializing fusion energy. The company is reinventing the stellarator using computer\-controlled arrays of planar coils thereby replacing the intricate, complex modular magnets required in all other stellarator architectures. Thea Energy is on a mission to create a limitless source of zero emission energy for a sustainable future. **Position Overview:** Thea Energy is seeking a Senior Test Engineer to serve as a cornerstone of our hardware validation strategy. This role is central to the execution of a leading fusion energy company and requires a high degree of autonomy. You will drive the verification and validation efforts for our superconducting magnets as well as other critical technology, ensuring that our hardware meets the rigorous demands of a fusion environment. The role will require close alignment and cross\-functional leadership across test, manufacturing, mechanical, and physics organizations. Your efforts will directly contribute to ensuring design success, enabling us to succeed in our commercial fusion energy goal. Thea Energy’s dynamic team is made up of self\-motivated individuals with an excitement for solving complex problems. ### **Key Responsibility Areas:** * Develop and own test validation strategy, including defining the testing milestones required to qualify High\-Temperature Superconducting (HTS) magnets, cryogenic systems, and high vacuum components. * Act as a subject matter expert for the test engineering team. You will work closely with magnet, electrical, and controls teams to ensure test results directly inform and de\-risk the next generation of stellarator design. * Lead relationships with key vendors for specialized hardware and for advanced test facilities, managing high\-value procurement contracts and coordinating external design, build, and validation efforts to meet aggressive project timelines. * Establish and enforce rigorous safety protocols for high\-voltage, high\-field, and cryogenic environments, ensuring all operations meet or exceed IEEE, ANSI, and IEC standards where applicable. ### **Ideal Experience \& Skillsets:** * 8\+ years of hardware\-centric test engineering experience in high\-stakes environments (e.g., fusion, aerospace, superconducting magnets). * BS or MS in Electrical Engineering, Applied Physics, or a related field. * Proven track record of managing the verification and validation lifecycle for integrated systems. * Mastery of LabVIEW and Python, with expertise in automating complex, multi\-day cryogenic and electromagnetic tests. * Demonstrated ability to work with a high degree of autonomy and make critical engineering decisions under tight deadlines. * Exceptional ability to translate complex test data into actionable insights for executive leadership and external stakeholders. * Ability to work through and solve highly multidisciplinary engineering problems. * Ability to take initiative, work independently and as part of a team. * Exceptional work ethic, with clear communication and collaboration skills. * Ability to occasionally lift objects up to 50 lbs. *It’s not necessary to meet all of the skillsets outlined above. They must preserve each solution’s business purpose and differentiation, make practical tradeoffs across speed, cost, quality, and scale, and act on risks before they threaten delivery. Understanding what delays or technical shortcomings mean for revenue opportunities, client commitments, and competitive advantage is essential. We require a hands\-on leader who earns the team’s respect through expertise, clear direction, and sound judgment. They will mentor engineers, set high standards, bring clarity to complex decisions, and remove obstacles that hinder progress. They will hold themselves and teams accountable for delivery while staying involved in critical design and implementation decisions. The right candidate will bring deep technical expertise, strong business judgment, and demonstrable experience taking MVPs or early\-stage solutions through enterprise deployment and scale. They should be as comfortable discussing business priorities and tradeoffs with the CEO as working through technical challenges with engineers, and able to show how their leadership improved business outcomes and strengthened teams. Success will be measured by enterprise\-ready products delivered on time, measurable business value, and a high\-performing engineering team equipped to support Theorem’s growth. This is an exceptional opportunity for a seasoned Technical Architect to drive meaningful business impact, with a runway to accelerate their professional growth within a highly visible and influential role. **Essential Functions and Responsibilities:** --------------------------------------------- **Technical Architecture \& Engineering** * Lead the architecture, design, and development of enterprise\-grade applications and distributed systems using modern Microsoft technologies, including C\#, ASP.NET Core, and current Microsoft\-supported .NET releases, with strong expertise in modern .NET architecture, development practices, and platform modernization. * Guide architectural standards, engineering frameworks, coding practices, and technical design principles across multiple engineering teams. * Design scalable, resilient, secure, and high\-performing cloud\-native solutions aligned to business strategy and long\-term platform evolution. * Establish and maintain architecture roadmaps that support scalability, maintainability, extensibility, and operational efficiency. * Apply modern architectural patterns and methodologies including Domain\-Driven Design (DDD), Event\-Driven Architecture, and Microservices. * Oversee technical design reviews, architecture reviews, and code reviews to ensure engineering quality and alignment to standards. * Drive system observability, reliability, performance optimization, and technical debt reduction initiatives across platforms and services. * Provide technical input for executive leadership to align technology decisions with business priorities, operational goals, and product strategy. **AI\-Augmented Engineering \& Innovation** * Champion the adoption of AI\-assisted engineering practices through demonstrated experience using tools such as GitHub Copilot, Claude, ChatGPT, etc. * Introduce proven AI\-enabled workflows to improve development efficiency, documentation, testing, code quality, and engineering productivity. * Evaluate emerging technologies, frameworks, and engineering trends to continuously modernize the organization’s technical capabilities. **Collaboration \& Delivery** * Collaborate cross\-functionally with Product Management, UX, DevOps, QA, and business stakeholders to define technical solutions aligned to product and business objectives. * Translate highly technical concepts into clear, business\-friendly communication suitable for executive and non\-technical audiences. * Provide strategic technical guidance during planning, prioritization, roadmap development, and enterprise decision\-making for Theorem’s Upward and Video Commerce solutions. * Identify technical risks, scalability concerns, security vulnerabilities, and architectural dependencies early in the delivery lifecycle. * Support Agile delivery methodologies including sprint planning, backlog refinement, technical estimation, release planning, and continuous improvement practices. **Required Skills \& Experience:** ---------------------------------- **Education \& Experience** * Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Technology, or related field, or equivalent practical experience. * 10–15 years of progressive experience in software engineering, solution architecture, and enterprise application development. * Proven experience leading architecture and technical delivery for large\-scale enterprise, SaaS, or product engineering environments. * Strong experience designing and deploying cloud\-native solutions within Microsoft Azure environments. * Experience working with distributed global engineering teams and Agile/Scrum methodologies. * Active practical experience using AI\-assisted engineering tools and workflows within software development environments is required. **Technical Skills** * **Microsoft Development:** Advanced expertise in C\#, ASP.NET Core, and modern .NET development. * **Architecture:** Strong command of cloud\-native and distributed systems architecture, including Microservices, Domain\-Driven Design (DDD), Event\-Driven Architecture, and modern API design. * **Azure \& DevOps:** Deep Microsoft Azure expertise, including Azure Functions, containerization, CI/CD, observability, security, and Infrastructure as Code. * **Data \& Messaging:** Experience designing scalable data and messaging solutions using technologies such as Cosmos DB, Azure Service Bus, SQL Server, and PostgreSQL. * **AI\-Augmented Engineering:** Hands\-on experience applying AI\-assisted development tools and workflows, such as GitHub Copilot, Claude, and ChatGPT, to improve engineering productivity, quality, and innovation. **Soft Skills \& Behaviors** * **Inspirational Leadership:** Leads by example and inspires engineering teams to pursue high standards, embrace innovation, and continuously improve their technical capabilities and ways of working. * **Strategic \& Commercial Thinking:** Connects technology and architectural decisions to business strategy, product objectives, customer needs, and long\-term organizational outcomes. * **Influence \& Communication:** Communicates complex ideas with clarity and credibility, building alignment and influencing decisions across engineering, product, business, and executive stakeholders. * **Learning Agility \& Adaptability:** Demonstrates intellectual curiosity and sound judgment, quickly navigating new technologies, changing priorities, and ambiguity while maintaining a clear sense of direction. * **Collaborative Leadership \& Ownership:** Creates trust and accountability through a hands\-on, collaborative leadership style; develops others, encourages diverse perspectives, and empowers teams to deliver exceptional outcomes. **Benefits:** ------------- * Competitive salary * Comprehensive benefits package including medical, dental, vision, and FSA. * 401(k) retirement savings plan with company match. * Life and Disability Insurance. * Flexible hybrid schedule that promotes work\-life balance. * Learning and development opportunities to push your capabilities and increase your knowledge. * An open\-minded leadership team that believes that every voice matters. * Working with a fun team of diverse people who celebrate birthdays, host team\- building events, give back to our communities, and promote engagement and well\- being in the workplace. * Theorem is Great Place To Work Certified™ and has been ranked 1st, 2nd, and 3rd as a Best Workplace from NJBiz and Best Companies Group. **Employer Statement** ---------------------- Theorem is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees through our T.H.R.I.V.E. initiative. ###### ***\*Candidates must be lawful U.S residents and be able to commute to Theorem’s HQ in Chatham NJ.***

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager, Impact Portfolio
jobs.description: **Senior Product Manager, Impact Portfolio** **Think Together is a California nonprofit that partners with schools to change the odds for kids. Founded in 1997, Think Together operates the greatest number of expanded learning programs across California, serving \~100K students, and is home to a suite of additional programs that aim to drive systemic change across California’s public\-school systems.** **About Think Digital** Think Digital, a division of Think Education, builds AI\-powered tools that help school leaders reduce administrative work, strengthen decision\-making and improve student outcomes. Drawing on nearly 30 years of experience in California schools, we partner with education leaders to turn proven practices into practical technology that helps school systems create the conditions for every student to succeed. **JOB SUMMARY** The Senior Product Manager is a hybrid product and design role on the product team: the person responsible for the full arc from problem to product. The role is responsible for leading discovery and UX research, defining product direction, and partnering with engineering on designing and building solutions, working hand\-in\-hand with our centralized design team for craft and consistency. The Senior Product Manager is the connective tissue across stakeholders district partners, internal leadership, customers in the field, and the exec team — keeping everyone aligned and clear on what’s There are no direct reports, but this role is expected to lead the team through clarity, influence, and product judgment. **ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES** ========================================= * Shape the strategic direction of a live product by translating early signals and insights into priorities, investment decisions, and a clear vision for the product’s continued evolution. * Drive product discovery and User Experience (UX) research, gathering qualitative and quantitative insights directly from users, district partners, and the market to inform product direction. * Evaluate product performance and user engagement to surface insights, shape strategic priorities, and guide ongoing product evolution. * Define clear, evidence\-based product priorities and success metrics aligned with organizational goals and user needs. * Partner closely with engineering to design and deliver solutions that address real user needs. * Work hand\-in\-hand with the centralized design team to bring craft, systems, and visual consistency to the product. * Champion an iterative, prototype\-driven approach to product development, reducing risk through early and frequent learning. * Own cross\-functional alignment across school districts administrators, engineering, field customers, and executive leadership by translating priorities into clear strategic direction, decisions, and next Balance long\-term vision with short\-term execution, continuously prioritizing to maximize impact. * Coordinate and lead cross\-functional sprints, aligning priorities, organizing work, and facilitating delivery to advance product outcomes. * Iterate and refine agentic processes; identify opportunities for improvement and incorporate feedback to enhance effectiveness and scalability. **QUALIFICATIONS AND REQUIREMENTS** * A bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience. * A demonstrable track record of having taken a real problem, framed it well, built a product or service around it, and shipped it, not just planned or consulted on it. * Strong problem\-solving instincts and the judgment to navigate hard constraints with limited information. * 5\+ years working on technology\-powered products as a product manager, product designer, engineer, or UX researcher. * Experience conducting UX research and translating user insights directly into product decisions. * Exceptional communication skills, including the ability to flex tone and depth across very different audiences, from a school district administrator to an engineer to an executive, leaving each of them feeling understood and clear on what’s next. * Demonstrated ability to lead through influence rather than authority, aligning cross\-functional teams without formal reporting lines. * Experience in EdTech or education, preferred. * Hands\-on experience with design tools (Figma or similar) and the ability to create or critique prototypes directly, preferred. * Familiarity with AI or agent\-based product development, preferred. * We’re building tools for California schools, so proximity to CA is a plus. **ADDITIONAL EMPLOYMENT REQUIREMENTS:** ======================================= * Must pass Live Scan (criminal background check via fingerprinting). * Provide and maintain current TB clearance throughout employment. * Reliable transportation is required to meet the needs of the position. * While driving may not be a regular requirement, employees who operate a personal or company vehicle for work\-related purposes must maintain and provide Human Resources with proof of a valid driver’s license and current automobile insurance. **COMPENSATION:** ================= Salary: $150,000\.00 *This is the targeted compensation for the position. A range of factors, including but not limited to; location, skills, experience, will be considered. Actual compensation may vary.* *Think Education is an Equal Opportunity Employer that does not discriminate on the basis of actual or perceived race, color, national origin, ancestry, sex, gender, gender identity, gender expression, pregnancy, childbirth or related medical conditions, religious creed, physical disability, mental disability, age for individuals age 40 and over, medical condition (as defined by state law (for example, cancer or genetic characteristics or HIV/AIDS), marital status, military and veteran status, sexual orientation, genetic information, citizenship status or any other characteristic protected by federal, state or local law. Our management team is dedicated to this policy with respect to recruitment, hiring, placement, promotion, transfer, training, compensation, benefits, employee activities and general treatment during employment.*

jobs.title: Staff Data Platform Engineer
jobs.description: Job Description Noetica is an AI\-native legal technology company, now part of Thomson Reuters, that transforms complex corporate transaction data into structured, searchable market intelligence. Its platform helps legal and finance professionals analyze deal terms, identify market trends, and assess risk with greater speed and confidence. As a Staff Data Platform Engineer, you will set the technical direction for Noetica’s data infrastructure and lead the evolution of systems that process legal and financial document data at significant scale. This hands\-on technical leadership role combines architecture, implementation, cross\-functional influence, and team development to ensure the platform supports rapid AI innovation while meeting demanding reliability, security, and compliance standards. Key Responsibilities * Own the technical roadmap for the data platform, balancing scalability, reliability, security, compliance, and business priorities. * Architect next\-generation pipelines and storage systems for high\-volume document data. * Lead decisions on technology selection, system design, and infrastructure strategy across the platform. * Advance data governance, privacy controls, compliance frameworks, and audit capabilities for regulated data. * Partner with machine learning and AI leaders to enable model training, evaluation, and inference at scale. * Establish technical standards, mentor engineers, and help build a high\-performing platform organization. * Represent the platform function in company\-wide architecture and engineering decisions. Remain hands\-on by owning critical systems and contributing code to solve complex technical challenges. * Required Qualifications * Ten or more years of software engineering experience, including at least six years focused on data platforms, infrastructure, or large\-scale backend systems. * Demonstrated expertise architecting distributed systems, including high\-throughput pipelines and petabyte\-scale or similarly complex data processing environments. * Deep knowledge of big data technologies, distributed databases, and modern data platforms. * Strong systems programming skills in Python, Java, C\+\+, Rust, or Go, with experience delivering production systems. * Expertise in data compliance, privacy engineering, and secure data handling in regulated environments. * Experience building and mentoring engineering teams and driving complex technical initiatives to completion. Sound judgment in balancing engineering quality, delivery speed, cost, risk, and business impact. * Preferred Qualifications * Experience in a high\-growth environment where platform infrastructure was critical to business success. * A record of leading major architectural transitions or platform migrations. * Published technical writing or public speaking on data systems, architecture, or engineering practices. * Experience with machine learning infrastructure, feature stores, or platforms that support AI workloads. * Background in legal technology, financial services, or another highly regulated industry. Coding in Python * \#LI\-MW1 **What’s in it For You?** * **Hybrid Work Model:** We’ve adopted a flexible hybrid working environment for our office\-based roles while delivering a seamless experience that is digitally and physically connected. * **Flexibility \& Work\-Life Balance:** Flex My Way is a set of supportive workplace policies designed to help manage personal and professional responsibilities, whether caring for family, giving back to the community, or finding time to refresh and reset. This builds upon our flexible work arrangements, including work from anywhere for up to 8 weeks per year, empowering employees to achieve a better work\-life balance. * **Career Development and Growth:** By fostering a culture of continuous learning and skill development, we prepare our talent to tackle tomorrow’s challenges and deliver real\-world solutions. Our Grow My Way programming and skills\-first approach ensures you have the tools and knowledge to grow, lead, and thrive in an AI\-enabled future. * **Industry Competitive Benefits:** We offer comprehensive benefit plans to include flexible vacation, two company\-wide Mental Health Days off, access to the Headspace app, retirement savings, tuition reimbursement, employee incentive programs, and resources for mental, physical, and financial wellbeing. * **Culture:** Globally recognized, award\-winning reputation for inclusion and belonging, flexibility, work\-life balance, and more. We live by our values: Obsess over our Customers, Compete to Win, Challenge (Y)our Thinking, Act Fast / Learn Fast, and Stronger Together. * **Social Impact:** Make an impact in your community with our Social Impact Institute. We offer employees two paid volunteer days off annually and opportunities to get involved with pro\-bono consulting projects and Environmental, Social, and Governance (ESG) initiatives. * **Making a Real\-World Impact:** We are one of the f ccordance with any applicable state or municipal laws. Finally, Thomson Reuters offers the following additional benefits: optional hospital, accident and sickness insurance paid 100% by the employee; optional life and AD\&D insurance paid 100% by the employee; Flexible Spending and Health Savings Accounts; fitness reimbursement; access to Employee Assistance Program; Group Legal Identity Theft Protection benefit paid 100% by employee; access to 529 Plan; commuter benefits; Adoption \& Surrogacy Assistance; Tuition Reimbursement; and access to Employee Stock Purchase Plan. Thomson Reuters complies with local laws that require upfront disclosure of the expected pay range for a position. The base compensation range varies across locations.\&\#xa;\&\#xa;Eligible office location(s) for this role include one or more of the following: New York City, San Francisco, Los Angeles, and/or Irvine, CA; McLean, VA; Washington, DC. The base compensation range for the role in any of those locations is $146,800 USD \- $272,600 USD.\&\#xa;\&\#xa;Base pay is positioned within the range based on several factors including an individual’s knowledge, skills and experience with consideration given to internal equity. Base pay is one part of a comprehensive Total Reward program which also includes flexible and supportive benefits and other wellbeing programs.\&\#xa;This role may also be eligible for an Annual Bonus based on a combination of enterprise and individual performance.\&\#xa; **About Us** Thomson Reuters informs the way forward by bringing together the trusted content and technology that people and organizations need to make the right decisions. We serve professionals across legal, tax, accounting, compliance, government, and media. Our products combine highly specialized software and insights to empower professionals with the data, intelligence, and solutions needed to make informed decisions, and to help institutions in their pursuit of justice, truth, and transparency. Reuters, part of Thomson Reuters, is a world leading provider of trusted journalism and news. We are powered by the talents of 26,000 employees across more than 70 countries, where everyone has a chance to contribute and grow professionally in flexible work environments. At a time when objectivity, accuracy, fairness, and transparency are under attack, we consider it our duty to pursue them. Sound exciting? Join us and help shape the industries that move society forward. As a global business, we rely on the unique backgrounds, perspectives, and experiences of all employees to deliver on our business goals. To ensure we can do that, we seek talented, qualified employees in all our operations around the world regardless of race, color, sex/gender, including pregnancy, gender identity and expression, national origin, religion, sexual orientation, disability, age, marital status, citizen status, veteran status, or any other protected classification under applicable law. Thomson Reuters is proud to be an Equal Employment Opportunity Employer providing a drug\-free workplace. Thomson Reuters makes reasonable accommodations for applicants with disabilities, including veterans with disabilities, and for sincerely held religious beliefs in accordance with applicable law. If you reside in the United States and require an accommodation in the recruiting process, you may contact our Human Resources Department at HR.Leave\-Expert@thomsonreuters.com . Disability accommodations in the recruiting process may include things like a sign language interpreter, making interview rooms accessible, providing assistive technology, or other relevant accommodations. Please note this email is not intended for general recruitment questions and we will promptly respond to inquiries regarding accommodations. More information on requesting an accommodation here. Learn more on how to protect yourself from fraudulent job postings here. More information about Thomson Reuters can be found on thomsonreuters.com

jobs.description: At Thrivent, we are focused on a digital transformation that will deliver modern, innovative experiences for our clients, financial advisors, and employees. We are investing in data and technology, using DevOps practices, and building an engineering culture of empowered technical experts. Our technologists are involved in work that includes java, react, cloud native development, enterprise integration, automation, cloud data platforms, artificial intelligence, and machine learning as well as maximizing platforms such as Salesforce and AWS. The Engineering Manager for Product Acquisition will help define and drive Thrivent’s Wealth Management and Insurance Product technology strategy and execution. We are looking for a manager with hands\-on technical experience to drive the strategy along with helping coach and mentor a team of engineers. You will lead a team of engineers and will collaborate with other engineering teams within the organization regarding strategy, adoption of our product operating mode, operational excellence, DevOps/engineering maturity, and implementation of the platform. If you are excited and passionate about leading a team to set and drive the Thrivent Digital Advisor Experience forward, apply today! **DUTIES \& RESPONSIBILITIES:** **Designing Solutions** * Review technical solution design ensuring it aligns with our architecture. product groups * Creates a positive team environment where individuals have psychological safety and work collaboratively while understanding, respecting, challenging and appreciating each other’s ideas **Collaborating across the organization** * Align your team with the priorities of the company and the technology organization for a given product area. **Setting product/platform technology team to build consensus on an approach and driving a build vs buy decision with the team. In a buy decision, works with the team to decide on criteria and vendor selection. * Execute or manage the overall technology solutions, platforms for the product groups and associated vendor relationships. **Coaching Engineers** * Holding regular 1:1s with team members and team meeting, * Provides constructive feedback, guidance and coaching to help engineers grow their skills and experience. * Provides career planning advice to engineers and creates development plans to help them achieve their career goals which leverages their skills and capabilities and provides them with learning opportunities. **Recruiting/building talent** * Leads the process of selecting and engaging the right consulting partners * Planning in advance for future people needs for the to our clients. Shapes and/or supports a culture that represents the Thrivent purpose, promise and values, ensuring that Thrivent’s trust and reputation remain strong with its clients. * Manage a team of direct employees and consultants. **QUALIFICATIONS \& SKILLS:** ***Required:*** * Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or other technical field or equivalent work experience * 8\+ years of progressively responsible positions in Information Technology including 5\+ years’ experience in software development, portfolio strategy and roadmap development. * 3\+ years’ management/supervisory experience in specific IT functional area discipline, e.g. applications development or equivalent skills leading major technical projects with accountability for enforcing talent management needs and performance standards. * Demonstrated experience and leadership introducing and growing a Product Operating Model (Agile/Scrum). * Demonstrated leadership and experience managing multidiscipline, high\-performance work teams. * Strong competency in project management and execution of multiple or large projects. * Experience working with customers to develop solutions to complex business problems. * Proven ability to communicate effectively with internal/external stakeholders to support business initiatives. * Proven ability to function in an environment which requires flexibility, good judgment and intelligent decision making, often based on limited information and/or extreme conditions. * Ability to formulate, implement and evaluate plans, programs and procedures applicable to customer relationship and demand management. ***Preferred:*** * Direct experience in Life, Health and Annuity insurance products, delivering technology for Financial Advisors. * Series 99 license or above. Pay Transparency Thrivent’s long\-term growth depends on attracting, rewarding, and retaining people who are committed to helping others thrive with purpose. We accomplish this by offering a wide variety of market competitive compensation programs to attract, reward, and retain top talent. The applicable salary or hourly wage range for this full\-time role is $139,455\.00 \- $188,676\.00 per year, which factors in various geographic regions. The base pay actually offered will be determined by a variety of factors including, but not limited to, location, relevant experience, skills, and knowledge, business needs, market demand, and other factors Thrivent deems important. The following benefits may be offered: various bonuses (including, for example, annual or long\-term incentives); medical, dental, and vision insurance; health savings account; flexible spending account; 401k; pension; life and accidental death and dismemberment insurance; disability insurance; supplemental protection insurance; 20 days of Paid Time Off each year; Sick and Safe Time; 10 paid company holidays; Volunteer Time Off; paid parental leave; EAP; well\-being benefits, and other employee benefits. jobs.title: Staff Software Engineer - AI Compute, Together Cloud
jobs.description: ### **About the Role** Together AI is building the AI Native Cloud, an end\-to\-end platform for the full generative AI lifecycle, combining the fastest LLM inference engine with state\-of\-the\-art GPU cloud infrastructure. The Together Cloud team builds the \[Together GPU Clusters](https://www.together.ai/gpu\-clusters) flagship IaaS product that provides high\-performance, AI\-ready GPU clusters through a self\-serve cloud console, along with the virtualized infrastructure layer powering Together's inference, RL, and fine\-tuning products. As a Staff Software Engineer focusing on AI Compute in the Together Cloud org, you will set technical direction for and build major components of the next generation AI cloud platform – a highly available, global cloud infrastructure with cutting\-edge virtualization of the latest ML hardware: GB300s/VRs, BlueField DPUs, InfiniBand and dual/quad\-plane RoCEv2 fabrics. That virtualized computing platform powers our own SaaS products – inference, RL, and fine\-tuning – and serves external cloud customers through self\-serve offerings such as on\-demand/reserved Kubernetes/Slurm clusters, across dozens of data centers and hundreds of thousands of GPUs. This is an architect\-and\-build role. Fully automated bootstrapping of GPU data centers, high\-performance virtualization of GPU compute and DC networking without compromising isolation or portability, and fault\-tolerant decentralized control planes — you'll set the architecture for these across our global and in\-DC services, and be a key owner of the hardest parts, in the code as well as the design. Your designs will span the IaaS layer of a greenfield Vera Rubin data center up to the global management plane that schedules capacity across all of them. At this level the job is as much leverage as code: the standards you set and the engineers you grow decide how fast the rest of Together Cloud ships. ### **Responsibilities** * **Own the GPU and network virtualization stack:** the hypervisor, kernel, and SDN work that keeps GPU compute and DC networking high\-performance, portable, and strongly isolated across heterogeneous hardware. * **Own the in\-DC IaaS layer:** architect and roadmap the services, Kubernetes operators, and libraries that provision and manage compute, storage, and networks in our data centers — VMs, parallel filesystems, VPCs, and InfiniBand partitions; lead its build\-out for a new Vera Rubin data center with thousands of GPUs, from hardware bring\-up to customer\-facing API. * **Design the GPU scheduling and global management plane:** the distributed control plane behind on\-demand and reserved clusters across dozens of data centers, including the systems that scale per\-cluster limits and automate the onboarding of new capacity. * **Architect monitoring and automated remediation for fault tolerance:** the strategy for automated detection, isolation, and recovery of failed nodes that keeps distributed pretraining and large\-scale inference running through hardware failures. * **Set technical direction across teams:** lead design reviews, resolve cross\-cutting architectural disagreements, unblock cross\-team dependencies and integration risks, and define the standards other engineers build against — measured in cluster reliability, time\-to\-first\-GPU on new capacity, and quality at scale. * **Grow the team:** mentor senior and junior engineers, deepen the team's expertise in virtualization, DC networking, and GPU infrastructure, and help raise the hiring bar for Together Cloud. * **Set the engineering bar:** create the testing frameworks, tools, and developer documentation that make our systems robust and usable by other teams, and shape the core, open\-source Together AI platform. To be successful you'll need to be deeply technical and an excellent communicator — expert software development fundamentals, deep systems knowledge and troubleshooting instincts, and the leadership and diplomacy skills to align teams that don't report to you. Much of this work starts ambiguous, and we expect you to define the scope yourself and drive it to production. ### **Requirements** * 7\+ years of professional software development experience, with expert\-level proficiency in at least one backend language (Golang desired), writing high\-performance, well\-tested, production\-quality code. * Track record of owning the architecture of large distributed systems from blank page to production at scale, including the judgment calls that could not be reversed cheaply. * Deep experience building and operating globally distributed, high\-performance microservice architectures across one or more cloud providers (AWS, Azure, GCP). * Expert systems knowledge across compute, networking, and storage — including concurrency, memory management, performant I/O, and scale at a global level. * Demonstrated technical leadership beyond your own commits: mentoring senior engineers, leading design reviews, and driving alignment across teams that do not report to you. * Excellent communication and diplomacy skills — able to write design docs that settle arguments, and to work effectively with technical and non\-technical stakeholders. * Experience building and operating reliable, customer\-facing production systems at scale, and owning the infrastructure automation (Terraform, Ansible), observability (Prometheus, Grafana), and CI/CD (GitHub Actions, ArgoCD) that keep them healthy. ### **Preferred Qualifications (not must haves)** * Deep Kubernetes internals experience, such as implementing non\-trivial Kubernetes operators, device/storage/network plugins, custom schedulers, or patches to Kubernetes itself * Deep experience with VMs/hypervisors, such as QEMU/KVM, cloud\-hypervisor, VFIO, virtio, PCIE passthrough, Kubevirt, SR\-IOV * Deep experience with DC networking tech \+ solutions, such as VLAN, VXLAN, VPN, VPC, OVS/OVN * Experience with Cluster API or similar * Experience working on high\-performance compute, networking, and/or storage * Experience virtualizing GPUs and/or InfiniBand * Experience building IaaS or PaaS systems at scale * Experience with DPUs/SmartNICs * GPU programming, NCCL, CUDA knowledge ### **About Together AI** Together AI is a research\-driven artificial intelligence company. We believe open and transparent AI systems will drive innovation and create the best outcomes for society, and together we are on a mission to significantly lower the cost of modern AI systems by co\-designing software, hardware, algorithms, and models. We have contributed to leading open\-source research, models, and datasets to advance the frontier of AI, and our team has been behind technological advancement such as FlashAttention, Hyena, FlexGen, and RedPajama. We invite you to join a passionate group of researchers in our journey in building the next generation AI infrastructure. ### **Compensation** We offer competitive compensation, startup equity, health insurance, and other benefits, as well as flexibility in terms of remote work. The US base salary range for this full\-time position is: $260,000 \- $300,000 \+ equity \+ benefits. Our salary ranges are determined by location, level and role. Individual compensation will be determined by experience, skills, and job\-related knowledge. ### **Equal Opportunity** Together AI is an Equal Opportunity Employer and is proud to offer equal employment opportunity to everyone regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity, veteran status, and more. Please see our privacy policy at https://www.together.ai/privacy

jobs.title: Senior Customer-Facing PHP Engineer
jobs.description: **Job Summary** Transport Pro is a leading provider of web\-based logistics software. We are looking for a **Senior PHP Developer** who thrives at the intersection of deep technical problem\-solving and customer empathy. This is not a traditional behind\-the\-scenes engineering role, nor is it a simple helpdesk position. You will serve as the primary technical interface for our clients—translating real customer friction into robust software solutions. We need an experienced developer who genuinely cares about solving human problems through code, understands the business impact of production issues, and takes pride in making our clients feel heard, supported, and valued. **A Note on Technical Depth:** We require a genuine software engineer with foundational knowledge. We are looking for candidates who can read stack traces, write SQL queries by hand, debug environment issues, and write clean, scalable PHP from memory. While AI tools (like Claude or Cursor) are fine for secondary assistance, if you rely on generative AI or "vibe coding" to figure out basic logic or troubleshoot standard errors, this position will not be a fit. **Work Environment \& Travel:** This position is fully remote. Your core mandate will be handling high\-touch customer support requests, configuring custom client installations, and writing production\-ready system enhancements. Because logistics operates around the clock, while 24/7 work is not required, this is not a strict 9\-to\-5 desk job. You will be part of an on\-call rotation to respond to critical customer emergencies on nights and weekends when urgent production issues arise. Additionally, while the day\-to\-day role is remote, **occasional travel will be required** (e.g., key client visits, high\-touch onboarding, or company offsites). Candidates must be willing and able to travel periodically as needed. **Responsibilities** * **Customer\-Centric Problem Solving:** Directly interact with clients to diagnose complex technical issues, provide empathetic communication, and deliver timely, high\-quality resolution to production support tickets. * **Full\-Stack Application Development:** Develop, refactor, and enhance server\-side applications using PHP, ensuring high performance, security, and maintainability. * **API \& System Integration:** Design and implement robust APIs (RESTful and SOAP) to facilitate seamless integrations between client environments and our core logistics platform. * **Software Architecture \& Design:** Participate in system design discussions, contributing to scalable software architecture and long\-term platform improvements. * **Clean Code \& Process Discipline:** Write readable, well\-tested, maintainable code following established engineering standards, SDLC processes, and version control (SVN). * **Testing \& Quality Assurance:** Perform hands\-on debugging and unit testing to ensure application stability across production and staging environments. * **Cloud \& OS Operations:** Manage and deploy services within Linux environments hosted on Google Cloud Platform (GCP). **Requirements** **Soft Skills \& Mindset** * **Empathy First:** Outstanding verbal and written communication skills with the ability to convey complex technical concepts calmly and clearly to non\-technical stakeholders. * **Owner's Mentality:** Deep accountability for customer success—you treat client emergencies with the urgency and care they deserve. * **Strong Diagnostic Instincts:** A methodical approach to troubleshooting that relies on fundamental knowledge, system logs, and code inspection rather than trial\-and\-error AI generation. * **Willingness to Travel:** Open to occasional travel (typically \< 10\-15%) for key client on\-site visits, training sessions, or internal team meetings. **Technical Capabilities** * **3\+ Years Senior PHP Experience:** Demonstrated expertise in modern PHP backend development within a production enterprise environment. * **Core Engineering Principles:** Deep proficiency in Object\-Oriented Programming (OOP), design patterns, data structures, and secure coding practices. * **Database Mastery:** Strong hands\-on experience with relational databases, specifically schema design, optimization, and complex query writing in **PostgreSQL**. * **Full Web Stack Proficiency:** Solid understanding of front\-end web technologies, including JavaScript, HTML5, CSS3, jQuery, and JSON formats. * **API \& Integration Protocols:** Proven experience designing and consuming RESTful and SOAP web services. * **Infrastructure \& Linux:** Familiarity with Linux server administration, shell scripting, containerized workflows, or cloud infrastructure (GCP/AWS). **Why Join Us?** At Transport Pro, we believe that great software engineering starts with a passion for helping real people. If you take pride in building rock\-solid code while delivering an exceptional client experience, we would love to have you on our team. Pay: $80,000\.00 \- $100,000\.00 per year Work Location: Remote

jobs.title: Forward Deployed Engineer
jobs.description: At Trunk Tools, we’re the leading AI company revolutionizing construction, the second\-largest industry on earth. We recently raised a $40M Series B led by Insight Partners, bringing our total funding to $70M from top\-tier investors including Redpoint and Innovation Endeavors. This new round is fueling our next phase of growth as we scale AI agents across the jobsite. Our mission is to build the future of construction through intelligent automation. Despite being a $13\+ trillion industry, construction still runs largely on analog processes, we’re changing that by embedding AI directly into field operations. Founded by builders and technologists (Stanford, MIT), our team has delivered software used by over 140,000 field professionals, impacting millions of users and contributing to $10B\+ in built projects. Many of us come from the field ourselves, giving us a deep understanding of the industry’s unique challenges. After years of building the “brain” of construction, we’re now launching production\-ready AI agents, starting with intelligent document processing and Q\&A, and rapidly expanding into core operational workflows. Our team has doubled in the past year, and with 100\+ employees (50\+ engineers), we’re scaling fast and entering a period of hypergrowth. This is a rare opportunity to join at an inflection point. **About the role** ------------------ Forward Deployed Engineers are how Trunk Tools gets into the field. You'll embed directly with our general contractor customers, stand up Cortex and our agents inside their real projects, and own the work of turning a pilot into a result the customer can measure: submittal reviews cut from 54\.8 days to 14, a 20\-sheet bulletin reviewed in under 10 minutes instead of roughly 6 hours, RFIs answered before they're ever sent. This is an early\-career role built for engineers who want to write real code, sit with real builders on real jobsites, and watch their work land in weeks, not quarters. You'll learn both the construction domain and the craft of deployment under experienced Forward Deployed Engineers, and everything you pick up in the field will flow straight back into the product. **What you'll do** ------------------ * **Deploy Cortex and the agents into live projects.** Connect a customer's document set, integrate with the systems they already run (Procore, Autodesk Construction Cloud), and configure the agents around how their teams actually work. * **Create new custom agents for use on live projects.** Leverage the Trunk Tools platform to create new agents for specific customer use cases that can be built, deployed, and used within a project, and used by the customer organization on multiple projects. * **Own the data\-to\-outcome loop for your accounts.** Get a working, measurable result on the customer's own drawings, specs, and submittals, fast, so the value is undeniable. * **Sit with the builders.** Spend time on jobsites and in trailers with project engineers, assistant project managers, and superintendents to learn their workflow and drive real adoption, not just a login. * **Write production\-quality code.** Build the tooling that makes each deployment work, and make it hold up as something the platform can reuse rather than a one\-off. * **Feed the field back into the product.** Bring what you learn to Product and Engineering so Cortex and the knowledge graph get sharper with every deployment. * **Partner with the account team.** Work alongside the deal owner from first proof through expanding across the customer's portfolio. **What we're looking for** -------------------------- * 0 to 3 years of software engineering experience with strong computer\-science fundamentals. Recent graduates with substantial project or internship experience are encouraged to apply. * Working proficiency in Python and/or TypeScript, and comfort with APIs, data, and building integrations between systems. * Clear, direct communication and genuine comfort in front of customers. We hire engineer\-diplomats: people who can write code in the morning and earn a superintendent's trust in the afternoon. * Willingness to travel to jobsites and customer offices, and real comfort working in the field, hard hat included. * A bias to action. You ship, you watch what breaks, you fix it, and you pick up a new domain quickly. * Low ego and a builder's respect for the people doing the work. **Bonus points** ---------------- * Exposure to construction, architecture, or engineering, or genuine curiosity about how buildings get built. * Familiarity with data, machine learning, or retrieval systems. * Prior customer\-facing, deployment, or forward\-deployed work. * Hands\-on experience with Procore or Autodesk Construction Cloud. **How we work** --------------- We live by three values, and this role touches all of them: * **Low Ego** \- we learn what construction teams need directly from them, on the jobsite. This job is that value made literal. * **No BS** \- we don't over\-promise AI. Every result you deliver should tie to time saved, cost reduced, or work won, and it should be real. * **High Output** \- we ship what we said we'd ship, when we said we'd ship it. **What we offer** A close\-knit and collaborative early\-stage startup environment where every voice is heard and every opinion matters Competitive salary and stock option equity packages 4 Medical Plans to choose from including 100% covered option. Plus Dental and Vision Insurance! Learning \& Growth stipend Flexible long\-term work options (remote and hybrid) Free lunch provided in the office in NYC \& Austin \- you’ll never go hungry with us! Unlimited PTO; We truly believe in work\-life balance and that hard work should be balanced with time for rest and rejuvenation IRL / In\-Person retreats throughout the year ***Please note:*** *All official communication from Trunk Tools will come from an email address ending in* ***@******trunk.tools****. If you receive outreach from any other domain, please disregard it or report it to us.* *At Trunk Tools, we’re working hard to build a more productive and safer environment within the construction industry, and we strive to live by these same values here at Trunk Tools HQ. As an equal\-opportunity employer, we are committed to building an inclusive environment where you can be you. We work hard to evaluate all employees and job applicants consistently, without regard to race, color, religion, gender, national origin, age, disability, pregnancy, gender expression or identity, sexual orientation, or any other legally protected class.* Compensation Range: $128,700 \- $209,000

This role requires both strong engineering discipline and software development capability. Our DevOps people are expected to think like developers, automate like platform engineers, and solve complex infrastructure and application problems with ingenuity and ownership. You will work on enterprise\-scale systems supporting large utility and financial organizations with strict compliance and security requirements, including SOC 2 Type II, PCI, PII, and occasional HIPAA\-regulated environments. **What We Work With** Our team actively develops and operates solutions using: * AWS cloud infrastructure and cloud\-native services * Terraform Infrastructure as Code * Python, C\#, and Go * Large Language Models (LLMs) and AI\-assisted engineering workflows * Claude AI * GitHub * Azure DevOps * Amazon Connect contact center solutions * CloudFront and AWS WAF * CI/CD pipelines, automation tooling, and deployment frameworks * Authentication and identity systems including SAML and OIDC **We are looking for DevOps People who** * Have Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, or similar degree. * Comfortable learning rapidly in evolving environments * Passionate about automation and operational excellence * Able to troubleshoot and solve difficult technical problems independently * Strong communicators who work well internal and external technical teams * Willing to take ownership of systems, deployments, and outcomes Successful candidates must be capable of bridging both worlds of software and infrastructure. **Responsibilities** * Build and maintain AWS infrastructure using Terraform * Develop automation tooling and internal platforms using Python, Go, and C\# * Support and improve CI/CD and deployment workflows * Design and maintain secure cloud architecture * Implement and troubleshoot authentication and federation technologies such as SAML and OIDC * Support enterprise\-grade Amazon Connect deployments and integrations * Work with engineering teams to improve developer workflows and platform reliability * Participate in operational support, troubleshooting, and production issue resolution * Contribute to AI\-assisted development and automation initiatives leveraging LLM technologies **Preferred Experience** * Experience working in regulated enterprise environments * Familiarity with AWS networking, security, IAM, WAF, and CloudFront * Experience with GitHub and/or Azure DevOps pipelines and repositories * Understanding of infrastructure automation and platform engineering concepts * Experience supporting customer\-facing enterprise systems * Exposure to contact center technologies or Amazon Connect is a plus **Job Program * Annual performance\-based bonus * Ongoing training opportunities * Visible, exciting work supporting the sales of cutting\-edge technology and workflow solutions. **Company Description** jobs.title: Sr Software Engineer - Android
jobs.description: **About the role and team** The AM\&D (Autonomous Mobility \& Delivery) team owns the autonomous future of Uber's Rides and Eats business, which is one of Uber's most important bets as a public company that sets the world in motion. Our goal is to eventually enable mass\-scale AV commercialization globally in all 10,000\+ cities Uber operates. We are just getting started. As we gradually but surely move towards this future, there is a full spectrum of engineering challenges that need to be tackled. For the Autonomous Mobility Product Engineering team, specifically:* How do we drive AV adoption with informative, trustworthy, and exciting experiences? * How do we make sure a rider's autonomous ride\-share experience is still safe, informative, and trustworthy without a human driver to interact with? From pickup, to on\-trip to drop\-off. We are solving problems that have never been solved before. Creating solutions that will shape the world's future in autonomous transportation. Therefore, we are looking for the best software engineering talent to join us to write this future chapter for humanity. **What you'll do*** Contribute to the creation of new features and platform capabilities, leveraging autonomous vehicle data and operational insights to build innovative solutions. * Build features to drive critical business growth for AV on Uber's platform. * Drive technical projects from inception to completion, collaborating with cross\-functional partners such as product managers, data scientists, and operations teams to deliver impactful solutions. * Balance technical trade\-offs between speed, performance, and quality, making informed decisions that align with both business goals and engineering best practices. * Cultivate engineering culture and technical excellence to drive up engineering velocity and quality across the team. **Basic Qualifications*** BS/BE degree or equivalent in Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, or a related field * 4\+ years of Software Engineering work experience * Extensive hands\-on Android development experience, including proficiency in Java and/or Kotlin programming and code reviews * Proven ability to lead technical projects end\-to\-end through all lifecycle stages, from inception through design through global deployment and productionization. * Expertise in defining standards for testing, monitoring, and alerting systems, while overseeing the execution of complex incident management at an organizational level. * Grit, drive, and a deep feeling of ownership * Self\-motivated with a passion to learn * Strong communication and collaboration skills **Preferred Qualifications** * MS or PhD in Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, or a related field * Experience in working on customer\-facing applications in mobility or delivery business. * Experience in Cross\-platform development (iOS and Android) * Outstanding verbal and written communication and presentation skills * Experience in developing mobile apps used by hundreds of millions of users globally. Strong focus on delivering high\-quality mobile UI experiences and feature development * Deep understanding of software engineering fundamentals, including algorithms, data structures, distributed systems, system design, and architecture. * Proven experience in identifying architectural gaps and creating org\-wide frameworks that improve developer velocity and reduce systemic technical debt.
